articles.title: Lumepay Raises $6M Pre-Seed to Scale African Cross-Border Payments
articles.excerpt:
Lumepay has disclosed a $6 million pre-seed round to expand its cross-border payments and digital asset infrastructure across Africa, following regulatory clearance to enter Kenya.

The post Lumepay Raises $6M Pre-Seed to Scale African Cross-Border Payments appeared first on The Fintech Times .

South African cross-border payments provider Lumepay has disclosed a $6 million pre-seed funding round backed by founder-led angels and domestic fintech investors. Closed at the start of 2026 alongside approximately $10 million in capital float secured to anchor client liquidity, the capital supports the company’s rail-agnostic B2B payments and digital asset infrastructure for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), corporates, and financial institutions. 

 The disclosure comes amid rapid structural shifts across global money movement, with worldwide cross-border payment volumes projected to reach $320 trillion by 2032 . Across Africa, businesses are increasingly moving away from fragmented correspondent banking chains toward faster settlement networks—a trend underscored by transaction values on the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) more than doubling in 2026 compared to the prior year . 

 Multi-Rail Infrastructure and East African Expansion 

 Led by CEO Harry Huang , chief operating officer Luc Varejes , and chief legal and compliance officer Tatenda Nhemachena —who bring more than 20 years of combined industry experience alongside a broader executive team—Lumepay operates at the intersection of conventional banking rails, foreign exchange depth, and stablecoin liquidity . 

 Lumepay co-founders from left to right, COO, Luc Varejes, CEO Harry Huang, chief legal and compliance officer, Tatenda Nhemachena 

 Following the pre-seed close, the company executed several commercial rollouts across the continent : 

 

 Digital Asset Trading: Launched Lumetrade, its institutional digital asset and stablecoin trading venue, in April 2026 . 

 Cross-Border Payments Platform: Rolled out its broader B2B cross-border payments platform across Africa in June 2026 . 

 Kenyan Market Entry: Secured regulatory clearance from the Central Bank of Kenya in October 2026 to launch local operations, enabling Kenyan enterprises to settle international supplier invoices in currencies including Chinese yuan (CNY), US dollars (USD), and Indian rupees (INR) while executing intra-African transfers . 

 

 Lumepay and Lumetrade are currently live across the West African CFA franc zone (XOF), Central African CFA franc zone (XAF), Nigeria (NGN), Ghana (GHS), Tanzania (TZS), Malawi (MWK), Mozambique (MZN), and Kenya (KES), with additional regulatory approvals pending to expand local payment capabilities . Looking ahead, the firm is prioritizing expansion across Southern, West, and Central Africa, specifically targeting Malawi, Mozambique, and the XOF and XAF regions . 

 “The future of cross-border payments isn’t traditional finance or stablecoins; it’s a combination of both, backed by the FX depth to make them work for real businesses,” stated Harry Huang . “That’s how we’ve built Lumepay: a rail-agnostic platform that works at the intersection between the two… Our integrated approach addresses the real drivers of friction: fragmentation, liquidity inefficiency and execution risk .” 

 “In the months since the raise, we’ve turned plans into working products: diversified and reliable liquidity; a platform that han dles cross-border payments end to end; a growing network of par tners and payment rails; and regulatory clearance in South Africa and Kenya, together with licensed partners across Francophone West and Central Africa,” added Luc Varejes . 

 Tier-One Banking Partnerships and Regulatory Architecture 

 To support institutional transaction volumes, Lumepay has established direct banking and regulatory infrastructure across key jurisdictions : 

 

 South African Payment Rails: Lumepay (Pty) Ltd operates as a registered Third-Party Payment Provider (TPPP) in South Africa, partnering with Nedbank as its sponsoring bank for domestic rand (ZAR) merchant collections and disbursements . 

 Regulated Digital Asset Dealing: Lume Trade (Pty) Ltd holds a Category I Financial Services Provider (FSP No. 54670) license covering intermediary services in crypto assets, derivatives, and deposits, utilizing a banking relationship with Standard Bank to facilitate ZAR deposits and withdrawals for institutional clients . 

 North American Registrations: Lumepay Limited is registered with Canada’s FINTRAC as a Money Services Business (MSB) and with the Bank of Canada as a payment service provider under the Retail Payment Activities Act . 

 

 “Banks are rigorous about who they work with, and they should be,” noted Tatenda Nhemachena . “Working with Nedbank and Standard Bank across our two businesses reflects the compliance standards we have built from day one .” 

 Having deployed its pre-seed capital to establish enterprise-grade security, wallet infrastructure, banking relationships, and licensed regional partnerships, Lumepay is now entering its growth phase and laying the groundwork for a Series A round . 

The post Lumepay Raises $6M Pre-Seed to Scale African Cross-Border Payments appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: Mercuryo Launches Swaps with 1,400 Routes Across 24 Digital Tokens
articles.excerpt:
Mercuryo's new Swaps product offers fixed-quote token conversion across 24 assets and 21 blockchain networks, though it is unavailable in the US, UK

The post Mercuryo Launches Swaps with 1,400 Routes Across 24 Digital Tokens appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Mercuryo , the London-headquartered payments infrastructure platform, has launched Swaps, a token conversion product that lets users move holdings between 24 digital assets across 21 blockchain networks. The company says the product covers 1,400 distinct swap routes, offers fixed quotes and zero slippage, and is executable in a single click. 

The asset list runs from the major tokens by market capitalisation, including bitcoin (BTC), ether (ETH) and the two dominant stablecoins, Tether’s USDt and USDC, through to more speculative names including Dogecoin, Pepe, Shiba Inu and Kaspa. Supported networks include Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Solana, BNB Smart Chain, TON and the XRP Ledger, among others. Liquidity is sourced through an unnamed cryptocurrency exchange that Mercuryo says applies anti-money-laundering controls, though the company has not disclosed the counterparty.

 The geographic restriction 

The most commercially significant detail in the announcement is a geographic carve-out: Swaps is not available to users in the United States, the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area. That restriction covers the three largest regulated digital-asset markets by institutional participation and removes a substantial proportion of global retail trading volume from Mercuryo’s addressable user base for this product.

The exclusion is likely a regulatory precaution rather than a commercial choice. In the UK, the Financial Conduct Authority requires cryptoasset businesses to register and applies financial promotions rules that constrain how token conversion services can be marketed. Across the EEA, the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation (MiCA), which came fully into force in late 2024, creates a harmonised but demanding licensing and disclosure framework for crypto-asset service providers. The US remains fragmented across Securities and Exchange Commission , Commodity Futures Trading Commission and state-level money-transmission regimes, and enforcement actions against token swap venues have put overseas providers on notice. Rather than clear those hurdles immediately, Mercuryo appears to be launching in markets where the compliance overhead is lower, keeping its options open for regulated-market entry at a later stage.

 Market context 

 Arthur Firstov, chief business officer at Mercuryo 

 Arthur Firstov , Mercuryo’s chief business officer, pointed to the company’s own on-ramp transaction data as the commercial rationale for the product. Mercuryo’s figures for the first half of 2026 show stablecoin transactions rising from 43 per cent to 60 per cent of total on-ramp volume during a period when bitcoin fell 33.2 per cent and ether dropped 47.3 per cent. The company interprets this as evidence that retail users are actively managing portfolio exposure rather than passively holding, creating demand for a low-friction conversion tool.

The token swap segment is well-established. Decentralised exchanges such as Uniswap and centralised platforms including Binance Convert and Coinbase ‘s Simple Trade all offer similar functionality, often with broader asset coverage and deeper liquidity. Mercuryo’s proposition is the fixed-quote model, which removes slippage uncertainty at the cost of locking in a spread, and integration with its existing on-ramp and payment infrastructure for users already on the platform. Whether that bundled positioning is sufficient to attract meaningful volume outside the UK, US and EEA remains to be tested.

The company counts Trust Wallet , MetaMask , Revolut , Mastercard and Visa among its partners, which gives it distribution into existing user bases that could provide an early adoption channel for Swaps. The unnamed liquidity provider and the lack of any disclosed fee or spread structure are gaps that institutional observers will note before assessing the product’s competitiveness.

The post Mercuryo Launches Swaps with 1,400 Routes Across 24 Digital Tokens appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: $220M in Longs Liquidated in 1 Hour as ETH Dips Below $2K and BTC Slides to $72K
articles.excerpt:
ETH dipped below $2,000 for the first time in almost three months. XRP went to a local low of its own at $1.02.

The cryptocurrency market is on the move again, and the direction is rather familiar and painful. Bitcoin just tanked to $72,000, marking a multi-month low, and the altcoins have followed suit after Trump’s latest comments on the war against Iran.

Expectedly, the total value of wrecked positions has jumped again, with $220 million worth of longs getting wrecked in just an hour.

Crypto Market Drops Again

Recall that it was just eight days ago when the primary cryptocurrency stood at $81,000 before it was rejected 24 hours later and slumped by several grand to $75,600. On Friday, it dipped further to under $75,000. Nevertheless, it managed to stand close to $76,000 over the weekend before the bears regained control of the market at the start of the current business week.

The culmination until today involved a slip below $73,000 on Tuesday after the higher-than-expected CPI reading. Bitcoin tried to recover some ground yesterday when it neared $75,000, but another rejection followed that drove it south to $73,500 earlier today. It dived once again minutes ago to $72,150 on most exchanges, after US President Donald Trump said his country doesn’t need a deal with Iran. Brent and WTI futures rose by over 1%, unlike the crypto markets.

 BTCUSD November 12. Source: TradingView 

Many altcoins have taken even more severe beatings. ETH slid below $2,000 for the first time since August 19, while XRP came just inches away from dipping beneath $1.00. NEAR has dumped the most among the larger-cap alts, plunging by almost 10% to under $3.40. XMR, HYPE, ZEC, DOGE, and SOL are also well in the red.

Liquidations Rise

The liquidations on a daily scale are up to $530 million, but $222 million out of that total came in the past hour alone. As typically happens under similar market conditions, longs are responsible for the lion’s share, with $217 million. BTC leads the adverse trend with $92.61 million in wrecked positions, while ETH follows suit with almost $59 million. That’s all in the past hour.

The number of wiped-out traders is close to 110,000, while the single-largest liquidated position took place on Hyperliquid and was worth over $31 million. It involved the BTC/USDT pair.

〈 加密交易所 Gemini 出清英歐業務！不到 1,000 萬美元賣給穩定幣支付商 KAST 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

紐約掛牌的 Gemini 把英國與歐盟業務賣給新加坡穩定幣支付商 KAST，成交金額不到 1,000 萬美元。這筆交易延續該交易所今年初的海外撤退，也反映加密產業的併購正在轉向「買執照」這種小額、重合規的標的。 （前情提要：Gemini 交易所盤前股價暴漲逾 25%！獲「1 億美元比特幣」注資、搶下 CFTC 牌照，無懼 Q1 虧損 1 億鎂） （背景補充：Gemini交易所正式啟動IPO：高盛、花旗承銷，股票代號GEMI、每股價格落在17-19美元） 雙子星交易所的上市母公司 Gemini Space Station（股票代號 GEMI）已把英國與歐盟業務轉手給新加坡穩定幣支付公司 KAST，成交金額不到 1,000 萬美元。這個數字由一名要求匿名的知情人士向媒體說明，理由是交易條件尚未對外公開。對照 Gemini 在 2025 年 9 月掛牌時的承銷定價區間，這筆錢只相當於一輪小型募資，賣掉的卻是能讓持牌公司在歐洲收付加密資產的監管資格。 交易輪廓其實先從一份職缺露出來。大約一個月前，KAST 開出的歐洲區總經理招募啟事就寫明，這名主管要負責 Gemini 英國與歐盟員工的移轉與過渡安排，等於在兩家公司正式說明之前，先把整併範圍寫進了工作內容。對於這筆交易，Gemini 拒絕評論；KAST 發言人不願談個案，僅表示公司「正因為營收與業務版圖成長，積極在市場上尋找併購機會」。 出售的起點在今年初。Gemini 2 月宣布收掉英國、歐盟與澳洲業務，同時削減全球約 25% 人力，只保留美國與新加坡兩塊市場，目標是把成本壓下來、往損益兩平靠近。當時市場已知有買方在看這些待關閉的英歐單位，看上的不是整家那斯達克上市公司的股權，而是它們手上的監管資格。交易落定等於證實這條路徑：許可與在地團隊被拆出來單獨出售，價格自然不會是整家公司估值的等比例縮小。 接手的一方來頭不小。KAST 總部在新加坡，做的生意是讓個人與企業持有、跨境移轉並直接花用穩定幣，產品線包含帳戶、跨境匯款與支付卡。創辦人 Raagulan Pathy 出身 Circle 管理層，公司在今年 3 月完成 8,000 萬美元 A 輪，由 QED Investors 與 Left Lane Capital 共同領投，募資用途明列申請許可與強化法遵。買下英歐單位，等於一次補齊在歐洲的落地資格、既有客戶與人事編制。 把幾筆金額放在一起看，定價邏輯就很清楚。KAST 手上的 A 輪資金是 8,000 萬美元，Gemini 在 5 月從 Winklevoss Capital Fund 拿到的注資是 1 億美元，而出售英歐業務的價碼不到 1,000 萬美元，大約只相當於 KAST 這輪募資的八分之一、Winklevoss 注資金額的十分之一。 Gemini 出售英歐業務的價碼不到 1,000 萬美元，遠低於 KAST 的 A 輪募資與 Winklevoss Capital 的注資金額（動區自繪） 整體併購市場也在往小額靠攏。併購顧問機構 Architect Partners 的季度統計顯示，第 3 季加密相關併購共 67 件、總額 22 億美元，金額比第 2 季少了 83%。件數還在、金額大幅縮水，說明買方現在要的是執照、通路與產品拼圖，而不是用大錢買下整家同業。 Gemini 一邊賣資產，一邊替自己找新的成長曲線。5 月那筆 1 億美元注資是以每股 14 美元買進 Class A 股、並以比特幣支付；8 月公司與 Apex Fintech Solutions 簽下意向書，要把受監管的加密預測市場鋪進券商通路，旗下 Gemini Titan 將成為 Apex 期貨佣金商提供加密事件合約的獨家合規場地。這條路線與賣掉歐洲據點並不矛盾，把資源集中到美國與新加坡，押注的是利潤率更高的產品。 短期最直接的檢驗點是財報。Gemini 排在美股週四收盤後公布第 3 季業績，市場要看的是虧損收斂速度、現金消耗，以及管理層怎麼說明海外撤退之後留下的營收缺口。 為什麼一張執照只值這個價？ 對買方來說，自己從零申請英歐許可，要付出時間、法遵人力與不確定的審核期。KAST 3 月才剛拿到 8,000 萬美元，用不到 1,000 萬美元買下現成執照、現成團隊與既有客戶關係，是效率最高的入場方式。對賣方來說，待關閉單位的固定成本不會因為停止攬客而消失，人事、法遵與稽核每月照樣燒錢，能換回現金、又讓管理層注意力回到美國與新加坡，帳面上怎麼算都比硬撐划算。 這也解釋了併購金額與件數的背離。22 億美元、67 件交易代表市場沒有凍結，只是單筆規模變小。當監管門檻成為加密業最貴的資產，交易自然從「買公司」變成「買資格」，而賣方多半是像 Gemini 這種正在重整、需要現金與聚焦的上市公司。 相關報導 Dragonfly 預言：穩定幣支付卡將成 2026 年重大主題 加密券商 FalconX 裁員10%：縮編新加坡策略，歐洲擴張接力 Gemini交易所在美國50州全面上架預測市場！Winklevoss兄弟博弈終於兌現〈加密交易所 Gemini 出清英歐業務！不到 1,000 萬美元賣給穩定幣支付商 KAST〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 施振榮二度出征APEC，深圳同場有川普、習近平、普丁
articles.excerpt: 11月，深圳APEC，川普確定赴會、普丁宣布出席，中國是主辦方。在這張大國雲集的牌桌上，台灣的領袖代表是宏碁創辦人施振榮。能否及如何與各國領袖互動為觀察重點，這位「微笑曲線」發明人將著總統期許傳達的三項主張，第二度踏上這個舞台。總統賴清德今（12）日上午在總統府舉行記者會，正式為2026年亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）經濟領袖會議代表團送行。宏碁集團創辦人暨榮譽董事長施振榮將率團前往深圳，出席11月18至19日舉行的經濟領袖會議。記者會上，施振榮夫人葉紫華也一同參加。賴總統致詞指出，台灣是以「所有會員都是在平等基礎上交流」的原則參與今年的安排會議。施振榮則表示，AI是本輪APEC的重點討論的議題

articles.title: 主要穩定幣 30 天縮水 142 億美元！創 2022 年 6 月以來最大跌幅
articles.excerpt:
Glassnode 追蹤的主要穩定幣美元供應規模，在截至 11 月 9 日的 30 天內淨減 142 億美元， […]

〈 主要穩定幣 30 天縮水 142 億美元！創 2022 年 6 月以來最大跌幅 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

Glassnode 追蹤的主要穩定幣美元供應規模，在截至 11 月 9 日的 30 天內淨減 142 億美元，創 2022 年 6 月以來最大收縮。該機構認為，贖回壓力正減少加密市場反彈可動用的資金。 （前情提要：USDT 總市值 60 日大減 40 億鎂逼近歷史極值，比特幣面臨流動性不足問題） （背景補充：穩定幣市值創四年來最大跌幅，但交易量寫歷史新高） 主要穩定幣的供應規模再度收縮。鏈上數據機構 Glassnode 在 11 月 11 日發布的週報指出，截至 11 月 9 日的過去 30 天，其追蹤的主要穩定幣美元規模淨減 142 億美元，是 2022 年 6 月以來最大的 30 日減少額。 穩定幣是交易者在交易所與鏈上保留資金、等待買入加密資產的常見工具。Glassnode 將這波收縮解讀為市場可動用的購買力減少，讓反彈面臨資金補給不足的壓力。 30 日淨減金額擴大，收縮規模創四年多來最大 Glassnode 的指標定義以供應數量乘以美元價格計算穩定幣市值；這份週報則觀察主要穩定幣美元規模的 30 日淨變化，用來追蹤供應擴張與收縮。 報告圖表顯示，本次 142 億美元的淨減額，已是四年多來最深的收縮。2022 年 6 月的同類讀數曾接近淨減 300 億美元，當時縮減的規模仍明顯大於這一輪。 Glassnode 將贖回壓力視為反彈資金減少的訊號 Glassnode 認為，供應縮減反映持有人將穩定幣贖回為美元，使留在加密交易市場內的資金減少。對等待買盤接力的市場來說，能以穩定幣形式直接投入的資金因此變少。 該機構也把 30 日變化重新轉為正值，視為新資金回流的初步訊號。它關注的是這個資金池能否恢復擴張，而不只是比特幣價格短暫回升。 ETF 持續贖回，部分大型錢包則開始承接 同份週報指出，截至 11 月 9 日，美國比特幣現貨 ETF 在過去 20 個交易日合計淨流出 16 億美元。穩定幣規模下滑之際，ETF 這條資金管道也處於贖回階段。 不過，Glassnode 同時觀察到，持有 100 至 1,000 枚 BTC、以及 1,000 至 10,000 枚 BTC 的兩類錢包已開始增持。其餘錢包族群仍在減持，顯示這波承接集中在少數持幣規模較大的群體。 相關報導 比特幣需求轉正！但穩定幣回流量仍少 加密市場慘烈去槓桿！Q2 現貨交易量暴跌 42% 創 2023 年來新低，下半年重頭戲看美國《清晰度法案》 USDC 交易量份額首度反超 USDT：Bernstein 稱穩定幣迎接新成長週期 摩根士丹利大砍 Circle 目標價至 38 美元！警告 USDC 面臨代幣化基金威脅〈主要穩定幣 30 天縮水 142 億美元！創 2022 年 6 月以來最大跌幅〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: Gemini 傳以不到 1,000 萬美元，把英國、歐洲業務賣給 KAST
articles.excerpt:
據 CoinDesk 引述知情人士，Winklevoss 兄弟的 Gemini 已把英國與歐洲業務賣給新加坡穩定幣支付公司 KAST，價格不到 1,000 萬美元；Gemini 不予置評，2 月已宣布撤出英國、歐盟與澳洲並裁員 25%。

這篇文章 Gemini 傳以不到 1,000 萬美元，把英國、歐洲業務賣給 KAST 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

據 CoinDesk 11 月 12 日引述知情人士報導，Winklevoss 兄弟創辦的加密貨幣交易所 Gemini，已把英國與歐洲業務賣給新加坡穩定幣支付公司 KAST，價格不到 1,000 萬美元。

Gemini 對此不予置評。KAST 發言人不談這筆交易，只說公司「營收與版圖都在成長，正積極尋找併購機會」。

Gemini 2 月已宣布撤出歐洲與澳洲，全球裁員 25%

Gemini 今年 2 月在 官方部落格 宣布撤出英國、歐盟與澳洲，全球裁員約 25%，只保留美國與新加坡業務，資源轉向預測市場。Winklevoss 兄弟當時說，美國一直是 Gemini 的主場，「是時候專注、加碼美國」。

英國業務在 4 月 6 日正式停止，當地用戶帳戶 3 月 5 日起只能提領，Gemini 請用戶到 eToro 開戶處理資產移轉。

KAST 一個月前的徵才啟事，已寫明要接手 Gemini 員工

CoinDesk 指出，KAST 約一個月前刊出歐洲總經理的徵才啟事，工作內容就包括帶領 Gemini 英國與歐盟員工完成過渡。

KAST 由前 Circle 主管 Raagulan Pathy 創辦，提供穩定幣帳戶、跨境轉帳與支付卡，讓個人和企業持有、轉移、消費穩定幣。公司今年 3 月以 6 億美元估值完成 8,000 萬美元 A 輪融資，由 QED Investors 與 Left Lane Capital 共同領投，資金用途包括取得牌照與合規。

第三季加密併購金額季減 83%

根據顧問公司 Architect Partners 的 季度報告 ，第三季加密產業共宣布 67 筆併購，總額 22 億美元，金額比第二季少了 83%。CoinDesk 形容，加密業的交易正轉向規模較小、為了取得牌照、通路或產品能力的收購。

Gemini 縮減海外業務的同時，創辦人也加碼出資。Winklevoss Capital Fund 5 月注資 1 億美元，以每股 14 美元買進 Gemini A 類股，用比特幣支付。依 Gemini 的 10-Q 申報，第二季 交易所營收年減 38% ，總營收則年增 37%。

這篇文章 Gemini 傳以不到 1,000 萬美元，把英國、歐洲業務賣給 KAST 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: 2022 年 TGA 最佳独立游戏《迷失》实体版登陆任天堂 Switch 2，29.99 美元

IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，BlueTwelve Studio 工作室旗下赛博猫咪游戏《迷失（Stray）》实体版现已正式登陆任天堂 Switch 2 平台，定价为 29.99 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 200.5 元人民币） 。游戏支持 4K 60 帧运行，同时适配了 Switch 2 Joy-Con 手柄的鼠标操作模式。

 

《迷失》是一款以猫为主角的第三人称冒险游戏，由 BlueTwelve Studio 开发、Annapurna Interactive 发行。值得一提的是，本作还获得了 2022 年 TGA 最佳独立游戏奖项。

故事发生在一座日渐衰败的赛博城市，这里有着刻画细致的霓虹闪烁的小巷，以及脏乱阴暗的下层环境。在高高低低的环境中流浪，抵御无法预见的威胁，探索这个只有平凡的机器人和危险生物的冷漠之地，并设法解开这里的谜团。

articles.title: 台灣人氣IP鴨梨子首次快閃咖啡廳12月19日開跑！聯名餐點與咖啡廳首發全新商品可愛登場
articles.excerpt:
人氣 IP 鴨梨子由台灣插畫家 C4 老師創作，以悠閒療癒的故事，治癒你焦慮的內心！C4 老師筆下的「鴨梨子」與「小鴨鴨」以可愛的筆觸，持續在社群上累積人氣，包括 LINE 貼圖、聯名商品都見得到他們的身影，更即將於今年首次舉辦快閃咖啡廳！12 月 19 日（六）至 12 月 27（日）期間，「鴨梨子的午茶派對」於 LEIBLE COFFEE 邀請你蒞臨，一同享受悠閒的午後時光！

 

　　現場除了特別的午茶時光布置之外，亦同步販售「鴨梨子的午茶派對」全新獨家繪製周邊，及特別合作餐飲，只要購買合作餐飲即贈送紙杯墊、感謝卡等贈品，消費滿 499 元即贈送限量紙袋。（以上贈品送完為止）此外，快閃咖啡廳將於 12 月 25 日舉辦「(•ө•) 鴨梨子的午茶派對 DUCK-C4 CAFE (•ө•) ～與 C4 的午茶時光～」特別活動，預約 12 月 25 日指定時段者，將有機會參與 C4 老師的現場簽繪活動，喜愛鴨梨子的你千萬別錯過！

　　【活動資訊】

 

活動地點：LEIBLE COFFEE（臺北市士林區福德里文林路294號）

活動日期：12/19（六）~12/27（日）每日11:00~19:00

入場方式：免費，假日入場須預約 KKTIX 指定時段

預約時間：11/16（一）12:00（GMT+8）開放預約

預約網址：https://twkadokawa.kktix.cc/events/duckc4

特別活動「與C4的午茶時光」：12月25日11:00~16:40，預約活動指定時段，即可參與

官方社群： Facebook 、 instagram 

 

　　

(•ө•) 全新獨家繪製周邊 (•ө•)

　　本次以「午茶派對」作為主題，全新繪製並製作獨家周邊商品，讓可愛的鴨梨子與小鴨鴨，陪你度過悠閒的午後時光！現場亦有過去出版的書籍，歡迎一次入手！

 

 

 

 

 

　　▌午茶好朋友！10cm 吊飾娃（售價 NT$460，約 10×10×8cm）
　　▌午睡睡飽飽！60cm 擺飾（售價 NT$799，約 60×14×11cm）
　　▌辦公好夥伴！5cm 兩用公仔盲盒（售價 NT$360，約 5×5×5cm）
　　▌可愛帶著走！盲抽徽章（售價 NT$110，約 4.4×4.4cm）
　　▌一起吃午餐！餐具組（售價 NT$250，外盒：3×24.6×6，含湯匙及筷子）
　　▌幫你收東西！迷你錢包（售價 NT$450，約 10.5×8×3cm）

　　★滿額贈禮★

 

來店消費即贈聖誕卡乙張。

滿額499元即贈限定紙袋（共兩款隨機，單筆消費可累贈）

滿額2,000元即可獲得抽獎券（可累計），將於活動結束後抽出獲獎者，可獲得快閃店展示之無框畫，或鴨梨子、小鴨鴨擺飾。

贈品數量有限，贈完為止。

 

　　【物販商品注意事項】

 

盲抽商品款式隨機，現場恕不接受拆開挑選或退換貨。

商品設有購買數量限制。另外，限購規定亦有可能在無預先通知的情況下解除。

商品發售時間、規格等，可能因諸般不可抗力因素而有所變更、延期或中止。

 

(•ө•) Duck-C4 CAFE 特別甜點 (•ө•)

　　鴨梨子與小鴨鴨變成甜點啦！與 LEIBLE COFFEE 合作，製作以鴨梨子為主題的特別餐點，好吃又可愛！

 

　　★餐點贈禮★

 

購買本次合作飲品即贈新繪圖紙杯墊乙張。

購買本次合作甜點套餐即贈感謝卡、紙餐墊及蛋糕插卡乙張。

贈品數量有限，贈完為止。

 

 

(•ө•) 鴨梨子的午茶派對 DUCK-C4 CAFE (•ө•) ～與 C4 的午茶時光～ 特別活動(•ө•)

活動時間｜12/25（五）11:00~16:40
報名方式：於12/25限定三場活動時段預約者，可享有與C4老師現場簽繪及互動交流的機會。

特別活動時段：11:00～12:40
　　　　　　　13:00～14:40
　　　　　　　15:00～16:40

 

現場互動簽繪採預約時段現場報名制，請於點餐後【主動告知簽繪意願】，並索取簽繪號碼牌。

活動將依照號碼牌順序進行，請留意現場叫號，並攜號碼牌至簽繪區報到，若過號請主動告知現場工作人員，並依工作人員指示進行活動安排。

憑號碼牌簽繪後，將由工作人員回收號碼牌，不接受任何形式的取回。

簽繪限簽乙項物品。除咖啡廳合作商品、贈品、餐墊外，亦可自行準備鴨梨子書籍或周邊簽繪物。

現場接受A4尺寸內卡片（請以信封包裝）、包裝完整之食品、禮物等。

因考慮簽名當天之天候、身體狀況或突發事件等，若簽繪辦法臨時有所變更時，以活動現場公告為準。

 

(•ө•) 入場規則及消費方式 (•ө•)

　　為維護活動品質與舒適體驗，請詳閱活動辦法及入場規則。本次活動將於週末&國定假日採「 KKTIX 線上預約制 」，其餘平日期間開放現場候位&自由入場。

 

線上預約開放｜11/16（一）12:00（GMT+8）

預約場次：12/19(六)、12/20(日)、12/25(五)、12/26(六)、12/27(日)

預約時段：11:00~12:40、13:00~14:40、15:00~16:40、17:00~18:40

預約人須完成KKTIX會員登入，並於入場時出示指定時段QRcode，進行核銷後即可入場，核銷及入場順序依照到場順序。

最晚須於該預約時段開始後10分鐘內入場報到，若超過時間不予進場，亦無法跨時段核銷預約票券入場。例：預約11:00者須於11:10前到場。

入場時依入場人數核銷電子票券，一人一券入場。

特別場次：「(•ө•) 鴨梨子的午茶派對 DUCK-C4 CAFE (•ө•) ～與C4的午茶時光～」，若想參加本特別場次活動之讀者，歡迎預約12/25（五）11:00~16:40區間之場次，活動詳情請見特別場次說明 。

因現場桌數有限，可能需配合併桌調整，請依照店內人員指示入座。

入店後須遵守店內低消規則，內用或外帶（限平日開放）皆須購買店內任一甜點（不限本次合作餐點），方可購買本次鴨梨子合作商品。

平日（非預約時段）不限制店內用餐，亦可外帶。惟外帶時，部分限定餐點無可食用裝飾物，但仍包含餐點所附之合作插卡及杯墊等贈品，數量有限，送完為止。

週末&假日（預約時段）恕不提供外帶或非預約者購買商品，敬請見諒。

單次入場僅可購買一次鴨梨子合作商品。預約時段入座時將提供購買號碼牌，現場憑號碼牌結帳。非預約時段時，合作商品需與餐點一併結帳。

本次合作咖啡廳含合作商品僅接受現金支付，恕不提供其他結帳方式。

 

　　※活動資訊與即時異動，以 @tw.kadokawabooks 官方帳號及現場公告為準。主辦單位保留修改、暫停、終止及最終解釋活動內容之權利。

articles.excerpt:
IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，任天堂宣布旗下《皮克敏 4：Switch 2 版》现已正式上市，该版本附带“ 大家来挑战 当多虑学院”模式，以 eShop 港服为例，本作定价为 379 港币（IT之家注：现汇率约合 323 元人民币） 。

 

玩家可以使用语音指令和欧奇对话、指挥它行动。游戏新增“当多虑学院”模式，玩家需要争分夺秒，在时限结束前完成寻宝任务。该模式主打高分挑战，提供三种难度选项，每周五、周六、周日还会开启周挑战。

 

IT之家注意到，口碑出色的《皮克敏 4》最初于 2023 年 7 月登陆初代 Switch 平台，收获了玩家与媒体的一致好评。尽管本作销量相比系列前作表现亮眼（尤其在日本，《皮克敏 4》首发销量超过系列前三部作品首发销量总和），但游戏发售之后从未推出过任何追加内容。

articles.title: 別怕踩雷，怕你被萌翻！《彩地雷》聯手動畫《我的祕密好友，HECHI》開啟首爾奇幻之旅
articles.excerpt:
以首爾市官方吉祥物「HECHI」為主角的人氣電視動畫《我的祕密好友，HECHI（My Secret Friend Hechi）》，正式迎來全球首度遊戲跨界聯名！本次企劃主打與 HECHI 一同暢遊首爾各大知名景點，主題賽季「與 HECHI 一起展開首爾秘密之旅」即日起登場，活動將持續至 12 月 17 日。

 

 

　　本次聯名將動畫中的首爾之旅融入《彩地雷》的貼紙收集與美術館佈置玩法。玩家可於活動期間透過解開謎題，收集以 N 首爾塔、DDP 及景福宮等首爾知名景點、辣炒年糕、泡菜及韓式飯捲等韓國代表美食，以及 HECHI 為主題的 8 款貼紙，打造專屬於自己的美術館。集齊所有貼紙後，還可額外獲得 2 款「貼紙底圖」。

 

　　此外，遊戲也推出根據任務完成進度提供特別獎勵的活動。玩家於賽季期間完成指定任務，即可獲得「HECHI 特別貼紙」、「HECHI 限定調色盤」及「個人檔案邊框」等獎勵。限定調色盤收錄象徵 HECHI 的四種代表色，以及身穿 HECHI 造型服裝的「彩地雷王」角色。此外，遊戲還加入專屬背景美術，以及完成關卡時登場的 HECHI 動畫演出，進一步增添遊戲樂趣。

 

 

　　《我的祕密好友，HECHI》是由首爾市、ICONIX 與 EBS 共同製作的動畫作品，描述首爾市代表吉祥物「HECHI」來到首爾後，與小學生允浩攜手展開冒險的故事；《彩地雷》是一款透過解讀數字與顏色線索，逐步填滿方格的手機邏輯益智遊戲。玩家無需依賴運氣猜測，只需運用邏輯推理即可解開謎題，享受思考與解謎的樂趣。

articles.title: BetFury Introduces Turbo Bet: Up to 100,000 Bets in a Single Session Across Its Original Games
articles.excerpt:
[PRESS RELEASE – Willemstad, Curaçao, November 12th, 2026] BetFury, a leading crypto casino, is introducing Turbo Bet, a high-speed mode for its Original games. It lets a player place from 100 to 100 000 bets in one session. Instead of betting one at a time, the player sets everything up once and starts the whole […]

[PRESS RELEASE – Willemstad, Curaçao, November 12th, 2026] 

 BetFury , a leading crypto casino, is introducing Turbo Bet, a high-speed mode for its Original games. It lets a player place from 100 to 100 000 bets in one session. Instead of betting one at a time, the player sets everything up once and starts the whole batch with a single click. Turbo Bet arrived first on Keno, then across the rest of BetFury’s Original games: Dice, Space Dice, and Limbo. These Originals are some of the most-played games on the platform, with high RTP (up to 99.28%) and built-in strategies.

 What Turbo Bet Does 

Turbo Bet is a batch-betting mode. The player sets a stake, picks how many rounds to run, adjusts the game’s settings, and starts the whole batch at once. The full cost (the stake times the number of bets) is taken up front, and the rounds then play out one after another while an on-screen bar tracks the progress. For the player, it turns what would be hundreds or thousands of separate clicks into a single action, while keeping the same control over stake and settings as a one-off bet.

 Built Into the Original Games 

Turbo Bet sits next to the Manual, Auto, and Strategies modes inside each game, so it is one tap away, not a separate product. The first time a player opens it, a short onboarding screen explains how it works. The number of rounds is always capped by the balance: a player cannot start a session larger than the current balance can cover, so every batch stays within budget. Turbo Bet runs on the real balance, and each bet counts toward Battles, the same as a Manual or Auto bet.

 Transparency on Every Bet 

Speed does not cost visibility. When a batch finishes, Turbo Bet shows a full round summary, and the player can open a detailed report for any bet in the run. Every round has its own outcome and hash, so all of them stay provably fair and verifiable, just like a single manual bet. Results can also be shared through the built-in Share & Win option.

 Who It Is For 

Turbo Bet suits players who treat Original games as a numbers exercise: those testing a strategy who want a large sample from one run, and anyone who would rather set the parameters once than click through hundreds of identical bets. It takes the speed and control of BetFury’s Originals and scales them past what manual play can reach.

 
“Our Original games already give players speed and control, and Turbo Bet takes both further,” said the CPO of BetFury. “Some players want to run a strategy across thousands of rounds, not ten, and that used to mean sitting through every click. Turbo Bet does it in one action, with every bet still provably fair. It is a power-user tool, built from how people already play our Originals.”

 About BetFury 

Established in 2019, BetFury is a leading crypto casino with over 3.5M registered players and $11.5B in lifetime wagering volume. The platform offers over 13,000 games, including 24 Original games with an RTP of up to 99.28%, and 80+ sports for betting with highly competitive market odds. Beyond gaming, BetFury provides a full suite of advanced crypto utilities, including Crypto Staking with up to 60% APR, Futures, and Crypto Swap. Moreover, the platform features proprietary BFG Staking, enabling users to hold native tokens to earn daily passive payouts in either BFG or USDT. BetFury continuously evolves based on user feedback and remains deeply committed to responsible gambling practices.

The post BetFury Introduces Turbo Bet: Up to 100,000 Bets in a Single Session Across Its Original Games appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: Arf and Ripple Bring RLUSD Settlement Liquidity to XRPL
articles.excerpt:
Swiss-regulated Arf will supply short-duration working capital in RLUSD to licensed cross-border payment firms settling on the XRP Ledger.

The post Arf and Ripple Bring RLUSD Settlement Liquidity to XRPL appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Arf , a Swiss-regulated financial institution headquartered in Zug, has partnered with Ripple to deliver stablecoin-denominated settlement liquidity to licensed cross-border payment companies operating on the XRP Ledger (XRPL). The arrangement uses Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin as the working capital instrument and targets a structural problem that has dogged the cross-border payments industry for years: the timing mismatch between when a payment company must fund a transaction and when the underlying settlement actually arrives. 

Arf reported that it has scaled to roughly $10 billion in annual global settlement volume since launching in November 2022, with capital turning over approximately four times a month. That velocity matters commercially: short-duration, high-turnover liquidity looks very different on a balance sheet and in a regulatory capital calculation than a traditional revolving credit line, which can take months to establish and typically demands collateral pledged in a single jurisdiction. For payment companies whose working capital needs to move across markets in step with payment flows, that mismatch is the core operational constraint the partnership is designed to address.

 How the facility works 

 Ali Erhat Nalbant, co-founder and CEO at Arf 

In the first phase, Arf will provide RLUSD liquidity directly on XRPL. Drawdowns are expected to be repaid within one to five business days as cross-border payments settle, allowing the same pool of capital to be recycled repeatedly against live payment flows. Arf retains underwriting and working capital decisions offchain, while XRPL provides the settlement rail.

A second phase is contingent on XRPL’s native lending infrastructure becoming operational. Once available, Arf says it intends to migrate more of its liquidity activity onto the protocol itself, enabling onchain capital management alongside its existing regulated treasury functions. No timeline for that infrastructure milestone was disclosed in the announcement.

 Ali Erhat Nalbant , co-founder and chief executive of Arf, said the company is “meeting that need at scale, with $10 billion in annual settlement volume and capital turning over four times a month,” adding that the Ripple partnership is designed to help payment companies “bridge that gap and support more payment volume.”

 Market and regulatory context 

The announcement sits within the broader PayFi category, a term used to describe financial products structured around real-time payment flows and the time value of money, spanning settlement liquidity, receivables financing and fiat-to-stablecoin treasury management. Arf and Huma Finance are credited with coining the category; the partnership with Ripple extends Arf’s regulated infrastructure into a public blockchain environment.

RLUSD, Ripple’s dollar stablecoin, launched in late 2024 and is positioned as a regulated instrument for institutional settlement use cases rather than retail trading. Stablecoins used in payment settlement are increasingly subject to regulatory attention on both sides of the Atlantic. In the EU, the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation covers asset-referenced and e-money tokens with specific capital and reserve requirements; in the UK, the Payment and Electronic Money Institution Regulations and the FCA ‘s evolving stablecoin framework will shape how arrangements of this kind are treated domestically. Arf’s Swiss regulatory status under VQF membership provides a foundation for cross-border operation, though each market in which its liquidity is deployed will carry its own licensing considerations.

For payment operators evaluating the proposition, the key variables are the cost of RLUSD-denominated liquidity relative to existing bank credit, the jurisdictional reach of the facility, and the operational risk profile of a settlement rail that is partly onchain. The transition to native XRPL lending infrastructure, when it arrives, will shift some of that risk profile further onto the protocol layer and will be the more consequential development to watch.

The post Arf and Ripple Bring RLUSD Settlement Liquidity to XRPL appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: NEXON黑暗奇幻MMORPG《Embers of the Uncrowned》，12/4起展開Steam全球測試，即日開放事前報名
articles.excerpt:
NEXON 於 11 月 12 日正式宣布，黑暗奇幻 MMORPG 《Embers of the Uncrowned》將於 12 月 4 日展開 Steam 全球測試，即日起開放至商店頁面報名。測試期間，玩家可體驗 4 大區域主線劇情和 4 種職業，同時公開前導預告片，搶先感受本作獨特的世界觀。　　

 

　　《Embers of the Uncrowned》是一款結合黑暗奇幻敘事與動作玩法的 MMORPG，目前針對 PC 平台進行最佳化開發中。遊戲以強烈且生動的演出呈現俯視角（Quarter View）動作戰鬥，帶來爽快的戰鬥體驗；同時加入玩家成為家族領主、親自經營領地的模擬經營要素，帶來與眾不同的成長樂趣。

 

 

 

　　全球測試將於台灣時間 12 月 4 日至 11 日透過 Steam 進行，只要在 Steam 商店頁面報名即可參加。繼今年 6 月 Steam 新品節（Steam Next Fest）試玩版擠進「最多人遊玩的試玩版」前 10 名之後，本次測試開放「暴風術士」、「處刑官」、「幻影劍士」、「暗夜追蹤者」等 4 種職業，展現多樣化的戰鬥風格。玩家可隨著在 4 大主要區域展開的主線劇情培養角色，感受《Embers of the Uncrowned》獨有的深度敘事；同時，也能運用輔助戰鬥的「助戰者」系統，享受更具策略性的動作戰鬥。而家族越壯大、角色也會隨之變強的成長架構，同樣可在本次測試中親身體驗。

 

　　此外，遊戲也將推出各 2 種的團隊副本與競技場，讓玩家可透過團隊副本挑戰強大首領，也可透過競技場彼此之間一較高下。另有「軍團入侵」、「乙太淨化戰」等在野外展開的大規模內容，以及小規模隊伍內容「暗影裂縫」，提供豐富多元的戰鬥玩法。

 

　　本次同步公開的前導預告片中，將可一窺遭「精靈」佔領而淪為廢墟的世界，瀰漫著黑暗沉重的氛圍，片中更有神秘人物登場，暗示著接下來的劇情發展。

articles.title: Exodus Q3 營收增 7% 卻轉虧 830 萬美元，股價今年跌 7 成
articles.excerpt:
錢包與支付平台 Exodus 公布 2026 年第三季財報，營收年增 7% 至 3,250 萬美元，淨利卻由去 […]

〈 Exodus Q3 營收增 7% 卻轉虧 830 萬美元，股價今年跌 7 成 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

錢包與支付平台 Exodus 公布 2026 年第三季財報，營收年增 7% 至 3,250 萬美元，淨利卻由去年同期 1,700 萬美元盈餘轉為虧損 830 萬美元，一般及行政費用年增 94% 是最大破口。 （前情提要：比特幣錢包Exodus將在美交所上市、美國首例完成股票代幣化於鏈上交易） （背景補充：Coinbase、Circle、Robinhood 財報出爐！新業務撐住營收，獲利仍看幣價） 錢包與支付平台 Exodus Movement（NYSE American：EXOD）公布 2026 年第三季財報，截至 9 月 30 日的三個月營收為 3,250 萬美元、年增 7%，但獲利由盈轉虧：歸屬母公司的淨利從去年同期 1,700 萬美元變成虧損 830 萬美元，調整後 EBITDA 也從正 590 萬美元掉到負 390 萬美元。公司在財報宣告中把這一季定調為「把 Exodus、Monavate 與 Baanx 整合在一起、簡化營運方式」的一季。 把損益表拆開看，虧損的來源相當集中。營收端只小增 7%，費用端卻明顯膨脹：一般及行政費用從 1,490 萬美元跳到 2,890 萬美元、年增 94%，是本季最大的一筆變動；支付處理費用首度獨立列帳，金額 950 萬美元；與交易、整合及重組相關的費用合計約 910 萬美元，去年同期這個科目只有 130 萬美元。數位資產評價利益也從去年的 2,100 萬美元縮水到 1,140 萬美元，等於少了一塊近 960 萬美元的帳面支撐。另一方面，合作夥伴費用從 460 萬美元降到 310 萬美元、年減 32%，數位資產服務費用則持平在 1,250 萬美元上下。 營運指標呈現的是另一種風景。第三季月活躍使用者 140 萬人，與第二季持平、沒有再成長；季度付費使用者（Funded Users）140 萬人、季增 7.7%，優於前一季的 130 萬人；活躍卡片數 160 萬張，總交易處理量（GTV）與代幣交換量雙雙站上 11 億美元，但交換量較第二季下滑 3.4%。換句話說，Exodus 把使用者留在卡片與支付這一側，卻還沒把量能轉成利潤。 Exodus 2026 年第三季財報關鍵數字，營收小增但行政費用幾近翻倍（動區自繪） 資本市場的反應同樣分歧。財報出爐前的 11 月 9 日交易日，EXOD 收在 4.48 美元、單日上漲 10.07%，但把時間拉長，股價近五個交易日仍下跌 8.57%，2026 年年初至今跌幅達 70.21%（那斯達克報價）。一檔營收還在成長的加密概念股，被市場用七成的跌幅對待，反映的是投資人對「錢包本業成長停滯、新業務還在燒錢」這個組合的耐心有限。 公司的擴張路線倒是一直往前推。Exodus 6 月與 Ondo Finance 合作推出 Exodus Markets，讓符合資格的使用者在 Solana 上的錢包裡直接接觸超過 200 檔代幣化股票、ETF 與其他資產；企業端的 XO Suite 平台也在建置中。執行長 JP Richardson 在宣告中說，Exodus 一開始是讓人們掌控自己的加密資產，接下來要透過錢包與企業平台把這套基礎延伸到日常金融活動，並直言「當 AI 代理開始替人與企業交易，它們需要同樣的基礎設施，具備清楚的許可權與支出上限」。公司在 X 上的說法則把第三季形容為「整合組織、恢復部分支付能力、收斂產品路線」的一季。 成本面則給了比較明確的數字。Exodus 表示，隨著整合 Monavate Holdings Limited、Monavate Ltd.、Baanx.com Ltd 與 Baanx US Corp 四家公司，公司正朝 2027 年合併年度成本縮減約 3,000 萬美元的目標前進；這個數字的野心比原先設定的 1,000 萬至 1,300 萬美元明顯加碼。管理層的說法是，成本縮減能提高營運槓桿，讓資源重新投進產品創新與新市場。 營收成長為何換不到利潤 把這一季和同期其他加密上市公司的財報放在一起看，Exodus 的處境更清楚。Coinbase、Circle 與 Robinhood 在 11 月初公布的第三季數字，也是「新業務撐住營收、獲利仍看幣價」的格局，但它們的營收基數大得多，支付與代幣化只是加分項；Exodus 的營收只有 3,250 萬美元，卻同時要負擔支付處理、發卡與整合成本，任何一筆費用擴張都會直接吃掉利潤。這也是為什麼一般及行政費用年增 94% 會如此致命：它相當於把整季營收的九成再花一遍。 更值得注意的是獲利結構的質變。去年同期的 1,700 萬美元淨利，其中有 2,100 萬美元來自數位資產評價利益，本業貢獻有限；今年這塊只剩 1,140 萬美元，公司又同時認列 950 萬美元的支付處理費用與約 910 萬美元的交易、整合、重組費用。也就是說，帳面虧損裡有一部分是一次性的整併成本，但支付業務的低抽成與本業成長停滯是結構問題，不會隨整合結束自動消失。 後續觀察 第一個觀察點在支付這條線能不能自己養活自己。160 萬張活躍卡片與 11 億美元的 GTV 目前帶來的是處理成本，而不是利潤，第四季該看的是支付處理費用能否隨規模放大而攤薄，以及代幣交換量能否止住季減 3.4% 的走勢、月活躍使用者能否重回成長；若使用者指標繼續原地踏步，3,000 萬美元的成本縮減就只是止血，而不是轉機。 第二個觀察點是錢包業者的競爭座標。同一時間，三星錢包已把 USDC 帳戶直接放進 8,200 萬支手機，代幣化股票這條賽道也擠進交易所與傳統金融業者的合資平台，自託管錢包正從單純的保管工具，變成支付與鏈上資產的入口。Exodus 的優勢是同時握有錢包與卡片兩端，劣勢是兩端都還在燒錢；接下來的幾季會決定，市場究竟把它當成一檔還在轉型的支付股，或是一檔已經失去成長故事的錢包股。 相關報導 Ondo 將在 9/3 開啟Ondo Global Markets，先上架百檔代幣化股票 ARK DeFi 季報：代幣化股票 DEX 量約...〈Exodus Q3 營收增 7% 卻轉虧 830 萬美元，股價今年跌 7 成〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 回憶再啟！《楓之谷M》x《天翼之鍊》限時聯名合作，限定角色波里斯與劇情地城登場
articles.excerpt:
Nexon 旗下人氣 MMORPG《楓之谷M》於 11 月 12 日宣布，與經典 RPG 作品《天翼之鍊》（英文名稱：TalesWeaver）的限時合作正式展開，帶來可親自操作的聯動角色「波里斯·貞奈曼」、以波里斯經歷為主軸的劇情地城，以及 1+2 狂熱燃燒等多項內容；同時推出豐富的聯名活動和道具外觀，邀請冒險家與熟悉的角色重逢，展開全新旅程。

 

 

 

兩個世界的經典交會，聯動角色「波里斯」與原作劇情地城登場

　　《天翼之鍊》（TalesWeaver）是由 Softmax 與 Nexon 共同開發的動作 RPG 線上遊戲，以龐大的世界觀、章節式劇情、鮮明角色與動人音樂所構築的奇幻世界，深受無數玩家喜愛。即日起至 12 月 10 日，原作角色與經典篇章跨越世界來到《楓之谷M》，無論是否接觸過《天翼之鍊》都能親自體驗參與。

 

　　本次聯動亮點之一為可操作角色「波里斯·貞奈曼」限時推出，於活動期間將可創建波里斯，以劍士類型角色展開遊玩。身為冬霜劍的契約者，波里斯使用雙手劍作為主武器，施展「凍結斬」、「冰河結晶斬」、「殘影劍式」等獨具特色的戰鬥技能，在裝備冬霜劍時更可使用專用演出技能「冰結瞬殺」，展現征服戰場的魄力。活動結束時，達成 220 級以上的波里斯將可永久變更為英雄職業，且將直接繼承裝備，延續在楓之谷的冒險。

　　

 

　　聯名劇情地城以「波里斯的記憶」為主軸，帶領冒險家重訪原作 Episode 1 的經典篇章，從哥哥葉普奈恩手中繼承了劍的少年波里斯，擔任一心嚮往成為冒險家的好友路西安的護衛，一同踏上旅途。在旅途中，他們將與熟悉的角色們相遇，故事也隨之展開，令人懷念的彩蛋雞王、安皮里爾和黑衣劍士也將於 Boss 戰中登場。全新劇情副本開放 100 級以上角色入場，共 8 個地城每日依序開放，首次通關各地城時將獲得經驗值與活動硬幣。

 

 

 

　　除此之外，一系列聯名活動也將逐週開放，「路西安的陶笛練習」為根據畫面輸入對應指令的迷你遊戲，完成後即可獲得對應硬幣；「皮林夢境的世界」開放冒險家前往夢境的世界擊敗彩蛋雞王，依分數獲得不同等級的約束之石 Buff；「黑霧島尋寶」則是本次全新的迷你遊戲類型，透過觸碰踏板尋找寶箱，根據完成階段領取活動硬幣。使用活動硬幣可在活動商店兌換多項獎勵道具。

 

　　本次聯名合作亦推出角色外型、傷害外型、坐騎、椅子、寵物及聊天框等多款主題內容，將《天翼之鍊》的經典元素融入日常裝扮與互動。各項道具名稱、推出方式及取得期間等詳細資訊，請至官網公告查詢。

 

 

1+2狂熱燃燒與多重成長支援，幫助角色快速養成

　　在重溫記憶中的冒險同時，本次也推出「1+2」狂熱燃燒活動，可設定波里斯為燃燒角色，至 220 級為止每升 1 級將額外提升 2 級，且在完成波里斯轉職活動後將獲得全新的「狂熱燃燒加速器」，持續 1+2 狂熱加成到 250 級，體驗全新聯名內容時也能輕鬆養成角色。此外，與波里斯一起成長和等級達成通關活動亦同步推出，達成指定等級即可解鎖豐富獎勵。

articles.title: 台積電 4.6 萬員工個資 3 枚比特幣暗網兜售，官方認外洩，但強調系統沒被入侵
articles.excerpt:
駭客在地下論壇宣稱握有 4.6 萬筆台積電員工個資，開價 3 枚比特幣。台積電證實部分員工資料外流，但沒有證據 […]

〈 台積電 4.6 萬員工個資 3 枚比特幣暗網兜售，官方認外洩，但強調系統沒被入侵 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

駭客在地下論壇宣稱握有 4.6 萬筆台積電員工個資，開價 3 枚比特幣。台積電證實部分員工資料外流，但沒有證據顯示自家系統遭入侵。 （前情提要：易遊網 69 萬人個資遭駭外流，接到「訂單異常」電話先別信） （背景補充：永豐董事長道歉！解釋「盜轉案」是駭客利用供應商系統入侵） 台積電的說法是：員工資料確實流出去了，但目前看不出是從它自己的系統流出去的。外流的人包括在職和已離職員工，台積電比對後發現，內容跟一家雲端業者服務裡存放的資料一致；同時強調晶圓生產和客戶資料不在這批資料裡。 台積電 12 日中午過後發出完整回應，把重點講明：「目前並無證據顯示台積公司系統遭到入侵」，受影響的人員已陸續收到通知。 駭客宣稱握有什麼？哪些是台積電認的？ 事情從兩個地下論壇開始。DarkForums 與 BreachForums 上有人貼文點名台積電，宣稱手上有 4.6 萬筆員工紀錄、共 6.9GB，3 枚比特幣起標，一週內沒人買就全部公開。以 12 日下午幣價計算，3 枚比特幣約新台幣 726 萬元（約 22 萬美元）。 賣家為了證明貨真價實，附上檔名 tsmc.txt 的樣本：499 筆，每筆 19 個欄位。照賣家的說法，從姓名、身分證字號、銀行資訊，到住址、手機、電子郵件、生日、職稱與國籍都有，連緊急聯絡人的電話和住址也一併列入。 不過要分開看的是：以上都是駭客的說法。台積電承認的只有「部分」員工資料外流，4.6 萬筆是否屬實、樣本是否完整，目前沒有人獨立核實。受影響人數、是哪家雲端供應商、資料怎麼流出去，台積電也都還沒公布。 這些資料拿去能做什麼，員工和家人要防什麼？ 資安專家評估，姓名、職稱加上公司名稱，足以假冒人資、主管或行政單位發通知；手機和電子郵件湊在一起，則能發釣魚信或假的帳號驗證。至於身分證字號和銀行資訊，對應的是身分冒用與金融詐騙。 其中最難防的是緊急聯絡人欄位。詐騙者不必騙員工本人，可以直接假冒公司人資打給家屬，說員工出事了，或用 AI 深偽冒充員工本人向家人要錢。實際的做法很簡單：接到自稱台積電人資、說員工出事的電話，先掛掉，再自己打給本人或公司確認。 資料也不見得馬上被用，專家提醒，可能在地下市場轉手、比對，數月後才有人拿來行騙。 為什麼又是供應商出事？ 這不是台積電第一次碰到這種局面。2023 年 6 月，勒索軟體集團 LockBit 把台積電列上暗網洩密網站，開價 7,000 萬美元，實際被駭的是新竹的 IT 服務供應商擎昊科技（Kinmax），外流的主要是伺服器初始設定與組態資訊。台積電當時說沒有客戶資料外洩，並中止與該供應商的資料交換。 相同點很清楚：兩次台積電都說不是自己的系統，問題出在外部廠商。台灣近期的永豐銀行盜轉案也是同一套說法，董事長道歉時表示，駭客是利用供應商系統入侵。 綜合來看，台積電把晶圓廠和客戶資料守住了，這點目前沒有反證。但員工資料放在別人的系統裡，這一層它沒辦法直接管，只能靠合約和稽核去約束。如果雲端供應商最後被證實就是源頭，這就是供應鏈管理的問題，而不是晶圓廠防線的問題；但反過來，若發現資料確實另有流出管道，那官方內部資安就要緊張了。 相關報導 Coinbase 否認遭駭！客戶聯絡資料外洩源頭指向 Amplitude 蘋果20萬份機密外洩》包括 iPhone 18 Pro 未發表零件圖、機密供應商清單.. MyCard 用戶疑集體遭駭！智冠：調查中 鏈上分析公司 Chainalysis 也爆資安事件：客戶全名、郵件地址等個資外洩 幣安闢謠！否認1280萬客戶個資外洩暗網，謹防釣魚詐騙〈台積電 4.6 萬員工個資 3 枚比特幣暗網兜售，官方認外洩，但強調系統沒被入侵〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 騰訊推出玩家專屬陪伴AI「鵝次元」 可辨識遊戲畫面即時給意見
articles.excerpt:
騰訊（Tencent）推出首款專為遊戲場景打造的 AI 陪伴 Agent「鵝次元」，能即時辨識遊戲畫面，讓 AI 角色依照玩家當下的遊戲狀況提供建議，並以語音與玩家聊天，玩家能將鵝次元設定為桌面寵物，或使用符合角色造型的桌布。「鵝次元」已於 2026 年 11 月 10 日在中國開放內測，尚未公布全球推出時間。

騰訊（Tencent）推出首款專為遊戲場景打造的 AI 陪伴 Agent「鵝次元」，能即時辨識遊戲畫面，讓 AI 角色依照玩家當下的遊戲狀況提供建議，並以語音與玩家聊天，玩家能將鵝次元設定為桌面寵物，或使用符合角色造型的桌布。「鵝次元」已於 2026 年 11 月 10 日在中國開放內測，尚未公布全球推出時間。

 

 

 

「鵝次元」是一款面向 PC 玩家推出的 AI 陪伴工具，主要特色在於能夠辨識玩家目前的遊戲畫面，並根據畫面內容回應問題、提供遊戲建議，遊玩遇到困難時可直接向 AI 角色提問，藉由即時語音互動取得協助。

 

 

 

 

目前玩家可從 4 名 AI 角色中選擇喜歡的外觀與個性 MBTI，擅長的遊戲包括《特戰英豪》、《英雄聯盟》與《反恐精英》等，外觀的部分都是身材比例高挑的美少女，年齡介於 19～24 歲，身高 162～180 不等，穿衣風格各有特色。

 

 

 

 

除了遊戲中的即時陪伴，玩家也能透過手機版 App 繼續與 AI 角色聊天，話題不必侷限於遊戲內容。官方介紹，「鵝次元」目前具備 PC 與手機 QQ 的陪伴聊天功能，後續還預計加入變聲，以及讓 AI 角色代替玩家發言的「嘴替」功能。

 

若相關功能正式推出，玩家將能讓 AI 角色以指定聲音或身分代為回應，進一步擴展陪伴工具的使用情境。

articles.title: Aldar and ADIB Launch Co-Branded Darna Covered Cards in Abu Dhabi
articles.excerpt:
Aldar and ADIB have launched two Visa co-branded cards tied to the Darna loyalty programme, offering up to 10% back on retail and hospitality

The post Aldar and ADIB Launch Co-Branded Darna Covered Cards in Abu Dhabi appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Aldar Properties and Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) have jointly launched a pair of co-branded covered cards linked to Aldar’s Darna digital loyalty programme, deepening the intersection of property, retail and Islamic banking in Abu Dhabi’s consumer market. 

The two products, the ADIB Aldar Visa Infinite and the ADIB Aldar Visa Platinum Covered Cards, were issued on 21 October 2026. Both sit inside the Live Aldar app ecosystem, allowing cardholders to earn, track and redeem Darna Points across Aldar’s retail, hospitality, education and residential portfolio.

 The product structure 

The reward tiers are graduated. Cardholders earn up to 10% value back in Darna Points on eligible spending at participating Aldar malls, hotels, golf courses, restaurants and entertainment venues. Spending on Aldar property purchases and Aldar Education attracts up to 1.5%, while eligible international transactions earn up to 2%. Welcome bonuses of up to 20,000 Darna Points, equivalent to AED 1,000, are offered on sign-up, subject to card tier and qualifying conditions.

Additional benefits include complimentary Darna Gold or Platinum status depending on tier, access to more than 1,000 airport lounges worldwide, complimentary valet parking up to four times per month at selected UAE locations, and an annual fee waiver from the second year onwards for cardholders who meet defined spend thresholds: AED 30,000 in foreign currency or AED 75,000 in total transactions.

 Faisal Falaknaz , group chief financial and sustainability officer at Aldar, said the partnership extends rewards to eligible property spend, “creating meaningful value around one of our customers’ most significant purchases.” Amit Malhotra , global head of retail banking at ADIB, framed the proposition as embedding banking more deeply into customers’ daily lives beyond traditional service relationships.

The cards are Sharia-compliant covered structures rather than conventional credit products, consistent with ADIB’s Islamic banking model. ADIB reported total assets of AED 304 billion as of June 2026, giving the partnership institutional weight within the UAE’s Islamic finance sector.

 Market context and regulatory landscape 

The co-branded card space in the Gulf has grown steadily as banks seek to deepen primary-account relationships and retailers look to translate loyalty programmes into payment data. The Aldar-ADIB structure is notable for spanning property purchasing alongside everyday retail, a combination that is less common than pure lifestyle or travel reward cards. Rewarding property transactions at the card level blurs the boundary between mortgage product and payment card, a wrinkle that sits within the DFSA and CBUAE regulatory perimeter for consumer credit and Islamic finance structures.

Visa’s involvement as the network rail gives the product global acceptance infrastructure, but the commercial logic is primarily domestic. Abu Dhabi’s real estate market has remained buoyant through 2025 and into 2026, driven by continued government investment and population growth, which provides a large addressable base for property-linked financial products.

Several UAE banks and property groups have experimented with similar closed-loop loyalty integrations, but the scale of Aldar’s landbank, which spans 76 million square metres, and the breadth of the Live Aldar app ecosystem give this proposition a wider earn-and-redeem surface than most comparable products in the region.

The near-term test for the partnership will be activation rates and whether the Live Aldar app can sustain engagement outside of property transaction moments. Loyalty programmes anchored to infrequent, high-value purchases, such as property, tend to require a rich everyday-spend layer to maintain cardholder relevance, which the retail and hospitality reward tiers are designed to provide.

articles.title: 原田勝弘在大會洗臉微軟 XBOX Series S不該有下一代
articles.excerpt:
微軟在本世代 XBOX 主機推出了高性能 XBOX Series X 和迷你的 XBOX Series S，但後者因為性能太過貧弱，成為無數廠商的開發夢魘，連帶影響廠商發行遊戲到 XBOX 意願，《鐵拳系列》的前製作人原田勝弘在近期大會上更直言這樣的主機不該有下一代。

微軟在本世代 XBOX 主機推出了高性能 XBOX Series X 和迷你的 XBOX Series S，但後者因為性能太過貧弱，成為無數廠商的開發夢魘，連帶影響廠商發行遊戲到 XBOX 意願，《鐵拳系列》的前製作人原田勝弘在近期大會上更直言這樣的主機不該有下一代。

 

在韓國首爾舉行的「2026 主機遊戲開發者大會」（Console Game Developers Conference 2026）座談會上，原田勝弘趁著活動現場有微軟高層，向 CD Projeck Red《電馭叛客 2077》副遊戲總監 Paweł Sasko 發出靈魂拷問。

 

原田勝弘表示自己真心不要再有「XBOX Series S」這樣的主機，想必 CD Projekt Red 在經歷多個平台移植，要將原本 XBOX Series X 能夠在高性能加持下流暢運行的內容，不斷為了相容性妥協調整，想必一定為了開發而感到相當惱火。

 

 
 原田勝弘於現場活動照片 

 

Paweł Sasko 不否認開發 XBOX Series S 主機的遊戲確實不容易，但也認為可以轉變心態，它是很好考驗，能讓遊戲的程式碼變得更為乾淨高效，像是《電馭叛客 2077》能夠移植到 Switch 2，都多虧於在 XBOX Series S 累積的經驗。

 

 
 Paweł Sasko（右）在活動現場的照片 

 

對此，原田勝弘不給公關話面子，直接戳破 XBOX 兩台機型帶來的是天堂與地獄的體驗，但 Switch 2 是獨立的單一平台，玩家能接受硬體定位與妥協；反觀 Xbox 玩家只會直接責怪開發團隊差別待遇，不會替背後的硬體限制著想。

 

後面，原田勝弘更是對著台下微軟高層提出自己擔憂，害怕他們真的會把 CD Projekt Red 在活動上的說辭拿回去包裝，直言正在開發的下一代主機 Project Helix 千萬不要再搞出「Helix S」這樣為了親民而市占，卻拿體驗開玩笑的機種。

 

XBOX Series S 受到遊戲開發商的厭惡其實早已不是什麼秘密，由於微軟硬性要求遊戲必須支援兩種主機，直接逼走大量廠商的發行意願，如《黑神話：悟空》就放棄上架、《柏德之門 3》一度延期，直到微軟妥協同意移除「雙人分隔畫面」才勉強過關。

articles.title: 《惡靈古堡 安魂曲》奪2026金搖桿獎終極年度遊戲！《超級變色龍》橫掃4項大獎
articles.excerpt:
第 44 屆金搖桿獎（Golden Joystick Awards）今（12）日稍早頒獎典禮公布 2026 年得獎名單，由卡普空系列第九代《惡靈古堡 安魂曲》拿下最高榮譽「終極年度最佳遊戲獎」，同時獲得年度家機遊戲、最佳遊戲預告及最佳主角演出，成為本屆最大贏家。

第 44 屆金搖桿獎（Golden Joystick Awards）今（12）日稍早頒獎典禮公布 2026 年得獎名單，由卡普空系列第九代《惡靈古堡 安魂曲》拿下最高榮譽「終極年度最佳遊戲獎」，同時獲得年度家機遊戲、最佳遊戲預告及最佳主角演出，成為本屆最大贏家。

 

爆紅獨立遊戲《超級變色龍》同樣表現亮眼，一舉拿下最佳多人遊戲、最佳自家發行獨立遊戲、實況主票選獎及開發者票選獎，共獲得 4 項殊榮。超英派遣中心《Dispatch》則包辦最佳敘事與最佳配樂，卡普空則獲選年度遊戲工作室。

 

 

 

金搖桿獎擁有超過 40 年歷史，共設立 20 多個獎項類別，旨在表彰過去 12 個月的優秀作品，大部分由全球玩家票選，僅少數類別由專業評審評定，近年由外媒 GamesRadar+ 主辦，今年度頒獎典禮在英國倫敦的特羅克西音樂廳（Troxy）舉行。

 

金搖桿獎 2026 終極年度遊戲競爭相當激烈，與 2025 年《光與影：33 號遠征隊》無懸念領先的情況不同，今年多款大作獲玩家關注，此外，在玩家社群 GOTY 呼聲極高的《GTA 6》預定 11 月 19 日推出，因此未能參與本屆評選。

 

 

Big Walk getting fucking DQ'd from the Independent Games Festival awards for undisclosed AI usage was certainly not on my fucking bingo card but here we are I suppose

— Pascal Ampertail 🐇💾 | Cyber Bnuuy VTuber (@PascalAmpertail) November 10, 2026 

 

另一項起爭議的作品則是 4 人齊走步行模擬獨立遊戲《Big Walk》（大步走），開發團隊 House House 於 11 月 11 日透露《Big Walk》開發最後階段曾使用大型語言模型（LLM）等 AI 工具，但 AI 生成的程式碼不到全作的 0.1%，但消息一出被獨立遊戲節（IGF）評審抵制引起軒然大波。

 

由於 2026 金搖桿獎投票在 11 月 5 日截止，投票期間參與者還沒得知這項消息，也因此《Big Walk》最終獲得由評論家評選的評論家選擇獎。

articles.title: 《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》重製版意外掀起迷因熱潮！孩童林克「仰視眼神」萌翻玩家
articles.excerpt:
任天堂於 11 月 5 日發售了 Nintendo Switch 2 專用遊戲《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》（ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ）完全重製版，本作中收錄了童年時期林克模樣的一張遊戲截圖，似乎正在社群網站上掀起一股熱潮。

 

 

　　《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》是 1998 年為 NINTENDO 64 推出的動作角色扮演遊戲，是系列中首度採用 3D 圖像的作品，奠定了《薩爾達傳說》系列 3D 化的基礎；雖然過去也曾進行過移植與重製，但此次以更進一步的全面重製版形式登場，除了圖像全面革新、過場動畫實現全語音外，還導入了自由鏡頭操作、跳躍與衝刺等符合現代需求的各種新要素，發售後四天內銷量已突破 520 萬套也創下了 NS2 平台上最快紀錄。

 

 

　　而在這部作品中，有一張畫面突然引發玩家熱議，起因是 X 用戶「fernando_tings」在貼文中分享了一張包含孩童林克的截圖片段，畫面似乎是從藥房老闆的視角拍攝，恰好只露出林克的鼻子以上部分，fernando_tings 的貼文經過翻譯後內容大致如下「『小哥，我媽媽要買 1 公斤絞肉』、『是哪種肉啊？』、『絞肉』」，這其實是一個生活常見的笑話，當孩子受父母委託去買絞肉時，肉舖老闆反問是哪種絞肉，但孩子只知道是「絞肉」，不明白老闆詢問「什麼肉的絞肉」的用意，當然本作中並沒有林克被委託去買絞肉的場景。

 

- Moço, minha mãe pediu 1kg de carne moída. - Qual carne? - Moída. https://t.co/2x73LqWw0v

— F (@fernando_tings) November 7, 2026 

 

　　話雖如此，或許是因為孩童林克從桌子上探出頭來的天真模樣，以及那絕妙的仰視眼神，讓人聯想到被託付跑腿任務的孩子吧，這則貼文捕捉了林克被賦予這句連「絞肉」種類都不知道、宛如天真孩童般的台詞的畫面，轉眼間便成為熱門話題，截至本文撰寫時，該貼文已獲得約 9,600 次轉發與 10 萬次按讚，以及超過 120 萬次查看，這「仰視眼神」迅速在網路上成為迷因，除了台詞被改寫的「另一版本」外，甚至還出現了手繪描繪相同情境的作品。

 

one triforce please https://t.co/mCoWyRthwj

— pikat 🇭🇰 (@pikatl) November 8, 2026 

 

　　這類貼文之所以掀起熱潮，重製版中鏡頭視角的改變應是原因之一，在原版中，城下町的視角多數並非跟隨林克，而是採用固定在特定點位的鏡頭運鏡，藥店內的視角也是穿過門後，固定在右側附近，其他場景中同樣是從特定點位進行拍攝。玩家幾乎沒有機會窺見林克的臉龐。

 

 

　　而在這次完全重製版中，鏡頭設定實現了自由視角操作，玩家終於能看到「從店員視角所見的林克」的模樣，能夠透過這些豐富多變的表情，以及與原版不同的視角重新審視角色，可說是相當有趣的一例，此外林克那雙圓溜溜的眼睛所散發出的可愛眼神，或許正是引發這則網路迷因「信服感」的關鍵所在。

 

 

　　順帶一提，在本作中不僅是孩童林克，當身材較矮小的角色與成年人對話時，都會呈現仰視的姿態，當角色說話或注視某處時，眼球會配合動作進行細膩的追蹤，這一點也備受矚目，在社群媒體上，似乎也有玩家表示被其他角色的仰視眼神所打動，從視線移動表現的豐富性中，也能感受到開發者們的講究。

articles.title: 「資料引力」讓 AI 試點成功、擴大卻失敗，企業如何避免承擔 AI 隱形稅？
articles.excerpt:
過去幾年來，許多大型企業都投入資源，發展 AI 基礎設施、軟體，還有其他相關建設，然而，即便財務部門同意計畫，採購部門也開始動作，但卻鮮少有企業理解未來該如何管理這些 AI 系統背後所涉及的資料。 在資料無法妥善得到管理的情況下，它將會悄無聲息、日積月累的拖慢公司業務表現，並且以預期之外的人力成本增加、專案進度延誤等形式表現出來。 根據麻省理工學院（MIT）於 2025 年發表的一份報告，高達 95% 的企業生成式 AI 試點計畫，對於營收幾乎或根本沒有可量化的影響。該報告表明，模型品質並不是企業面臨的主要問題，而是企業將 AI 整合到營運流程的方式存在缺口。 換句話說，即便企業的 AI 試點計畫成功了，也無法證明當同一套 AI 系統套用整個組織的運作環境時，獲得同樣順利的表現。 企業 AI 的隱形稅，來自搬不動的資料 科技巨頭戴爾（Dell）技術長辦公室基礎架構解決方案 VP Gaurav Chawla，近日於專欄文章中提出「企業 AI 隱形稅」的概念，說明企業 AI 專案之所以從「試點成功」變成「營運失敗」，其過程容易遭到領導者忽略的困境與難關。 Gaurav Chawla 首先指出，大多數企業在導入全新 AI 平台之後，就會誤認為僅需要將資料匯集到一處，其上方的智慧層就能自然運作。Gaurav Chawla 說，這雖然是個合理的假設，可是在企業級規模下，想實現幾乎是不可能。 理由在於企業資料具有引力，也就是所謂的「資料引力（Data Gravity）」，例如法規規定某些資料只能存放在特定位置，資料主權規則也要求資料只能儲存於指定區域，無法隨意流動與遷移；過去花費數十年時間針對某個資料集建立治理架構的業務單位，也幾乎沒有動機將資料移動到新的平台，有時甚至沒有合法、合規的途徑允許部門這麼做。 資料引力最重要的影響，就是當有人試圖將資料，以及圍繞資料所建構的應用程式分離時，這些應用程式將可能會因此發生嚴重且代價高昂的故障。 Gaurav Chawla 指出，資料引力所帶來的影響，通常隱藏在企業 AI 專案的概念驗證與試點計畫之中，因為這些項目通常只會在經過預先清理的小部分資料上運作，而企業真正需要負擔的成本，將會於 AI 專案應用到大部分雜亂無章的真實環境資料後才浮現。 廣義上資料引力概念的本質為「資料集越大，企業移動的成本就越高」，其中傳輸費用僅是一部分，資料交由 AI 處理後所產生的延遲、頻寬、安全控制及營運開銷，全都會再進一步推高整體成本，所謂的「企業 AI 隱形稅」正是由此而來。 隱形稅不只一筆帳，還會層層壓在團隊身上 Gaurav […]

過去幾年來，許多大型企業都投入資源，發展 AI 基礎設施、軟體，還有其他相關建設，然而，即便財務部門同意計畫，採購部門也開始動作，但卻鮮少有企業理解未來該如何管理這些 AI 系統背後所涉及的資料。

在資料無法妥善得到管理的情況下，它將會悄無聲息、日積月累的拖慢公司業務表現，並且以預期之外的人力成本增加、專案進度延誤等形式表現出來。

根據麻省理工學院（MIT）於 2025 年發表的一份報告，高達 95% 的企業生成式 AI 試點計畫，對於營收幾乎或根本沒有可量化的影響。該報告表明，模型品質並不是企業面臨的主要問題，而是企業將 AI 整合到營運流程的方式存在缺口。

換句話說，即便企業的 AI 試點計畫成功了，也無法證明當同一套 AI 系統套用整個組織的運作環境時，獲得同樣順利的表現。

企業 AI 的隱形稅，來自搬不動的資料

科技巨頭戴爾（Dell）技術長辦公室基礎架構解決方案 VP Gaurav Chawla，近日於專欄文章中提出「企業 AI 隱形稅」的概念，說明企業 AI 專案之所以從「試點成功」變成「營運失敗」，其過程容易遭到領導者忽略的困境與難關。

Gaurav Chawla 首先指出， 大多數企業在導入全新 AI 平台之後，就會誤認為僅需要將資料匯集到一處，其上方的智慧層就能自然運作。 Gaurav Chawla 說，這雖然是個合理的假設，可是在企業級規模下，想實現幾乎是不可能。

理由在於企業資料具有引力，也就是所謂的「資料引力（Data Gravity）」，例如法規規定某些資料只能存放在特定位置，資料主權規則也要求資料只能儲存於指定區域，無法隨意流動與遷移；過去花費數十年時間針對某個資料集建立治理架構的業務單位，也幾乎沒有動機將資料移動到新的平台，有時甚至沒有合法、合規的途徑允許部門這麼做。

資料引力最重要的影響，就是當有人試圖將資料，以及圍繞資料所建構的應用程式分離時，這些應用程式將可能會因此發生嚴重且代價高昂的故障。

Gaurav Chawla 指出，資料引力所帶來的影響，通常隱藏在企業 AI 專案的概念驗證與試點計畫之中，因為這些項目通常只會在經過預先清理的小部分資料上運作，而企業真正需要負擔的成本，將會於 AI 專案應用到大部分雜亂無章的真實環境資料後才浮現。

廣義上資料引力概念的本質為「資料集越大，企業移動的成本就越高」，其中傳輸費用僅是一部分，資料交由 AI 處理後所產生的延遲、頻寬、安全控制及營運開銷，全都會再進一步推高整體成本，所謂的「企業 AI 隱形稅」正是由此而來。

隱形稅不只一筆帳，還會層層壓在團隊身上

Gaurav Chawla 認為，因「資料引力」所產生的「企業 AI 隱形稅」，通常不會以單一項目呈現，而是以數十項細微需求的形式，壓在原本就已不堪重負的團隊身上。

舉例來說，負責團隊必須建立並維護資料傳輸管道，將資料從原本未經此類流量設計的系統中移出；當來源系統變更時，還要將每份副本與原始資料進行對帳；而且無論資料儲存於何處，都必須套用相同的治理控制措施。此外，團隊還必須追蹤為開發、測試、分析及訓練所建立的額外資料集。

這些任務若只單看任何一項，似乎都不至於造成災難性的後果，拖累企業實際營運，但當它們疊加在一起時，便會成為 AI 專案的重大負擔，甚至隨著組織試圖擴大專案規模，負擔的代價只會越來越高。

成本延遲浮現，回頭修改代價更高

除此之外，Gaurav Chawla 強調 「企業 AI 隱形稅」最危險的地方，還在於它出現的時機。 這筆帳往往會在企業採購完成，而且團隊組建到位之後的 12 至 24 個月內才浮現，此時 AI 帶來的初步成果，早就已經被負責單位向上呈報。

當採購合約已經簽署、團隊人力都已經聘僱，企業甚至連發展方向也已經對外公開承諾，想要再回頭重新修改架構，其成本將遠高於企業從一開始就針對資料引力進行設計。

尤其對於規模較大的企業來說，雖然運算資源的需求容易規劃並納入預算，可是資料管線維護、資料對帳、治理、安全審查，以及維持系統運作所需的人力，卻會分散在不同組織之中，使得狀況變得更加複雜。

AI 需要的是上下文，不是更大的資料倉儲

Gaurav Chawla 直言，多數企業針對停滯 AI 計畫所做的事後檢討，往往僅止於「資料尚未準備就緒」的層面，這種判斷雖然方向正確，可是卻不完整，因為更深層的問題在於企業正試圖用儲存策略去解決「上下文」問題。

簡單來說，AI 模型從來不需要有人將原始資料直接倒在它面前，它需要的是上下文，即能夠找出正確的紀錄、與政策進行交叉比對、遵守存取規則，並基於最新資訊進行運作，而非僅依賴專案啟動的資料快照。

Gaurav Chawla 表示，想讓 AI 模型獲得這些東西，解法從來不是更大的資料倉儲，而是建立起企業級的上下文層，利用一種受管制且一致的機制，跨系統和跨位置發現資料，接著連結並檢索資料，這樣就不必將每個資料來源將資料交給中央儲存庫處理。

在這種情況下，中繼資料和向量資訊能夠協助 AI，查找並推論受到法規、主權、所有權限制，無法任意移動的紀錄。Gaurav Chawla 說，關鍵並不在於如何將所有資料匯集到同一個地方，而在於如何讓正確的上下文能在資料原本所在的任何位置、無論受何種規則管轄的情況下，都能被 AI 模型有效運用。

投入 AI 建設前，企業先回答 4 問題

Gaurav Chawla 提醒，在執行重大的 AI 基礎設施投資之前，企業應該要先回答四個基本問題：

 

第一，哪些資料集受到法規或合約限制而無法移動？

第二，目前各資料集的治理權歸誰所有？同時當資料集的副本存在於其他地方時，又會發生什麼情況？

第三，隨著來源系統的演進，這些副本將如何保持同步？

第四，智慧處理能否部署至資料現存的位置，還是架構要求所有資料必須集中化？

 

Gaurav Chawla 表示，企業釐清這些問題後，將有助於篩選出新架構、新平台的候選供應商，達成導入 AI 的目標，並且以更低成本快速實現業務流程自動化；此外，資料架構應該是成為 AI 商業案例中最主要的要考量項目，而非是在採購合約簽訂後才需要被解決的細節。

ROI 反映一半問題，還有一半是資料

最後 Gaurav Chawla 強調，企業通常會用 Token、吞吐量和 GPU 使用率來衡量 AI 的投資報酬率（ROI），而這些指標雖有助於評估 AI 專案的效率，但僅能反映出問題的一半。

所謂 企業 AI 價值的另一半，終究限制在於運算的上游環節，即餵入模型的資料是否值得信賴、是否受到妥善管理，以及能否保持最新狀態，同時又不對相關人員造成日益沉重的負擔。 

Token 使用量和 GPU 效率，可以告訴企業團隊運作 AI 模型的成本，但它們無法呈現一款 AI 模型，是否具備做出良好決策所需要的上下文。若想達成這一點，將始終取決於底層資料是否準確、最新、受管控，並且跟正確的業務流程互相連結。

從資料中萃取出的上下文，決定了 AI 自主行動的準確性，以及企業是否正朝著成為「AI 原生組織」的方向前進；既然企業都懂得為 AI 運算成本編列預算，那麼資料架構自然也會需要。

Gaurav Chawla 說，未來能從 AI 中獲益最多的企業，將是那些可以設計資料架構時，為 AI 代理所需要的上下文提供支援，同時還不必移動或刻意集中全組織資料的企業。

articles.title: 穩定幣一個月縮水 148 億美元，2022 年 5 月以來最大降幅
articles.excerpt:
DefiLlama 資料顯示，美元穩定幣流通總量 30 天減少 148.6 億美元至約 2,890.7 億美元，是 2022 年 5 月以來最大 30 天降幅；USDT 一個月減少 83 億美元、USDC 減少 30 億美元。

這篇文章 穩定幣一個月縮水 148 億美元，2022 年 5 月以來最大降幅 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

穩定幣總量正以 2022 年以來最快的速度縮水。根據 DefiLlama 資料 ，截至 11 月 12 日，美元穩定幣流通總量約 2,890.7 億美元，比 30 天前的 3,039.3 億美元減少 148.6 億美元，是 2022 年 5 月以來最大的 30 天降幅，總量也回到 2025 年 9 月的水準。

今年穩定幣總量的高點在 5 月 17 日，約 3,128.5 億美元，到現在已經減少約 238 億美元。

USDT 一個月少 83 億美元，USDC 少 30 億

減少的部分主要來自兩大穩定幣。DefiLlama 資料顯示，Tether 的 USDT 流通量約 1,756.5 億美元，比上個月減少 83.1 億美元；Circle 的 USDC 約 698.9 億美元，減少 29.7 億美元。兩者合計占穩定幣總量約 85%。

 The Block 引述鏈上分析公司 CryptoQuant 的報告指出，截至 11 月 7 日的 60 天內，USDT 市值減少 66 億美元，是 2022 年 12 月 FTX 倒閉後同期 32 億美元降幅的兩倍多。

Glassnode：穩定幣轉回增加才是新資金進場的訊號

鏈上分析公司 Glassnode 對 The Block 表示：「供給縮小，代表持有人把穩定幣贖回成美元、把現金帶離市場，能推動反彈的燃料就變少了。」Glassnode 認為，穩定幣供給重新成長，會是「新資金進場的第一個訊號」。

CryptoQuant 則認為，比特幣可能在 USDT 供給轉正之前就先形成階段性低點。截至台灣時間 11 月 12 日早上，比特幣報價約 7.37 萬美元。

鏈新聞 10 月報導過， 穩定幣供給今年僅增 0.4% ，支付額則年增 45%。

這篇文章 穩定幣一個月縮水 148 億美元，2022 年 5 月以來最大降幅 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: OKX 代幣化美股 11/23 上線：67 家拒絕上架，首批多為加密公司
articles.excerpt:
OKX 與紐約證交所母公司洲際交易所合資的 OKXICE 代幣化證券平台 11 月 23 日上線，首批逾 70 檔資產包括 Coinbase、Circle、Robinhood、Strategy 與 59 檔 Direxion ETF；已有 67 家公司依 SEC 創新豁免拒絕上架。

這篇文章 OKX 代幣化美股 11/23 上線：67 家拒絕上架，首批多為加密公司 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

OKX 11 月 11 日 宣布 ，與紐約證交所母公司洲際交易所（ICE）合資的 OKXICE 代幣化證券交易平台（TSV），將在 11 月 23 日上線，符合資格的美國用戶可以在 OKX App 裡全天候交易代幣化證券。

首批預計上架逾 70 檔資產，包括 Coinbase、Circle、Robinhood、Strategy、BitGo、Securitize、Better.com 的證券，以及 59 檔 Direxion 的 ETF；Strategy 另外會上架旗下的特別股。

67 家企業拒絕上架，首批以加密產業公司為主

平台依美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的「創新豁免」運作，發行公司可以在期限內提出異議，不讓自家股票的代幣版本在特定平台交易。根據 The Block 整理，11 月 5 日公布的最新名單已有 67 家公司提出異議，包括 Meta、家得寶、Netflix、特斯拉、好市多。

鏈新聞先前追蹤這份名單時，蘋果、Meta 加入後 七大科技巨頭已全數在列 。這次公布的首批發行公司，則幾乎都是加密產業或金融科技公司。

The Block 也提到，那斯達克法務長 Zecca 11 月 10 日在《巴倫週刊》投書表示，那斯達克打算讓自家股票退出所有代幣化證券交易平台，理由是創新豁免讓代幣化證券在全國市場系統之外交易，可能造成市場分散。

Uniswap v4 流動性池交易，資產放在自託管錢包

依 OKX 的說明，交易透過 OKX 以太坊二層網路 X Layer 上、以 Uniswap v4 建立的自動做市商流動性池進行，智能合約只允許符合資格的錢包交易與提供流動性。

代幣化由 Securitize 負責，每枚代幣對應一股美國股票，持有人享有股利、投票權與參與公司行動等股東權利。用戶的證券放在自託管錢包，平台不保管資產，也不持有私鑰。使用者必須是 OKX 美國公司的客戶、開通 CeDeFi 錢包並完成身分驗證。

OKXICE 共同主席、紐約州前州長古莫在聲明中說：「SEC 為美國市場引領下一個金融時代開了一扇真正的門。」另一位共同主席 Trabue Bland 說，平台會隨規模擴大再開放更多用戶使用。

代幣化股票的競爭也在升溫，紐約證交所近期選定以 Avalanche 結算代幣化股票，那斯達克、DTCC 也有各自的計畫，見 紐交所選 Avalanche 結算代幣化股票 。

這篇文章 OKX 代幣化美股 11/23 上線：67 家拒絕上架，首批多為加密公司 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: i2c Reports 42% Client Renewal Growth as PowerOne Scales Globally
articles.excerpt:
The Redwood City payments processor added clients across banking, crypto and gaming while processing over $70bn in annual transaction volume.

The post i2c Reports 42% Client Renewal Growth as PowerOne Scales Globally appeared first on The Fintech Times .

i2c Inc. has published a year-in-review summary for its PowerOne unified banking and payments platform, citing a 42% rise in clients that renewed or expanded their programmes over two years and a 46% growth in its largest client portfolios over the same period. The Redwood City, California-based company processes more than $70 billion in annual transaction volume across 216 markets and claims 99.999% historical platform availability. 

The announcement is framed around a wave of new client wins rather than a specific deal or funding event. Named additions span regulated banks, digital-asset firms and gaming-payments operators: Crypto.com extended its global card programme across dozens of markets without building new infrastructure; Belize Bank migrated its Mastercard and Visa portfolios onto PowerOne without service interruption; and Sightline Payments , working alongside Cross River Bank , used the platform to launch what it described as a first-of-its-kind payments ecosystem for the US gaming industry. Latin American digital bank Inter also joined the client roster to support international expansion, and Wealthsimple, one of Canada’s larger fintech platforms, cited the platform’s configurability as a key factor in its partnership.

 Platform architecture as the competitive argument 

 Amir Wain, CEO at i2c Inc. 

The commercial thesis i2c is advancing is one shared by a small number of global card-processing vendors: that a single, unified technology stack outperforms stitched-together multi-vendor arrangements on reliability, speed of product configuration, and total cost of ownership. The company claims more than 300 APIs, more than 100,000 pre-coded building blocks, and 1.5 million engineering hours invested annually in continuous development, with 30% of its workforce dedicated to research and development.

That argument has gained traction partly because the alternative is genuinely painful. New American Banker research, conducted in partnership with i2c, found that 88% of financial institutions have accelerated their modernisation timelines in response to competition from digital-first banks and non-bank providers, with legacy processing architecture cited most often as the primary barrier. The tension between proven scale on old infrastructure and agility on modern stacks is a real operational dilemma, and it shapes purchasing decisions at the programme manager and chief technology officer level.

Founder and chief executive Amir Wain described the platform’s direction in terms that signal a move toward agentic AI capabilities, framing unified data and decisioning workflows as the prerequisite architecture. “Our work toward agentic AI builds on the advantage of unified data, workflows, and decisioning, creating a foundation where intelligence can operate across the platform rather than being bolted onto fragmented systems,” he said.

 Market context and competitive landscape 

The card-issuing and processing segment is consolidating around a handful of global platforms. i2c competes against processors with significantly larger balance sheets, including Marqeta , Galileo (now part of SoFi ), and established network-affiliated processing arms. Differentiation in this space tends to come from configurability, speed to market for new card programmes, and the depth of support for non-standard use cases such as multi-currency prepaid, crypto-linked debit and gaming wallets. The Sightline and CoinZoom client wins suggest i2c is deliberately targeting these higher-complexity, higher-margin niches rather than competing on volume alone.

Industry recognition during the year included placement in IDC FinTech Rankings’ Top 100, a Leading Vendor designation from Celent in card issuing and processing, and Established Leader status in Juniper Research ‘s Modern Card Issuing Platforms Market 2025-2030 report. The company also joined Mastercard’s Crypto Partner Program and the Open Standard USD initiative, signalling ambition in stablecoin payment infrastructure.

i2c also made several senior leadership appointments, including a new chief financial officer, chief revenue officer, chief marketing officer and general counsel, suggesting the company is building out the executive layer typically associated with a business preparing for a liquidity event or a significant expansion phase, though no such plans were disclosed in the release.

The post i2c Reports 42% Client Renewal Growth as PowerOne Scales Globally appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: David Schwartz Hasn’t Bought XRP in Years: And His Latest Comments Sparked a Firestorm
articles.excerpt:
David Schwartz's reluctance to buy more XRP has triggered fresh debate over Ripple's business model, adoption claims and expectations surrounding the token.

David Schwartz’s latest comments about his XRP holdings have prompted questions from some members of the community about his confidence in the asset.

In a series of posts on X, the former Ripple CTO said he has not bought XRP in a long time and has sold nearly all the digital assets he has ever held because he is uncomfortable with risk. Schwartz still holds a considerable amount of Ripple stock, which he considers more risk than he would ideally like to take.

Schwartz Hates Risk

Schwartz has reduced his XRP holdings from 26 million to just 3 million. His Bitcoin holdings were down from 1,500 to just 1 BTC, while his Ethereum stash was down from 40,000 to just 6 ETH.

The comments quickly caught the attention of XRP holders, particularly those who questioned why someone who helped create the XRP Ledger would still view the crypto asset as a risky investment. One user said Schwartz understands the technology, its potential, growing adoption, and how a higher XRP price could improve efficiency and costs. Against that backdrop, the user questioned why he would be reluctant to hold more of the asset.

Schwartz did not dispute the point. He said almost every major risk he has taken in life has paid off, but that does not change the fact that he simply hates taking risks.

Not everyone was satisfied with that explanation. Another X user said that Schwartz’s comments had “opened a can of worms” for Ripple, and asked how XRP could be considered a risky investment if the company’s plans and business model were as solid as the community had been led to believe. The user even suggested that the former CTO had handed XRP holders a potential reason to pursue a class-action lawsuit against the blockchain company.

However, Schwartz’s said that it was his personal tolerance for financial risk, and not a prediction about XRP’s future. Despite this, the exchange has exposed a clear divide in community expectations.

Weakness Deepens

XRP was down 2.2% over the past 24 hours as the struggle near $1.06 continues. The crypto asset has shed more than 18% in the past week alone.

The sell-off has pushed XRP down to sixth place among cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, with USDC overtaking it.

The post David Schwartz Hasn’t Bought XRP in Years: And His Latest Comments Sparked a Firestorm appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: Silicon Valley’s richest outspent supporters more than 10 to one to kill California’s billionaire tax—and won
articles.excerpt:
Voters also voted to pass Proposition 42, potentially blocking future taxes on income and assets.

California voters rejected a proposed tax on the state’s billionaires after some of Silicon Valley’s wealthiest executives and investors spent $378.4 million to defeat it—delivering a victory to a coalition led by Google cofounder Sergey Brin.

The Associated Press called the race on Monday, with 52.8% of voters opposing Proposition 40 and 47.2% supporting it. The votes needed to pass the measure had trailed for days.

 

 

 

The defeat means—at least for now—an effort to make California the first state to impose a one-time tax on its billionaires has ended. It also represents a significant win for the Silicon Valley executives who have come together to block the measure.

Approximately 52.8% of voters opposed Proposition 40, whereas 47.2% supported it. According to CalMatters , ultrawealthy opponents collectively contributed $378.4 million to efforts opposing the tax and related countermeasures like Props 41 and 42. That amount is more than 10 times the $33.5 million raised by supporters of Proposition 40.

 

 

 

 A measure to split the Democratic Party 

Proposition 40 would have imposed a one-time 5% tax on the net worth of individuals worth more than $1 billion who were California residents on Jan. 1, 2026. The proposed tax covered financial assets and other forms of wealth, rather than just income.

Under the proposal, approximately 90% of the revenue would have gone toward healthcare services, with the remaining 10% allocated to education and food assistance. The Legislative Analyst’s Office estimated that the measure could generate “tens of billions” of dollars.

The initiative was introduced by Service Employees International Union-United Healthcare Workers West, which argued that California needed additional revenue to address healthcare funding shortfalls following federal spending reductions under President Donald Trump’s tax and spending legislation. The measure also received support from Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders, U.S. Rep. Ro Khanna, the California Democratic party and several labor organizations.

But not every Democrat and Californian was on the same page. The proposal faced opposition from prominent Democrats including Gov. Gavin Newsom, who argued that a state-level wealth tax would push wealthy residents and their businesses out of the state. Instead, Newsom said he would support a national wealth tax. San Francisco Democrats also opposed the measure, voting 17-4 against Prop 40 in August, while U.S. Rep. Nancy Pelosi, a member of the local party, voted “no endorsement.”

“Here is what I support: A national billionaires’ tax,” Newsom wrote in a post on Substack in June. “A true minimum tax on billionaires—a modern Buffett Rule—that ensures the people at the very top pay at least the tax rate their own workers pay.”

 The billionaire opposition campaign 

The campaign against the proposition was financed by some of the most prominent figures in the tech, finance and investment industries—with Brin emerging as its largest individual financial backer.

Brin contributed approximately $102 million to Building a Better California, a political committee he established in January that became the main vehicle opposing the wealth tax. The contributions made Brin one of the most consequential financial players in California’s 2026 ballot-measure fight. He relocated to Nevada in December 2025—making his fortune, estimated at $231 billion by Bloomberg, potentially exempt from the tax.

Eric Schmidt, Google’s former CEO, was also a major contributor to the opposition effort. According to campaign finance filings, he contributed $40.2 million to the campaign.

Other prominent tech executives and investors also contributed millions, including DoorDash CEO Tony Xu, Stripe cofounder Patrick Collison, venture capitalist John Doerr, cryptocurrency entrepreneur Chris Larsen and former Sequoia Capital partner Michael Moritz.

 

 

 

 The wealth tax would have been killed anyway 

The contributions were also not limited to Building a Better California’s fight against Prop 40. Through Oct. 20, Building a Better California spent more than $304 million supporting efforts to defeat Proposition 40 and advance Propositions 41 and 42—direct counters to the wealth tax. Of that amount, approximately $118.5 million went toward opposing Proposition 40, while the other $186 million supported Propositions 41 and 42, according to Capital & Main . 

Proposition 41 would “require preelection audits for initiatives proposing special taxes and additional audits every four years. It also would prohibit new tax revenue from being exempted from state spending limits,” making it harder for the state to use funds raised by the billionaire tax. Proposition 42 would “prohibit taxes on personal savings, assets and retirement holdings”— outlawing retroactive taxation, directly countering Proposition 40. According to the Legislative Analyst’s Office, if either one gets more “yes” votes than Proposition 40, the wealth tax could be stopped even if it is approved.

And while the wealth tax didn’t get approved, a ballot measure meant to block it did. According to the AP , Proposition 41 did not pass by voters while Proposition 42 did— meaning Proposition 40 would have been shot down if it had passed regardless.

 

 

 

According to Politico , more than 70 current and former California billionaires had spent a record $612 million into the state elections this cycle. Of that money, at least 30 billionaires had contributed more than $293 million specifically to the wealth tax fight.

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Verizon’s CEO turned down the job several times before leaving retirement on his ranch: ‘I came in with a little bit of a bad attitude’
articles.excerpt:
Dan Schulman was happy tending cattle in Montana. But Verizon's struggles and a push from his wife convinced him to return to the corner office.

Dan Schulman thought he had traded the corner office for cowboy boots for good. After nearly a decade running digital payments giant PayPal , he was enjoying retirement on a Montana ranch with his wife, Summerly, and roughly 900 head of cattle. He was happy, in love, and had no desire to return to the grueling CEO schedule.

So when his fellow Verizon board members came calling for him to step in as CEO, he said no. Several times. 

But the telecommunications giant was losing market share, falling behind competitors, and struggling with a bureaucracy . Eventually, a sense of obligation—and some convincing from his wife—brought him out of retirement to take the top job in October 2025.

“I came in with a little bit of a bad attitude,” Schulman told Fortune Editor-in-Chief Alyson Shontell in the latest episode of Fortune 500: Titans and Disruptors of Industry . A year later, he said, he’s “absolutely loving it and pretty hopeful about our future.”

The reluctant hire is now one year into a three-year turnaround plan for Verizon, a Fortune 500 company with $138 billion in revenue last year. The early numbers are moving his way.

 A reluctant return to the corner office 

The former PayPal chief had stepped down in 2023 and retirement gave him plenty of time to embrace his inner cowboy. The New Jersey native had been wearing cowboy boots since eighth grade, long before he had a ranch—or cattle—to go with them.

“I really didn’t want to come back into the CEO job,” he said. “These jobs are all-consuming. You’re putting in 10 to 14 hours a day.”

Verizon, as it turns out, knows a thing or two about making repeat calls. Although Schulman may have been ready to hang up on corporate life, it wasn’t ready to part ways with him just yet. 

He had sat on Verizon’s board since 2018 and had been its lead independent director since December 2024. He knew the management team, understood the business, and had watched the company struggle to compete. He was already the board’s backup plan.

“I was the hit-by-the-bus scenario,” he said. If anything had happened to then-CEO Hans Vestberg, “I would go in temporarily.”

Verizon had been losing market share for roughly five years, Schulman said. Once first in its industry by market capitalization, it had fallen to last, and its longtime reputation for having a superior wireless network was no longer enough to keep customers from looking elsewhere.

“We had the lowest P/E, which is what the Street thinks of our future growth potential,” he said.

Schulman acknowledged the board probably should have acted sooner. It had developed a plan to address the company’s struggles, but the strategy didn’t deliver. Quoting his father, he put it this way: “People plan, God laughs.”

“We had a plan. It didn’t work out, so we had to go to Plan B, which was me, not Plan A,” he said.

Despite his reservations, Schulman believed Verizon still had the assets to turn things around, including what he estimated at 150 million customer lines. The board kept asking. In the end, it was Summerly who convinced him, reminding her husband that he could still make a difference.

“I felt an obligation,” he said.

Verizon’s CEO cut 35-signature approvals and 13,000 jobs 

Once he accepted, Schulman wasn’t interested in easing into the job.

At his first all-employee meeting, he delivered a blunt assessment of the company’s problems without notes or slides. Verizon had become a “big, lumbering giant that had fallen behind,” he said, with a hierarchical culture, slow decision-making, and processes that required something like 35 signatures to move forward.

He also warned employees that layoffs were likely.

That warning became reality in November 2025, just weeks after he took over, when Verizon began cutting more than 13,000 jobs , the largest round of layoffs in its history. Verizon had cut 2,000 or 3,000 people, often through voluntary buyouts, every year, Schulman said. He wanted the cuts to free up money to reinvest in the business, and to show employees this turnaround was different.

“I needed to show this was different, that I was very serious about the change that was going to happen,” he said. “Playing to win is not just a slogan for me or a nice marketing thing.”

His strategy centers on replacing Verizon’s risk-averse culture with one willing to experiment, make decisions faster, and put customers ahead of internal processes. That means rethinking what Verizon has long put first.

The network is “foundational to everything we do,” Schulman said, but “it can’t be about the network. It has to be about the customer.”

Verizon’s early results are promising, with two years to go 

The overhaul is beginning to show up in the numbers. In the third quarter of 2026 , Verizon added a net 406,000 postpaid phone lines, up from 44,000 a year earlier. Its promotional costs to acquire customers fell 41%, and free cash flow rose 12% to $7.8 billion.

Part of the shift came from breaking an industry habit of luring customers with free phones and promotional offers.

“A free line is not really a net add from my perspective,” Schulman said.

Still, he knows the turnaround is far from over. He expects it to take three years, and the company has extended his contract through December 2028 to see it through.

The ranch will have to wait. Asked how he’ll judge his tenure when he eventually hands Verizon to a successor, Schulman pointed first to customer trust, then to pride inside a company many had written off as too big and too bureaucratic to change.

“We’re surprising a lot of people right now,” he said, “and it feels good when that happens.”

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

〈 以色列 Discount Bank 11/26 將開放比特幣、以太幣交易！但買的幣不能轉出 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

articles.title: GENIUS 法案只保發行端！DeFi 借貸條款還能被投票改掉
articles.excerpt:
美國聯準會端出 GENIUS 法案的儲備與兩日贖回規則，但 DeFi 借貸的抵押規則、清算門檻與利率仍可能被治 […]

〈 GENIUS 法案只保發行端！DeFi 借貸條款還能被投票改掉 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

美國聯準會端出 GENIUS 法案的儲備與兩日贖回規則，但 DeFi 借貸的抵押規則、清算門檻與利率仍可能被治理投票改掉，全額儲備的美元借進去的風險並沒有消失。 （前情提要：Fed 推進 GENIUS Act 落地：穩定幣發行商要存錢防風險，2 天內贖回否則清算） （背景補充：美國 OCC 搶先拍板 GENIUS Act 穩定幣最終規則：2027/1/18 生效，銀行與非銀發幣路徑拍板） 穩定幣發行端的規則終於要落地。美國聯準會 9 月 24 日提出兩項落實《GENIUS Act》的新規則，要求發行商以儲備資產支撐代幣，並套用新的資本與風險管理標準；草案同時明定贖回必須在兩個工作日內完成，發行商每個月要向監管機關申報流通中的穩定幣數量。時程很趕，法案將在 2027 年 1 月 18 日、或最終規則發布後 120 天生效，兩者取其先。 發行端終於有一套人人可讀的規則，接下來會看到更多國家級用例，例如償債與美元的跨境流通。但穩定幣最終流進去的 DeFi 借貸市場，成熟度還差一截。DeFi 借貸協議 Ajna 共同創辦人 Mike Hathaway 與 Joseph Quintilian 點出的問題是：典型鏈上借貸市場裡，預言機提供的價格決定一筆貸款何時被清算，代幣持有人則可以投票改動整套規則，而且往往是在錢借出去之後才改。 這個組合原本是為了保護使用者。策展金庫與標準化餵價把早期 DeFi 的門檻拆掉，機構現在拿到一份審核過的市場選單，只要評估一個交易對手，風險語言也對得上信用委員會的習慣。但便利來自集中度，而風險就坐在集中度上。當同一批風控管理員與同一個價格來源替數千億美元貸款背書，一個壞引數或一次短暫的價格尖峰，就會沿著所有依賴該來源的市場擴散，把跟原始錯誤毫無關係的市場一起拖進清算。 文章列舉的例子橫跨一年多。2025 年 11 月 Stream Finance 出現 9,300 萬美元損失，分析師追出約 2.85 億美元的可能曝險分散在 Euler、Silo、Morpho 等協議；今年 2 月 Moonwell 一場治理投票設定的餵價，把 cbETH 報成約 1.12 美元、而實際價格約 2,200 美元，留下約 178 萬美元壞帳；3 月 Aave 上一個風控工具的設定過期，讓 wstETH 被低估約 2.85%，引發約 2,700 萬美元清算；9 月 Vesu 只因為兩分鐘的錯誤價格資料，就清掉 47 個倉位、約 300 萬美元。 近一年四起 DeFi 借貸壞帳與清算事件的金額對照（動區自繪） 錢借出去之後，誰能改條款 機構放款看的是條款。若一場治理投票可以在放款後改掉抵押規則、清算門檻或利率，這筆貸款就無法定價，沒有信用部門能替一份下週可能被代幣投票重寫的合約核保；外部管理的預言機也可能失效或變得不可用。文章提醒，華爾街會認出這個模式：「大到不能倒」的互連問題正在被重建，而且沒有聯準會現在要求穩定幣發行商具備的資本緩衝。 監管的保證在發行端就停住。一枚在發行端全額儲備的美元，還是可能被借進一個下週就能靠投票改條款的市場，或被一個可能連續兩分鐘報錯的餵價定價。發行端越像銀行，這段落差就越顯眼。 Ajna 提出的解法是把改變變成選擇性的：沒有預言機，放款人自己選願意放款的價格，利率依合約裡的固定公式而非投票決定，資金池上線後規則不能被任何人改動。代價是漏洞無法修補，只能靠使用者自己選擇遷移到新版本。對機構而言，「誰能在放款後改動這筆貸款的條款」這個問題，比「哪個市場最安全」更能決定風險。 後續觀察：生效日與機構資金流向 第一條線是時程。GENIUS Act 的生效日訂在 2027 年 1 月 18 日，OCC 也已在 10 月搶先拍板自家版本的最終規則，兩套規則疊起來，發行端合規成本的輪廓大致底定。目前草案文本管的是儲備、資本與贖回，並沒有處理預言機失效或治理投票改條款這類風險，這也意味借貸市場的規則問題，短期內仍得由市場自己解決。 第二條線是錢往哪裡去。儲備、資本緩衝與兩日贖回落實之後，鏈上美元的部位只會更大，而這些錢多半會先進入策展金庫這類集中式基礎設施。機構願不願意為了條款不可變而放棄便利，會決定下一代借貸市場的形狀。對照 2025 年以來四起事故的金額，條款可變性的成本已經有具體數字可以對帳。 相關報導 鯨魚做空CRV，Aave耗費百萬買單？DeFi借貸協議為什麼會產生壞帳 一次釣魚，為何揭開 DeFi 能否「魚與熊掌兼得」的矛盾靈魂？Venus 攻擊啟示錄 免清算借貸協議的可行性：DeFi 的高收益和靈活效能兩者兼得？〈GENIUS 法案只保發行端！DeFi 借貸條款還能被投票改掉〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: German Regulators Challenge PayPal Over Anti-Competitive Practices
articles.excerpt:
PayPal, a major player in Germany’s online retail market, is facing scrutiny from the country’s antitrust regulator over alleged anticompetitive practices. At issue is the company’s policy prohibiting merchants from adding surcharges when customers choose PayPal at checkout,  despite the relatively high fees it charges sellers compared with other payment methods. According to Global Banking […]

The post German Regulators Challenge PayPal Over Anti-Competitive Practices appeared first on PaymentsJournal .

PayPal, a major player in Germany’s online retail market, is facing scrutiny from the country’s antitrust regulator over alleged anticompetitive practices. At issue is the company’s policy prohibiting merchants from adding surcharges when customers choose PayPal at checkout, despite the relatively high fees it charges sellers compared with other payment methods.

According to Global Banking & Finance Review, PayPal was available on more than 85 % of German websites using payment service providers as of September 2026. It also accounted for more than a quarter of Germany’s total online payment revenue in 2025. Last year, the country became the launch market for PayPal’s digital wallet .

Higher Merchant Fees

Merchants that accept PayPal agree to contractual terms prohibiting them from charging customers extra for using the service. They are also barred from discouraging PayPal payments or making alternative payment methods more convenient. These restrictions have been in place since 2018.

PayPal typically charges merchants between 2.49% to 2.99% of each transaction, plus a fixed fee of 34 to 39 cents, per UA.news . Larger merchants may negotiate individual rates, however, meaning actual costs can vary.

The Bundeskartellamt, Germany’s Federal Cartel Office, argues that PayPal’s market position  makes it difficult for merchants to drop the service, even when less expensive alternatives are available. Its president, Andreas Mundt, has warned that the combination of PayPal’s popularity and relatively high merchant fees could make it hard for competing providers to attract business, potentially contributing to higher prices for consumers.

PayPal had no immediate comment on the allegations. The regulators has invited the company to respondent to its preliminary findings.

Ramifications Around the World

The Bundeskartellamt is considering requiring PayPal to turn over any profits generated through the practices under investigation. It also believes the restrictions could violate EU competition law. A finding of infringement could have implications beyond Germany, potentially prompting broader scrutiny of PayPal’s merchant agreements across Europe.

In the U.S. PayPal generally has more latitude to establish contractual conditions for merchants using its services, including restrictions on payment-specific surcharges. Federal law does not broadly prohibit payment providers from imposing such restrictions on merchants.

The post German Regulators Challenge PayPal Over Anti-Competitive Practices appeared first on PaymentsJournal .
