articles.title: Google 瓦解 130 萬台機上盒殭屍網路，指代工廠出廠藏後門、家用網路成代理節點
articles.excerpt:
Google 威脅情報團隊（GTIG）近日公布，與日本警察廳、資安業者 Synthient、TrendAI 等夥伴合作，瓦解名為 XCPE 的殭屍網路。Google 指出，Android 設備代工廠（OEM／ODM）Videostrong 讓逾 130 萬台機上盒成為殭屍網路的一部分；Google 認為這不是個別內部人員所為，也不是開發疏失，「x.cpe 網路是為了持續獲利而建立的」。Videostrong 截至《The Record》刊出時，未回應置評請求。 TrendAI 觀測到的受感染設備遍及 170 多國，台灣名列最多的前五國之一；而 130 萬台可能還是保守數字。參與調查的 Synthient 創辦人 Ben Brundage 告訴《Krebs on Security》，這個數字「非常保守」。Google 也估計，切斷相關惡意程式家族的控制網域，還能斷開至少 1,000 萬台其他受感染裝置的存取。這些出廠就帶著後門的機上盒究竟被拿來做什麼？買走這些家用網路的又是誰？ 一台電視盒、多條財路：閒置頻寬如何被分包賣出？ 答案藏在「住宅代理」（residential proxy）這門生意裡。住宅代理讓買家借用一般家庭的網路連線上網，被借用的家用設備，就是代理網路的「出口節點」。Google 直指：「後門營運者、廣告詐欺集團與住宅代理業者構成一條互相串連的供應鏈，一旦其中一環遭到打斷，營運者就會迅速轉向新的載入程式，或競爭對手的變現 SDK。」Synthient 則形容，這是一場更大規模「按安裝數付費」（pay-per-install，PPI）行動的一部分，助長了廣告詐欺與代理生態系。 Google 指出，Videostrong 透過出售後門存取權給犯罪合作夥伴，並替對方把惡意模組裝進受感染設備來獲利。名為 x.cpe 的後門預載在韌體中，以系統層級權限執行；TrendAI 進一步拆解，x.cpe 搭配變現模組 com.abc.nexus，能把客廳裡常見的設備，變成住宅代理的出口節點、廣告詐欺的點擊器，或 PCDN 網路的節點。PCDN 在中國相當常見，利用家用設備的閒置頻寬傳送影音串流等內容，並付費給設備主人。 TrendAI 觀察到三類收入：轉賣家庭網路連線的住宅代理服務、未經任何同意畫面就加入的兩個商業頻寬分享計畫，以及產生詐欺廣告曝光的廣告模組。營運者可以從中央主控台，透過 MQTT 指令逐台開關這些模組，一台電視盒因此能用好幾種方式賺錢，有時還同時進行，主人看到的卻只是一台正常播放節目的串流設備。TrendAI 在 6/3 至 […]

Google 威脅情報團隊（GTIG）近日公布，與日本警察廳、資安業者 Synthient、TrendAI 等夥伴合作，瓦解名為 XCPE 的殭屍網路。Google 指出，Android 設備代工廠（OEM／ODM）Videostrong 讓逾 130 萬台機上盒成為殭屍網路的一部分；Google 認為這不是個別內部人員所為，也不是開發疏失，「x.cpe 網路是為了持續獲利而建立的」。Videostrong 截至《The Record》刊出時，未回應置評請求。

TrendAI 觀測到的受感染設備遍及 170 多國，台灣名列最多的前五國之一；而 130 萬台可能還是保守數字。參與調查的 Synthient 創辦人 Ben Brundage 告訴《Krebs on Security》，這個數字「非常保守」。Google 也估計，切斷相關惡意程式家族的控制網域，還能斷開至少 1,000 萬台其他受感染裝置的存取。這些出廠就帶著後門的機上盒究竟被拿來做什麼？買走這些家用網路的又是誰？

一台電視盒、多條財路：閒置頻寬如何被分包賣出？

答案藏在「住宅代理」（residential proxy）這門生意裡。住宅代理讓買家借用一般家庭的網路連線上網，被借用的家用設備，就是代理網路的「出口節點」。Google 直指：「後門營運者、廣告詐欺集團與住宅代理業者構成一條互相串連的供應鏈，一旦其中一環遭到打斷，營運者就會迅速轉向新的載入程式，或競爭對手的變現 SDK。」Synthient 則形容，這是一場更大規模「按安裝數付費」（pay-per-install，PPI）行動的一部分，助長了廣告詐欺與代理生態系。

Google 指出，Videostrong 透過出售後門存取權給犯罪合作夥伴，並替對方把惡意模組裝進受感染設備來獲利。名為 x.cpe 的後門預載在韌體中，以系統層級權限執行；TrendAI 進一步拆解，x.cpe 搭配變現模組 com.abc.nexus，能把客廳裡常見的設備，變成住宅代理的出口節點、廣告詐欺的點擊器，或 PCDN 網路的節點。PCDN 在中國相當常見，利用家用設備的閒置頻寬傳送影音串流等內容，並付費給設備主人。

TrendAI 觀察到三類收入：轉賣家庭網路連線的住宅代理服務、未經任何同意畫面就加入的兩個商業頻寬分享計畫，以及產生詐欺廣告曝光的廣告模組。營運者可以從中央主控台，透過 MQTT 指令逐台開關這些模組，一台電視盒因此能用好幾種方式賺錢，有時還同時進行，主人看到的卻只是一台正常播放節目的串流設備。TrendAI 在 6/3 至 10/1 間歇觀測發現，營運者實際變現了約九成受控設備，這個代理產品平均每天提供約 18 萬個真實家用 IP，單日高峰逾 36 萬個，且都只是下限。

不跳同意畫面就加入代理網路，Google 要求業者拿出可稽核的同意證明

模組裝進的代理 SDK 之一 AppSalt，是爭議焦點。Google 分析指出，AppSalt 初始化時不顯示同意畫面，而是直接呼叫 optIn() 方法，在沒有任何使用者介面的情況下設定同意旗標；啟動時還會檢查應用程式的安裝來源，若是從官方 Google Play 商店安裝，就停止執行。AppSalt 是 Honeygain 旗下的住宅代理 SDK，Honeygain 則隸屬於立陶宛的 Oxylabs。

Google 點名的營運者是 Videostrong，不是 Oxylabs。據《Krebs on Security》事後更新的報導，Oxylabs 表示查無 Videostrong 這家公司的紀錄，但在供應商中找到 GTIG 報告列為 Videostrong 惡意程式外部載入程式的 com.abc[.]nexus，「我們一看到，就暫停了合作關係，並發出正式的法律查詢函。」Oxylabs 也表示，公司系統設計上必須收到使用者同意的訊號，才會把設備當作出口節點，是開發者偽造了這些訊號。

早在 Oxylabs 發表聲明之前，Google 的報告就從整個代理產業的角度分析，認為這些業者只有在平台政策與執法逼迫下才會徵求同意，未經使用者同意的「靜默加入」仍是設備變成出口節點最普遍的方式。TrendAI 另提醒，付費換流量的公司本身不一定是惡意，問題在於營運者未經設備主人同意就把設備納入。Google 也對代理業者提出要求：「雖然部分業者可能聲稱自己行事合乎道德，只在消費者明確同意下才註冊設備，但任何『道德取得』的主張，都必須有透明、可稽核的使用者同意證明作為依據。」

流量混在真實客戶之中，只看 IP 為何擋不住帳號接管與詐欺？

這些頻寬賣出去之後，可能被怎麼使用？資安記者 Brian Krebs 指出，住宅代理服務是不當、往往也是惡意流量的主要來源，包括帳號接管、廣告詐欺，以及為 AI 專案大量爬取內容。Synthient 也提到，無監管的代理網路會推動撞庫（credential stuffing，用外洩帳密大量嘗試登入）與分散式阻斷服務（DDoS）殭屍網路。

對企業而言，這些流量很難和正常使用者區分。TrendAI 指出，來自這些設備的流量，和企業真實客戶、在家工作員工使用的是同樣的網路，針對資料中心 IP 範圍的封鎖清單無法攔截，實際上也沒攔下這類流量。買家只需要租用存取權，不必自己入侵；風險會落在所有用 IP 位址判斷使用者是誰、身在何處的環節，例如登入篩檢、支付詐欺檢查、廣告計費與地區限定服務。

舉例來說，租用出口節點的攻擊者，可以取得受害者所在國家與地區的家用寬頻位址；在廣告端，每台盒子都從真實家庭連線產生曝光，廣告驗證系統會把它當成真實受眾。不過 TrendAI 也強調，研究團隊並未觀察到這批設備代理容量的具體買家，這些發現也不應被當成國家級攻擊者使用這批設備的證據。

拆掉伺服器不等於清乾淨：企業從採購、網路分段到登入驗證怎麼防

Google 這次透過法律行動，拿下 Videostrong 控制殭屍網路的網域與伺服器，以及十多個經由這個後門載入的惡意程式家族所用的控制（C2）網域。Google 也禁止 Videostrong 及其未來的子公司、關係企業製造、販售經 Google 認證的 Android 設備，或向其他認證廠商供應軟體。GTIG 瓦解行動負責人 Charley Snyder 告訴《The Record》，切斷通訊網域「實際上使惡意程式變得無害」。

TrendAI 的看法較保留：拆除伺服器切斷了營運者與設備的連線，但植入程式仍留在每台已售出的設備上，這類營運者過去也曾在新的基礎設施上重建。受影響的也不只家用機上盒，Google 另觀察到遠距醫療設備、卡拉 OK 機與數位看板等 Android 物聯網設備遭感染。

企業端可以怎麼做？Synthient 建議企業 IT 用報告公布的入侵指標（IOC）盤點網路，發現可疑設備立即斷線，封鎖 C2 網域與 IP，並把其餘物聯網設備放在與敏感系統隔離的網段。TrendAI 則建議，有遠端員工的組織，應把員工家中未受管理的消費性設備視為曝險，公司存取只透過受管理的端點；詐欺防制團隊不要只依賴 IP 信譽，可記錄 JA4T 等網路指紋，結合重複登入失敗等行為訊號再處置。

採購端同樣是防線。Google 指出，下游硬體品牌、白牌經銷商、電信業者與電商平台都有責任堵住這個破口，「零售商與經銷商應要求原始設計製造商（ODM）提供獨立的資安稽核，並迅速下架涉及供應鏈濫用的製造商。」TrendAI 也建議，販售白牌電視盒的通路應要求供應商提供經認證的韌體。

XCPE 的控制網域與伺服器雖已被拿下，但同意訊號可以被偽造，已售出的設備也仍帶著植入程式。對企業而言，防禦的焦點正從設備本身，延伸到登入、支付與廣告系統如何看待「來自一般家庭」的流量。

 

【推薦閱讀】

◆ Qwen3.8 試圖連往阿里雲，是後門還是訓練殘留？企業部署 AI 代理先管住對外連線 
◆ Google、微軟、OpenAI、Anthropic 支援網站一次退出 AI 訓練，但只管訓練、不擋爬蟲

articles.title: Hypercall to Open Anthropic Options on Hyperliquid November 9 as IPO Timing Draws Doubts
articles.excerpt:
Hypercall's Anthropic options will settle on a 30-minute average of a Hyperliquid perp's oracle price, not on any traded share.

Hypercall said on Friday that it will open options tied to Anthropic’s pre-IPO price on Monday, November 9, as the AI company prepares for its Nasdaq listing.

The contracts go live at 8 a.m. EST and trade around the clock, weekends included. Traders can buy calls and puts or combine them into spreads. Those options are synthetic and settle in cash.

Hypercall, a Synapse product, is an options exchange built on Hyperliquid. The platform reported $536 million in options notional volume in September. Its existing markets cover SpaceX, the S&P 500, large US stocks, Bitcoin (BTC), and Ethereum (ETH).

Options Settle on Perp Prices

Hypercall pointed to Anthropic’s pre-IPO perpetual futures on Hyperliquid, where traders already bet on the company’s valuation. Those markets run on HIP-3, a Hyperliquid feature that lets developers deploy their own perpetual futures. Hyperliquid’s market data listed four Anthropic perps on Friday. Those four come from Trade[XYZ], Ventuals, Paragon, and EntropyIO.

Moreover, Hypercall’s documentation says its options are European-style, so they pay out only at expiry. Each contract settles in USDC against a 30-minute average of the oracle price on the underlying Hyperliquid perp.

For stocks and indices, that perp sits on Trade[XYZ]’s venue. Its list of underlyings, last updated on November 3, does not yet include an Anthropic perp.

Ventuals’ SpaceX pre-IPO perp fell about 45% in May after bad oracle data from an outside provider and liquidated more than $1.5 million in long positions. Hypercall said buyers of fully paid options can lose no more than their premium and face no liquidation before expiry.

Likewise, market makers that sell those options can hedge on the Anthropic perps, which keep trading after US exchanges close.

Roadshow Timing Draws Doubts

Anthropic made its IPO filing public on October 26 and plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Its amended prospectus, filed on November 2, still leaves the price range blank.

Bloomberg had reported the roadshow could start the week of November 9, with a debut before Thanksgiving on November 26. On Friday, Reuters reported potential investors doubt that the roadshow can go ahead next week.

Four people familiar with the talks told the agency investors are pushing for a lower valuation because they see the recently discussed $1.5 trillion valuation as the high end of expectations.

The post Hypercall to Open Anthropic Options on Hyperliquid November 9 as IPO Timing Draws Doubts appeared first on CryptoPotato .

【科技早餐】今天精選 8 則國內外重要科技新聞。

＊孫正義 54 億美元機器人併購卡關，中國禁止收購 ABB 在中業務

日本軟銀集團（SoftBank Group）11 月 6 日公告，已在 11 月 4 日接獲中國外商投資安全審查機關通知，禁止收購瑞士 ABB 在中國的機器人業務。ABB 也在 11 月 5 日證實這項決定。軟銀由董事長兼執行長孫正義（Masayoshi Son）領導，去年 10 月與 ABB 簽署協議，擬以企業價值 53.75 億美元收購其全球機器人部門。這次禁令直接影響中國業務部分，雙方目前仍在討論如何推進整體交易，尚未宣布全球併購案取消。

ABB 機器人事業橫跨工廠自動化、系統整合與工業設備，對軟銀布局實體 AI 具有戰略意義。《Reuters》引述知情人士指出，中國審查涉及敏感技術及資料跨境流動疑慮，但主管機關並未公開完整否決理由。對有意跨境併購自動化企業的買方而言，這起事件凸顯：即使交易標的是全球事業，只要涉及中國製造、研發或客戶資料，審查結果也可能改變交易結構與時程。後續重點在雙方能否提出獲得接受的處理方案。

＊NVIDIA 完成 10 億美元入股 NAVER，最高 90 億美元 AI 算力計畫推進

NVIDIA 對南韓網路與雲端業者 NAVER 的 10 億美元投資，已在 11 月 6 日完成付款。根據 NAVER 向監管機關提交的資料及《Yonhap News Agency》報導，NAVER 透過第三方配售發行約 656 萬股新股，NVIDIA 取得約 4.13% 股權。這項投資 7 月已公布，此次最新進展是款項正式到位。NAVER 準備擴大 GPU 雲端服務。

另一條資金線來自基礎設施投資機構 Brookfield。NAVER 在 10 月 27 日公告，Brookfield 將透過特殊目的公司，計畫投入最高 90 億美元採購 GPU、資料中心等資產，再向 NAVER Cloud 提供算力；初期規劃 2027 年上半年投入 55 MW、2028 年擴至 200 MW。NAVER 並為子公司最長 8 年的使用費義務提供保證，相關公司預期仍納入其合併報表。這種模式可減輕初期資本壓力，但不代表 NAVER 不再承擔長期付款與需求風險；90 億美元也不是已完成支出。

＊Microsoft 傳不續租 Oracle 部分舊款 GPU 算力，IREN 交付時程延後

《Bloomberg》11 月 6 日引述知情人士指出，Microsoft 近月陸續停止使用 Oracle 提供的部分 AI 雲端算力，並未續租採用較舊世代 NVIDIA GPU 的租用合約。這屬媒體報導，不能解讀為 Microsoft 已全面終止與 Oracle 的合作。Oracle 則表示，包含較舊 GPU 在內的 AI 基礎設施需求仍然強勁，Microsoft 尚未公開詳細說明個別合約。

另一家供應商 IREN 在 11 月 5 日公布財報，確認 Microsoft 要求調整資料中心網路設計，加上供應商時程因素，使原定 2026 年底達成超過 40 億美元的年度經常性營收能力目標，改至 2027 年 1 月，最晚可能延至 2 月。IREN 表示 Horizon 1 已開始為 Microsoft 提供服務。這項 40 億美元指的是已簽約、已取得資金支持的年化營收能力目標，並非目前已實現的年度營收。兩起事件反映 AI 算力採購對硬體世代與交付條件的要求正在提高。

＊OpenAI 新模型找出 81 項 Firefox 高危漏洞，並開發 948 個 Linux 攻擊程式

OpenAI 11 月 5 日公布資安研究模型 GPT-6 Cyber 的測試成果。研究人員利用模型，在 Firefox 發現 81 項先前未知、經 Mozilla 列為高嚴重性的漏洞，並提供可重現的證據與修補建議；Mozilla 已針對其中許多問題發布修補程式。模型另外重現了 1,724 項 Linux 核心漏洞，並針對其中 948 項開發出可運作的漏洞利用程式。兩組數字分別來自不同軟體與研究任務，不應混為一談。

OpenAI 依自身準備度框架，將 GPT-6 Cyber 的資安能力評為「Critical」，高於前代模型的「High」。在衡量模型能否利用指定漏洞的 ExploitGym 測試中，成績由 32.1% 提升至 48.5%。公司強調相關能力主要提供經驗證的防禦研究人員使用，並設定授權與使用界線。對企業而言，AI 正縮短發現漏洞、驗證攻擊路徑與提出修補建議的時間，但上述成果來自研究環境，不能直接等同一般攻擊者已具備相同能力。

＊Counterpoint：第三季 DRAM 營收年增 369%，三星以 38% 市占領先

研究機構 Counterpoint Research 11 月 5 日發布 2026 年第三季記憶體市場估算，指出全球 DRAM 營收年增達 369%，接近 2,000 億美元。三星電子（Samsung Electronics）以 38% 的營收市占居首，SK 海力士（SK hynix）與美光（Micron）分別約為 29% 與 21%。Counterpoint 認為，AI 加速器、資料中心與伺服器需求帶動價格大漲，是本季市場擴張的主要因素；這些數據屬研究估計，並非各家公司合併財報的直接加總。

研究也指出，當季 DRAM 位元出貨量季增約 4%，遠低於營收增幅，顯示主要成長動能來自售價而非供貨量同步暴增。一般 DDR 與 LPDDR 記憶體價格上漲速度甚至超過高頻寬記憶體，使 HBM 在整體 DRAM 營收中的比重反而下降。新廠短期難以量產，研究預期供應仍可能吃緊。對伺服器、工控與終端設備採購商而言，記憶體成本和交期可能持續壓縮硬體預算。

＊日本動支約 100 億日圓強化資安，AI 掃描漏洞與網路救援隊列重點

日本政府 11 月 6 日在內閣會議決定，從 2026 年度預備金動支約 100 億日圓，因應企業與政府機關接連遭遇網路攻擊及個資外洩。其中約 20 億日圓用於運用 AI 檢查政府資訊系統漏洞，約 41 億日圓投入警察網攻偵辦設備與人才，另約 38 億日圓用來強化數位廳系統防護。這是已通過的預算配置，相關新措施仍有設置與執行時程，不能全部視為已經上線。

根據《Associated Press》報導，日本還計畫在 11 月底前組成由經濟產業省推動的資安專家團隊，運用 AI 偵測弱點，並推動由政府與民間專家合作的網路救援隊，協助受攻擊企業初步應變。政府同時研議如何降低外洩資料被二次利用的風險，但網站封鎖等措施仍涉及法律與通訊秘密爭議。這次政策訊號顯示，日本正把資安從個別企業的防護工作，擴展為公共資源與跨部門協作課題。

＊Tesla 擬縮減 Cybertruck 產量轉向 Cybercab，Optimus 人形機器人同步推進

Tesla 執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）11 月 6 日表示，公司打算在 2027 年中左右縮減德州超級工廠的 Cybertruck 生產，將部分產能轉向自動駕駛計程車 Cybercab。《Reuters》引述市場資料指出，美國 2025 年 Cybertruck 銷量約 2.02 萬輛，比 2024 年減少 48%。目前尚未確定 Cybertruck 是否會全面停產。

Tesla 同時推進 Optimus 人形機器人，但這與 Cybercab 是不同產品及產線計畫，不能把 Cybertruck 釋出的產能直接視為轉給 Optimus。根據 Tesla 10 月財報，Optimus 已在加州 Fremont 啟動初期生產，德州相關廠房仍在建設。Cybercab 已在奧斯汀投入小規模付費載客服務，但仍面臨安全合規審查與擴大營運的挑戰。這次產能調整顯示，Tesla 正將投資重心逐步轉向自動駕駛與機器人，兩項新業務能否形成穩定收入，仍待市場驗證。

＊Toyota 明年成立機器人專責組織，整合工廠技術加快商業部署

日本豐田汽車（Toyota Motor）11 月 5 日公布組織調整，將於 2027 年 1 月 1 日成立全公司層級的 Toyota Robotics，由執行役員暨生產長志賀武文（Takefumi Shiga）兼任負責人。新單位將整合原本分散在不同部門的機器人研發人員、製造技術及應用功能，並直接受到公司層級監督。Toyota 將機器人列為未來業務的重要支柱，希望把汽車製造現場累積的工程能力，延伸至更廣泛的機器人應用。

這項調整強調從實際產線需求出發，結合開發部門與製造現場的問題，推進機器人的實用化、商業化及現場部署。對製造業而言，能否解決特定作業流程、與既有設備整合，以及持續維護和改善，往往比展示動作能力更重要。官方公告並未提出人形機器人出貨數量、營收目標，或宣稱已達成大規模商業部署。

articles.title: Pmtbox adds Coupons.com Founder Steven Boal to its Board
articles.excerpt:
The Utah-based merchant payments platform said Boal brings two decades of fraud and payments infrastructure experience from Coupons.com and CashStar.

The post Pmtbox adds Coupons.com Founder Steven Boal to its Board appeared first on The Fintech Times .

pmtbox , the Utah-based enterprise commerce platform that consolidates payments, risk intelligence and transaction data for merchants, has appointed Steven Boal to its board of directors. Boal founded Quotient Technology , better known as Coupons.com , in 1998 and led it as chief executive and board chair for 24 years through its listing on the New York Stock Exchange . He also founded digital gifting firm CashStar , which was acquired by Blackhawk Network in 2017. 

The appointment follows April’s $15 million seed round led by Tandem Ventures , reported at the time to be the largest seed raise in Utah in the past decade. Boal joins Tandem founding partner Alex Bean and pmtbox founder Wayne Hamilton on the board.

 Experience where money changes hands 

Boal’s relevance to pmtbox extends beyond capital markets credibility. At Coupons.com, his team spent years building the fraud controls and print security that persuaded consumer goods manufacturers, including Procter and Gamble , Unilever and Clorox , to accept digital coupons in place of paper. At CashStar, his co-founder on that board journey was Pete Kledaras , now co-founder and chief technology officer of pmtbox, who built CashStar’s payments and fraud management infrastructure. A notable feature of that platform was acting as the risk-bearing merchant of record for 350 global retailers, absorbing liability for high-risk digital transactions on behalf of clients including The Home Depot and CVS/pharmacy .

That shared history between Boal and Kledaras is central to the announcement. “I was in Maine building CashStar’s payments infrastructure while Steven chaired the company from Mountain View, so I’ve seen how he operates when real money is on the line,” said Kledaras. “Merchants have spent years treating fraud and chargebacks as a cost someone else sets for them, and as an annoying hurdle for consumers. Steven understands why that has to change.”

Boal framed the commercial problem pmtbox is trying to solve in direct terms: most merchants treat payments as a rate negotiated once, then discover that fraud, chargebacks and disputes make the real cost substantially higher, often without realising how conversion rates are simultaneously being eroded.

Market context and regulatory backdrop

The problem pmtbox is addressing is genuine and growing. Card-not-present fraud and chargeback abuse have both risen as digital commerce has expanded, and merchants operating across multiple payment processors and fraud tools routinely lack a unified view of their true transaction economics. The merchant-of-record model that CashStar pioneered is one architectural response; unified commerce platforms that aggregate payments, risk data and dispute management into a single layer are another.

The competitive landscape for merchant payment infrastructure is dense. Stripe , Adyen and Checkout.com each offer risk tooling alongside acquiring, often at scale, while a newer cohort of fraud-specialist vendors competes for the risk intelligence layer separately. For pmtbox, the differentiation claim rests on giving merchants direct control over their own data and economics rather than delegating risk decisions to a processor or gateway. Whether that proposition commands enterprise contract values will depend on the depth of integrations and the loss rates it can demonstrably improve.

In the regulatory dimension, US merchants face ongoing pressure from card scheme chargeback thresholds, and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has signalled continued interest in disputes and resolution processes. Any platform that claims to reduce merchant fraud exposure is operating in a space where regulators and card schemes are also actively setting the rules.

Boal currently serves as chief executive and board chair of Matia Mobility , a medical device firm based in Salt Lake City, and has been a guest lecturer at the Stanford Graduate School of Business .

The post Pmtbox adds Coupons.com Founder Steven Boal to its Board appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: Ripple Price Analysis: Could XRP Crash to $1.00 Next Week as Sellers Remain in Control?

XRP’s rebound has given way to another sharp selloff, with the price falling toward $1.16 after losing a key support zone. Sellers retain control across both timeframes, while the next major demand area is approaching below.

Ripple Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

The daily chart shows a clear continuation of XRP’s bearish structure. The recent recovery into the $1.30–$1.34 supply zone was aggressively rejected, triggering a breakdown beneath the $1.24–$1.28 support area. Several consecutive bearish candles have since carried the price toward $1.16, with little sustained buying response.

The next significant demand zone sits around $1.09–$1.14, corresponding to the base of August’s strong advance. This area could attract buyers and produce a relief bounce, but a reversal would require stronger follow-through than the recent candles have shown. A sustained breakdown below $1.09 would expose the broader $0.99–$1.03 support zone around the August lows.

On the upside, the broken $1.24–$1.28 region is now an important potential resistance area. Recovering it would ease immediate downside pressure, although the $1.30–$1.34 supply zone remains the more significant barrier to a broader structural improvement. Until these levels are reclaimed, rebounds remain vulnerable to renewed selling.

 

XRP/USDT 4-Hour Chart

The four-hour chart highlights a failed breakout above the descending channel’s upper boundary. Ripple briefly advanced into the $1.30–$1.34 supply zone before reversing sharply, falling back inside the channel and breaking through the consolidation base near $1.25.

The subsequent sequence of lower highs and lower lows confirms strong bearish momentum. Price is now consolidating narrowly around $1.16, but this pause has yet to produce a meaningful bullish structure shift. The nearby $1.15 low is the immediate downside reference, followed by the $1.09–$1.14 demand zone. The descending channel’s lower boundary currently passes through approximately $1.12, adding technical confluence within that area.

For a recovery to gain traction, Ripple first needs to overcome the recent lower highs around $1.18–$1.20. Sustained acceptance above this region could support a rebound toward $1.24–$1.28, where former support overlaps with the descending channel’s upper boundary. Until then, the limited response near the lows keeps another move toward the lower demand zone in focus.

articles.title: BTC Price Analysis: Key Support Levels to Watch as Bitcoin Enters a Crucial Week
articles.excerpt:
Bitcoin’s recovery toward $81K has been sharply rejected, sending the price back to the lower edge of its daily demand zone. With Bitcoin consolidating near $75.9K, buyers face another important test while futures activity shows signs of heating up. Bitcoin Price Analysis: The Daily Chart The daily chart shows Bitcoin remaining below the ascending channel’s […]

Bitcoin’s recovery toward $81K has been sharply rejected, sending the price back to the lower edge of its daily demand zone. With Bitcoin consolidating near $75.9K, buyers face another important test while futures activity shows signs of heating up.

Bitcoin Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

The daily chart shows Bitcoin remaining below the ascending channel’s midpoint after an unsuccessful attempt to reclaim it. The latest rebound toward $81K ended with a strong bearish candle, reinforcing the sequence of lower highs that has developed since the September and October peaks.

The asset is now hovering near the bottom of the $75K–$78K demand zone. Although this area has attracted buyers on several occasions, the latest reaction has been limited, with small candles forming following the aggressive selloff. This indicates temporary stabilization, but there is little evidence of a convincing reversal so far.

A sustained daily close below $75K would weaken this demand zone and could extend the correction toward the ascending channel’s lower boundary, currently around $72K–$73K. Alternatively, buyers need to recover $78K to improve the immediate outlook. A subsequent reclaim of the $80K–$81K region and the broken channel midpoint would provide stronger evidence that the correction is losing momentum.

 

BTC/USDT 4-Hour Chart

On the four-hour timeframe, Bitcoin is trading within a descending channel. The recent rally reached the channel’s upper boundary inside the $79.8K–$82K supply zone before reversing sharply. This rejection confirms that sellers continue to defend both horizontal supply and descending trendline resistance.

The subsequent decline carried BTC into the $74.9K–$76.3K demand zone, where it is now consolidating near the channel’s lower boundary. This confluence could support a temporary rebound, but the narrow consolidation and lack of strong bullish follow-through leave the short-term structure fragile.

A sustained recovery above $76.3K would be the first sign of relief, potentially allowing a move toward the recent consolidation area around $77K–$78.5K. However, a broader reversal would require Bitcoin to overcome the descending channel’s upper boundary and reclaim the $79.8K–$82K supply zone.

Conversely, acceptance below $74.9K would signal that buyers have failed to defend the September demand area. A simultaneous breakdown beneath the descending channel could accelerate the decline toward the lower daily support region.

 

Sentiment Analysis

The Futures Volume Bubble Map classifies futures volume conditions into cooling, neutral, heating, and overheating regimes. The latest observations show heating conditions around $75.8K–$76K, following another heating reading near the failed recovery around $80.5K.

The appearance of heating signals during the latest decline suggests increased futures participation as Bitcoin approaches support. However, volume alone does not establish whether this activity represents fresh short positions, defensive hedging, or buyers attempting to absorb the selloff. The latest bubbles also remain in the heating category rather than overheating.

Combined with the bearish price structure, this activity makes the current demand zone particularly important. Rising participation alongside a confirmed support breakdown could accompany further downside volatility. If buyers instead reclaim $76.3K and build sustained upward momentum, the same increase in activity could mark a contested support defense. For now, the bubble map highlights an active decision area without confirming capitulation or a bottom.

 

The post BTC Price Analysis: Key Support Levels to Watch as Bitcoin Enters a Crucial Week appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: XRP on Wall Street: Evernorth Reveals a Huge RLUSD-XRP Link
articles.excerpt:
The report from Evernorth comes amid heated debates online abou the role of XRP.

The Nasdaq-listed company built around an actively managed XRP treasury has released a detailed report on the XRP Ledger’s push into tokenized finance.

The data suggests that while RLUSD has become an increasingly important dollar-denominated settlement asset, its growth is not necessarily coming at the expense of XRP.

RLUSD Growth Runs Through XRP

 CryptoPotato reported yesterday on the heated debate online between some XRP Army members, who claim that Ripple’s leadership has not taken any steps to support the cross-border token’s price valuation. Evernorth’s report also takes a side but tries to explore the question from a different angle.

It said that approximately $400 billion in real-world assets and nearly $300 billion in dollar stablecoins have now been tokenized globally, but only around $39 billion can currently be traded, settled, or pledged directly on the chains where they reside. The thesis is that the next phase of tokenization will be less about simply recording assets on-chain and more about making those assets usable.

XRPL has made substantial progress on that front, as tokenized value on the network has grown from $1.76 billion in February to over $5 billion as of October 20. This puts the Ledger at sixth place among all networks and fourth among public blockchains, said Evernorth. Meanwhile, the number of accounts issuing new Multi-Purpose Tokens rose from four in January to 24 in October, and 98 MPTs were issued in a record month.

Here’s where things get more interesting for the XRP Army. In 2024, only 10.5% of XRP trading on XRPL’s native DEX involved stablecoins or fiat-backed tokens. That figure jumped to 50% in 2025 and has reached 86% so far in 2026. Moreover, Evernorth said 92% of the $1.65 billion worth of RLUSD swapped on XRPL’s native exchange this year traded against XRP.

 
“The dollar isn’t taking liquidity away from XRP. It trades against XRP,” the report argued .

Wall Street Experiment Grows

Evernorth began trading on Nasdaq under the XRPN ticker on October 12 after completing its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II. It entered the public market with approximately 473 million XRP and roughly $300 million in gross cash proceeds.

The company later selected Ripple, Coinbase, Kraken, and BitGo to help deploy that treasury through institutional strategies rather than simply holding the tokens passively. More recently, it arranged an equity facility with Cantor Fitzgerald that could raise approximately $80 million, with additional XRP purchases listed among the possible uses of the capital.

articles.title: Republicans saw Indian Americans as ‘natural conservative voters.’ But Trump’s second term undid the gains as their support for Democrats shot up
articles.excerpt:
Trump gained ground with Indian Americans in 2024, but his immigration politics and MAGA racism reversed that.

In 2024, Donald Trump appeared to make inroads with Indian Americans, a traditionally Democratic voting bloc. He won the support of 30% of Indian Americans that year, up from 22% in 2020, according to a report published on Nov. 2 by the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace. Its charts show that up until January of this year, GOP support was increasing among Indian women and men aged 40 and older. 

But two years into Trump’s second term, and those gains vanished ahead of the midterms. Just 19% of the 1,000 Indian American adults surveyed from Oct. 7 to Oct. 27 by Carnegie intended to vote for the Republican in their House district, compared to 62% intending to vote for the Democrat. In Senate races, Democrats held a similar advantage over Republicans at 63% to 21%.

The reversal coincided with the Trump administration’s crackdown on legal immigration through H1-B visa restrictions , increasingly vocal anti-Indian rhetoric from some Republicans, and renewed concerns about the rising cost of living , contributing to the GOP’s declining appeal to even the Indian Americans it began winning over. 

Devesh Kapur, a professor of South Asia studies at Johns Hopkins University who co-authored the Carnegie report, told Fortune that economic concerns drew Indian Americans toward Trump in 2024, when voters were frustrated by inflation and the rising cost of living under Joe Biden. 

But those same anxieties, compounded by Trump’s immigration politics and a rise in anti-Indian racism, helped turn Indian American voters away again. 

“It’s a combination of these three factors,” he said. 

A blatant example of what Kapur refers to as the “racist rhetoric in the MAGA crowd” came in September, when Bo French, the GOP candidate for Texas’s railroad commissioner, posted a photo on X of a crowd of South Asian students celebrating a University of Texas at Austin football victory. 

“I heard UT graduation this year looked like this,” French wrote. “I didn’t believe it. The problem is now obviously far worse than anyone imagined.”

While members of his party like Sen. John Cornyn condemned the post, its existence revived Indian Americans’ concern that Republicans don’t fully welcome the community. 

Amrita Bhasin, the CEO of AI-powered supply chain platform Sotira, told Fortune that more vocal anti-South Asian rhetoric by political figures pushed away Indian American voters more than changes to immigration policy alone.  

“I actually don’t think the racism is any worse than it was pre-Trump,” she said. “What’s different now is that politicians and people in power feel comfortable saying racist things out loud, specifically about South Asian people.”

In her view, Trump proposing a $103,265 surcharge on companies hiring workers with an H1-B visa in August also played a role. H1-B visa holders generally can’t vote, but Indian Americans may have relatives, friends, or colleagues whose ability to work in the country depends on the program. 

Indians represent 71% of all H1-B visa approvals and have a strong presence in tech jobs and other highly skilled professions, so these restrictions send a message that they don’t belong, Bhasin said.  

“I think the H-1B is part of it, but really the H-1B is a symptom of a bigger issue,” she said. “When you see that this work is not being respected in the same way, it feels like the Republicans maybe are not on the side of Indians.”

 Religion as another wedge 

Republicans have long believed Indian Americans should be receptive to their platform. David Frum, a former speechwriter for George W. Bush, called Indian Americans “natural conservative voters ” because of their high incomes, educational backgrounds, and entrepreneurship. 

Indian journalist and now Council on Foreign Relations senior fellow Sadanand Dhume penned a 2012 essay for the conservative American Enterprise Institute saying that “interests, values, and history all suggest that the natural political home for Indian-Americans is the GOP.”

But Kapur said the “growing grip” of evangelical Christianity in the GOP has limited its appeal to Indian American voters. The Carnegie report found nearly one in three Indian American Christians (31%) identified as Republicans, compared with 21% of Hindus, 10% of Muslims, and just 8% of those with no religious affiliation. 

“Since the majority are not Christian, that alone becomes a singular sort of impediment,” Kapur said. “There’s no way to get around it.”

The tension over religion surfaced notably in Texas politics. In 2023, Democratic state lawmaker James Talarico pointed to the potential alienation of Hindu students during a legislative hearing on a GOP bill requiring public schools to display the Ten Commandments.

“How do you think it makes a Hindu student feel to have a poster in every classroom that says ‘thou shall not worship any God before me’?’ he asked .

Three years later, Talarico beat GOP candidate Ken Paxton to become the first Democrat to win a U.S. Senate seat in Texas since 1988 . In Fort Bend County, which includes the Houston suburb of Sugar Land and its sizable Indian American community , Talarico won 63% of the vote compared with Paxton’s nearly 35%, according to county election returns .

But Indian Americans voting against Republicans in the midterms doesn’t mean they did it out of stronger loyalty to Democrats. About 35% of Indian Americans who planned to vote Democrat in the midterms said they were motivated by opposition to Republicans, rather than support for Democrats, per the Carnegie report . 

“Anger or feeling of antipathy towards the Republican Party was clearly an important factor over and above the support for the Democrat Party per se,” Kapur said.

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: 幣安何一提醒：打折 U、柬埔寨收的帳別轉進來，會遭執法凍結
articles.excerpt:
幣安共同創辦人何一 11 月 8 日在 X 提醒，「朋友打折的 U」「緬甸做生意的錢」「柬埔寨收的帳」等資金不要轉進幣安，關聯地址早已被標記，打進來會面臨執法凍結，幣安沒有解凍權限。

這篇文章 幣安何一提醒：打折 U、柬埔寨收的帳別轉進來，會遭執法凍結 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

幣安共同創辦人何一 11 月 8 日在 X 發文 ，點名五種資金來源，請用戶不要轉進幣安：「朋友打折的 U」「親戚從鏈上打過來的幣」「緬甸做生意的錢」「柬埔寨收的帳」，以及「朋友的錢從帳號過了一下」。

 

 
请各位注意“朋友打折的U”，“亲戚从链上打过来的币”，“缅甸做生意的钱”，“柬埔寨收的帐”，“朋友的钱从账号过了一下”等场景，这类资金请不要转到币安。…
— Yi He (@heyibinance) November 8, 2026 

 

何一：髒錢進幣安前，關聯地址就已被標記

何一寫道：「幣安有嚴格的全球合規標準，這類對合規團隊來說很容易識別，關聯地址在髒錢進入幣安前已經標記。」

她說，這類資金打進來會面臨執法凍結，「普遍案情複雜，案子週期比較長，幣安沒有解凍權限」。貼文最後一句是「互相理解，互相尊重」。

貼文裡的「打折的 U」，指的是比市價便宜賣出的 USDT。何一沒有說明這則提醒是針對哪一起案件，也沒有公布相關凍結的數量或金額。

凍結由執法機關申請，中國警方另有專用入口

依幣安的 執法機關請求系統 說明，政府與執法機關可透過專用平台提出調閱或協助請求，幣安會逐案審查，依使用條款與適用法律配合。緊急案件可標記為「Exigent」，幣安會立即處理。

這套系統分成兩個入口，一個給全球執法機關，另一個專供中國執法機關註冊使用。

義大利北部一家號稱歐洲首家的比特幣實體店，11 月 27 日將是最後一天營業。店家說 9 年來從沒替客人保管過一毛錢，仍拿不到 MiCA 執照。 （前情提要：歐盟 MiCA 法全面上路「淘汰 9 成機構」！Coinbase、OKX、Kraken 成贏家，幣安未能如期拿牌） （背景補充：幣安法國年底清退所有帳戶，因未獲 MiCA 授權） 歐洲號稱第一家比特幣實體店的 Comproeuro，11 月 27 日（週五）將是最後一天營業，原因是拿不到歐盟 MiCA（加密資產市場監管法）規定的執照。這家店位在義大利北部 Trentino 地區的 Rovereto 市，2017 年 12 月開張，店名模仿義大利街頭常見、專門收購黃金的「Compro oro」小店：那種店是拿舊東西換現金，而這家是拿歐元換比特幣。 店家說，9 年來從沒替客人保管過一毛錢，卻被當成銀行來管。 替店家發聲的 Marco Amadori，是當地比特幣收款機新創 inbitcoin 的共同創辦人，也是 Comproeuro 背後的推手。他接受義大利地方媒體 il Dolomiti 採訪時說：「這 9 年來，我們從沒替客人保管過一歐元或一枚比特幣，但我們拿不到 MiCA 執照。」 沒碰客人的錢，為什麼被當銀行？ Amadori 表示，歐盟的法律寫得很糟，義大利的解釋更糟。via Rialto 這家店被當成銀行看待，要繳一筆只有義大利才有的 2 萬歐元規費，還有其他制度費用，付的卻是店家根本沒在做的託管服務。所謂託管，就是客人把錢或比特幣交給業者代管，這家店從頭到尾沒做過這件事。 他用了一個比喻：「為了繼續營業，我得替一筆我從沒保管過的資金找託管人。這就像規定麵包師傅必須自己擁有麥田，只因為市場是替 Barilla（義大利最大麵食集團）寫的。」 至於整體比例，Amadori 說，在 OAM（義大利代理商與仲介機構登記處）登記的加密業者約有 150 家，只有 8 家拿到 Consob（義大利證券交易委員會）會同義大利央行核發的執照，比例略高於 5%，Comproeuro 不在其中。他強調，店家不是因為違規才走到這一步，而是「對一家街坊小店來說，這張執照的規模根本不對」，合規成本在第一位客人進門前，就吃光所有利潤。 其實這家店也早就不能買賣比特幣。2025 年 12 月以前，客人可以在這裡買賣比特幣，店家不經手保管；12 月之後只剩諮詢與教學，這項服務也只到 11 月底，門市就跟著一起收掉。 不碰客人資產，就一定拿不到執照嗎？ 根據 ESMA（歐盟證券及市場管理局）的 MiCA 業者名冊，11 月 3 日更新版顯示，總部在義大利、由 Consob 核發執照的加密業者共有 10 家，包括 Banca Sella 銀行、Young Platform、Conio 等。其中 8 家獲核發的業務含託管，另外 2 家登記的服務只有兌換，沒有託管。 換句話說，不做託管照樣可以拿到執照，卡住小店的比較像是付不付得起合規成本，也就是 Amadori 說的「規模不對」。MiCA 的立意是保護投資人：大型業者手上握有客戶的資產，一旦出事，就是大規模的損失，所以規定訂得嚴。 問題在於，同一套成本落到街坊小店身上，負擔的輕重完全不同。 Amadori 說，他寫信給義大利國會，沒有結果。他認為，這套為「手上握著幾十億他人資產的大型業者」寫的規則，被不分大小地套在一個刻意什麼都不保管的小櫃檯上；民眾沒有因此更安全，只是失去一個原本就在保護他們的模式。 相關報導 MiCA 大限剩兩週！83% 歐洲加密平台恐出局，合規巨頭「贏家通吃」 歐盟 MiCA 登記再加 6 家德國銀行，德國 CASP 授權 79 家續居龍頭 Bitpanda co-CEO：MiCA 讓歐洲客戶更信任託管，但執法是最大問題 加密之城》瑞士盧加諾「從麥當勞到百年餐館」都支持BTC支付，還能比特幣繳稅 MiCA「一證通行27國」遇挑戰：法國公開警告監管套利風險〈號稱歐洲第一家比特幣實體店月底關門：9 年沒保管客人一毛錢，仍拿不到 MiCA 執照〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 美財政部制裁加拿大 8 家匯兌商：涉替伊朗換幣洗錢、毒梟金流也入列
articles.excerpt:
美國財政部依第 13902 號行政命令，把 8 家註冊於加拿大的貨幣服務業者列入制裁名單，指其替伊朗把里亞爾換 […]

〈 美財政部制裁加拿大 8 家匯兌商：涉替伊朗換幣洗錢、毒梟金流也入列 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

美國財政部依第 13902 號行政命令，把 8 家註冊於加拿大的貨幣服務業者列入制裁名單，指其替伊朗把里亞爾換成加密貨幣、繞過美元體系；名單中多家同時經手加拿大毒梟的毒品金流。 （前情提要：美財政部切斷 MEXC 與美國金融系統相關金流！指出 167 億美元非法活動） （背景補充：美財部制裁伊朗四大加密交易所！Nobitex 首當其衝，佔全國一半交易量） 美國財政部外國資產控制辦公室（OFAC）在美東時間 11 月 6 日宣布，依第 13902 號行政命令，將 8 家註冊於加拿大的貨幣服務業者列入制裁名單。根據美國財政部公布的制裁內容，這些公司替客戶把伊朗里亞爾與其他貨幣兌換成數位資產，讓涉及伊朗的國際交易得以完成，等於替德黑蘭開了一條不經過美元體系的資金通道。 這些業者的數位資產地址，除了與受制裁的伊朗交易所往來，部分更直接連上伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）相關地址。美國財政部長貝森特在書面聲明中表示，加拿大不能成為替伊朗政權及其代理勢力提供制裁規避服務的避風港，財政部會在世界任何地方追查並切斷伊朗政權的金融通道。 這波名單是代號「Operation Economic Outcast」行動的最新一波。該行動在 2026 年 8 月啟動，主軸是切斷支撐伊朗政權與 IRGC 的經濟命脈，其中加密貨幣被美國財政部認定為德黑蘭規避制裁的首選工具。 8 家業者分布安大略與卑詩兩省 這輪被指定的 8 家實體，多數以「匯兌」為招牌，同時兼做數位資產買賣： 名單裡的 8 家實體分布在安大略省與卑詩省。卑詩省的有 1380079 BC Limited（以 Amin Exchange 名義營運）與 NIA Nations Currency Ltd；其餘 6 家都在安大略省，包括 Diverse Trade Inc（Million Exchange）、Top PC Technician Inc（與 1380079 BC Limited 關係密切、共用 Amin Exchange 品牌）、2397639 Ontario Ltd（Farah Exchange）、CCC Inc、B Galaxy Inc（Cryptoyal）與 Darvish Exchange。 這些公司多數以「匯兌」為招牌，同時兼做數位資產買賣。 財政部對其中幾家的行為描述相當具體。Million Exchange 主打把伊朗里亞爾換成其他貨幣、並替客戶管理數位資產，其地址曾把數十萬美元等值的資產送往 IRGC 或恐怖主義相關地址；NIA Nations 除了數位資產兌換，還宣傳可把錢從伊朗匯到加拿大，其地址與 IRGC 相關地址及 Nobitex、Wallex、Ramzinex、Bitpin 都交易過；Darvish Exchange 主打用比特幣換里亞爾，交易物件包括 Nobitex、Wallex、Aban Tether Exchange 與 Shelbit。 Amin Exchange 這一支則同時踩到伊朗與毒品兩條線。其地址曾收到 Shelbit 送來的數十萬美元，另在多倫多、溫哥華、蒙特婁等地清洗數以百萬計美元的毒品所得。 Farah Exchange 的地址與 Shelbit、Wallex 有數十萬美元往來，也把數千美元的數位資產送往恐怖主義相關地址、並把數百萬美元等值的數位資產轉給加國毒梟。CCC Inc 的地址同樣收過恐怖主義相關地址轉來的數十萬美元，而 B Galaxy 的 Cryptoyal 品牌直接以「不限金額」的伊朗貨幣兌換數位資產作為賣點。 加密貨幣與現金之間的實體接觸點 美國財政部在這份名單裡，把加拿大定位成伊朗資金鏈的關鍵節點。官方說明直指，加拿大境內有數百家貨幣服務業者，同時透過現金移轉系統與「現金換數位資產」兩條路徑，讓資金進出伊朗；被指定的這 8 家讓受制裁的伊朗實體繼續使用其服務，等於替伊朗政權保留了資助恐怖主義與代理勢力的財源。 財政部也提到，加拿大與國際媒體過去已多次點出部分業者的制裁規避與資恐風險，這些公司卻仍在營運，甚至多次變更公司名稱與地址以規避查緝。 這也解釋了為什麼 OFAC 要把戰線拉到匯兌商。交易所本身有下架壓力、也受到各國監管關注，但匯兌商規模小、登記鬆散，往往就是法幣與加密資產之間唯一的實體接觸點。只要這類通路還在，伊朗就能在美元體系之外維持對外支付能力。 前奧運單板選手也牽連其中 這波制裁的另一條線是毒品金流。財政部點名加拿大籍毒梟 Ryan Wedding，他曾是奧運單板滑雪選手，利用溫哥華與多倫多一帶的貨幣兌換業者清洗數以十億計的毒品所得：他派快遞員把大批現金送到這些公司，公司再把錢換成數位資產匯往海外。 Wedding 已於 2026 年 1 月落網，但在被送進美國拘留前，他已透過這批今天被指定的業者移轉了數百萬美元等值的數位資產，其中 Amin Exchange 的溫哥華分支、Million Exchange 與 Farah Exchange 都被點名經手。 這波行動由財政部金融犯罪執法局（FinCEN）與加拿大金融交易與報告分析中心（FINTRAC）共同協調，並結合美國緝毒局（DEA）的毒品調查能量。 制裁生效後，這 8 家業者在美國境內、或由美國人持有與控制的財產全部凍結，且被制裁實體直接或間接持股達 50% 以上的公司一併凍結；未經許可，美國人不得與其進行任何交易。違反美國制裁的美國與外國人，都可能面臨民事與刑事責任，民事部分還採嚴格責任原則。 相關報導 加密貨幣交易所Zedcex與Zedxion遭美國制裁！因協助伊朗規避制裁，被視為國家經濟的一環 川普證實再打伊朗防空，美軍懸賞 2000 萬美元找核情報 伊朗加密貨幣交易所 Nobitex 資金外流量暴增 700%！美軍空襲後Crypto化身「資金逃生門」〈美財政部制裁加拿大 8 家匯兌商：涉替伊朗換幣洗錢、毒梟金流也入列〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

美國財政部 FinCEN 與聯準會聯手撤回 2020 年的跨境轉帳申報草案，原擬把門檻從 3,000 美元砍到 […]

〈 終於喊卡！美財政部撤回 250 美元申報草案，跨境轉帳門檻維持 3,000 美元 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

美國財政部 FinCEN 與聯準會聯手撤回 2020 年的跨境轉帳申報草案，原擬把門檻從 3,000 美元砍到 250 美元，如今維持 3,000 美元不變。 （前情提要：FinCEN 撤回加密混幣器新規！川普去管制 agenda，兩項爭議草案直接砍） （背景補充：監管趨嚴！FinCEN提案：超過250美元「美國跨境轉帳」都要提交審查，包含數位貨幣） 美國財政部金融犯罪執法局（FinCEN）與聯準會理事會週五聯手撤回 2020 年提出的「旅行規則」（Travel Rule）草案。這份草案原本要求金融機構對 250 美元以上的轉帳蒐集匯款人資訊，等於把申報門檻從 3,000 美元大幅下調，讓更多日常交易得把交易雙方身分一起帶著走。官方公告確認撤回，跨境轉帳的申報門檻確定維持 3,000 美元。 FinCEN 在撤回檔案裡寫明理由：這份提案擱置已經超過五年，可轉換虛擬貨幣產業的樣貌跟當年不同，重新徵求公眾意見會更有幫助。官方措辭是，「各機關相信，未來任何與可轉換虛擬貨幣相關的紀錄儲存規則與旅行規則修正，都應該放在這些最新發展的脈絡下重新評估，才能確保修法切合目的」。 這份草案的爭議從 2020 年一路延燒。FinCEN 當年主張，不法分子愈來愈常利用小額轉帳搬移非法資金，因此要把美國境外的資金移轉申報門檻往下砍；Coin Center 等加密倡議團體立刻警告，門檻從 3,000 美元降到 250 美元，等於讓更多日常交易落入「沒有搜尋令依據的金融監控」。 撤回訊息傳出後，產業團體迅速表態。加密創新委員會（Crypto Council for Innovation）執行長 Ji Hun Kim 在宣告中直言撤回是「正確的決定」，並說這項提案過去幾年沒有推進是有充分理由的，把跨境轉帳門檻從 3,000 美元降到 250 美元，會為機構帶來不當負擔。 長期反對該案的 Coin Center 也在部落格發文回應，表示樂見草案被撤回。文章直言，連同上個月財政部撤回的「非託管錢包」與加密混幣規則，「這些撤回加起來，等於為幾項長期懸而未決的提案正式畫下句點，那些提案原本會讓《銀行保密法》已經相當廣泛的金融監控體系再擴大一圈」。Coin Center 同時點出，機關這次明確表示，未來若有類似提案，必須重新提供公眾評論的機會。 市場影響：門檻維持 3,000 美元，美國站在最寬鬆的一端 對交易所與合規業者來說，最直接的結果是跨境資訊傳遞門檻維持 3,000 美元，不需要為了 250 美元以上的小額轉帳重建整套通報作業。美國境內的旅行規則原本就適用於金融機構之間的資金移轉，這次被收回去的是「跨境」那一段的加嚴版本，對業者來說暫時少了一層負擔。 把鏡頭拉遠，美國這次的選擇在主要市場裡屬於最寬鬆的一端。歐盟對加密轉帳不設免申報門檻，任何金額都要附上轉出人姓名、帳號與地址或出生日期。 台灣自今年 10 月起分兩階段匯入旅行規則，第一階段適用境內 8 家虛擬資產服務商之間的移轉，不分金額都要傳遞收付雙方姓名與錢包地址，單筆超過新臺幣 3 萬元（約 926 美元）時，自然人還須補上出生日期與住所地址。 韓國則在 8 月拍板修法，廢除 100 萬韓元（約 700 美元）的免申報門檻，讓註冊業者之間的轉帳一體適用。同一段時間裡，三個市場都在往前推進，美國反而退回了原點。 後續觀察：重寫版本與國際落差是兩個看點 第一，撤回不等於永久放棄。FinCEN 在檔案裡保留了空間，明說未來若要再提出類似修正，必須重新給公眾評論的機會，門檻之爭只是暫緩，不是終局。接下來要留意的是，下一版會不會改走「針對高風險管轄區或特定交易型別」的窄口徑設計，而不是再一次全院落式下砍門檻。 第二，國際標準仍在原地。防制洗錢金融行動工作組織（FATF）對虛擬資產服務商的資訊傳遞要求沒有跟著鬆綁，美國放寬自家跨境門檻後，與歐盟零門檻、台灣逐筆傳遞、韓國取消免申報門檻的方向明顯分岔。對在多個市場落地的交易所來說，合規系統還是得按最嚴格的那一套來建，短期內不會因為華盛頓鬆手就降低成本。 相關報導 臺灣虛擬貨幣轉帳「超過3萬」要登記生日住址！金管會 Travel Rule 十月上路 韓國廢除 700 美元免申報門檻：所有加密轉帳全面適用 Travel Rule 為什麼傳統監管體系在區塊鏈上淪為了笑話？〈終於喊卡！美財政部撤回 250 美元申報草案，跨境轉帳門檻維持 3,000 美元〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 徐明星：請暫時避免從 MEXC 入金 OKX，資金可能被凍結審查
articles.excerpt:
OKX 在 FinCEN 命令生效前就先收緊：用戶從 MEXC 轉入的 USDT 恐被標為潛在風險地址、審查三 […]

〈 徐明星：請暫時避免從 MEXC 入金 OKX，資金可能被凍結審查 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

OKX 在 FinCEN 命令生效前就先收緊：用戶從 MEXC 轉入的 USDT 恐被標為潛在風險地址、審查三天，徐明星公開呼籲請用戶暫時避免從 MEXC 入金 OKX。 （前情提要：美財政部切斷 MEXC 與美國金融系統相關金流！指出 167 億美元非法活動） （背景補充：MEXC 回應美國斷金流命令：稱營運正常、啟動反洗錢獨立審查） 請注意！，現在從 MEXC 把幣轉進 OKX，入帳可能會被暫緩、送進風險審查。OKX 創辦人暨執行長徐明星今（8）日清晨也在 X 上寫道，請大家「暫時避免直接從 MEXC 向 OKX 轉入資金」，來自相關交易所的資金可能被凍結審查，相關帳戶也可能被進一步調查。 目前美國財政部金融犯罪執法局（FinCEN）對 MEXC 下的命令，其實還沒生效。命令要等刊登在聯邦公報後 30 天才算數，截至 11 月 8 日上午，聯邦公報還查不到這份命令。 很抱歉给您带来了不便。我们理解，您可能是一位无辜受到此次事件波及的用户，我们也非常理解您的困扰和不满。 请大家暂时避免直接从 MEXC 向 OKX 转入资金。 OKX 对… https://t.co/2CV921sET0 — Star_OKX (@star_okx) November 7, 2026 被卡住的錢是怎麼回事？ 事情的起點是一名 X 用戶，他在昨（7）日貼文表示，自己把 USDT 從 MEXC 帳戶轉到 OKX，兩筆分別是 848.8 USDT（TRC20 網路）與 11.7 USDT（ERC20 網路），都因「可能來自高風險地址」卡在風險審查。 他寫道：「我們不是罪犯，僅是在交易所之間轉自己的資產。」並質問凍結依據與何時能拿回錢。 貼文附上的兩張 OKX 截圖，狀態分別是「On hold」（暫緩）與「處理中」，說明文字寫著入金來自潛在風險地址、正在風險審查，11 月 10 日之後仍未入帳再聯絡客服，也就是三天審查期。其中 848.8 USDT 那筆在 OKX 土耳其站。 徐明星引用這則貼文，向可能被無辜波及的用戶道歉。他說，OKX 把 FinCEN 對 MEXC 的特別措施，比照類似金融制裁的審慎標準處理；FinCEN 雖給了 30 天過渡期，OKX 仍選擇提前大幅加強風控。 FinCEN 命令全文依美國《打擊俄羅斯洗錢法》第 9714 條，認定 MEXC Global 為「主要洗錢關注」機構，指控 2021 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月至少 167 億美元可疑非法金流，並禁止美國法規下的金融機構與 MEXC Global 之間任何資金傳輸，明文包含加密貨幣的收與送。 命令還沒生效，OKX 為什麼先動手？ 徐明星的說法是寧可提前收緊，不等到期限。命令全文則有另一個線索：FinCEN 自己承認，合規的機構即使努力限制曝險，仍可能收到來自 MEXC Global 的加密貨幣；註腳寫明，幾乎沒有現成方法能在收到之前「拒收」加密貨幣轉帳。 所以命令讓機構依個案酌情處理，例子包括資金從 MEXC 出來後在個人錢包放了很久，或機構的風控流程不允許把錢退回 MEXC。換句話說，錢一轉出去就到了接收方手上，接收方要設防，做法之一就是入帳後先扣住審查。 已經被卡住的人怎麼辦？ 目前沒有官方答案。OKX 沒有發正式公告，唯一的說法就是徐明星的中英文兩則貼文。除了截圖上的三天期限，資金最後退回還是放行，沒有更多說明。 回覆區的質疑集中在三點：法律都還給 30 天緩衝，OKX 卻提前動手；OKX 有沒有事先公告，從 MEXC 提領會被凍結；合規搶跑能理解，但被誤傷的散戶，總得有明確的處理時限或原路退回的管道。不過也有網友認為嚴格是好事，不沒收就行。 其他交易所呢？根據吳說區塊鏈彙整的社群回報顯示，MEXC 提出的幣轉到幣安、Gate 時，也有人遇到入帳延後、被要求配合合規審查，甚至被列入退款審查。Bitget Wallet 的做法更直接，證實旗下卡片儲值目前拒收經識別來自 MEXC 的資金。 不過交易所這邊多是零星個案，各家並未統一公告規則；截至 11 月 8 日上午，幣安與 Gate 都還沒有正式說法，受限範圍多大、錢最後怎麼處理，目前都不清楚。 相關報導 OKX帳戶與Tornado互動一律封殺！社群憂惡意投毒攻擊，徐明星怎麼說？ Bitget 制裁名單再擴張！出入金涉 HTX、Cryptomus 等近 20 個受制裁實體直接終止帳戶 前 FBI 探員 Yaroch 認罪！他從 35 樁聯邦調查的錢包憑證搬走約 247 萬美元，還問 ChatGPT 該不該去葡萄牙買酒莊。 （前情提要：FBI 探員死背「敵人錢包助記詞」轉走 100 萬鎂自肥，最後良心不安自首） （背景補充：美國政府持超20萬枚比特幣！僅次中本聰、幣安成最大巨鯨） 美國司法部維吉尼亞州東區聯邦檢察官辦公室 11 月 5 日的認罪公告指出，前 FBI 探員 Patrick Steven Yaroch 當天在亞歷山卓聯邦地院承認電信詐欺與洗錢兩項罪名，法官 Patricia Tolliver Giles 接受認罪。 他利用職務取得的加密貨幣錢包憑證，從 35 樁聯邦調查中搬走約 247 萬美元，最高可判 20 年徒刑，量刑庭期訂在 2027 年 3 月 4 日。 依認罪協議的事實陳述，Yaroch 2017 年至 2025 年初在 FBI 波士頓分局任職，負責一個以敵對國家為目標的調查小組，2025 年 2 月到 2026 年 7 月 31 日轉調總部反情報與間諜部門，期間能接觸 FBI 辦案時蒐集到的加密貨幣憑證。 最晚從 2024 年 12 月開始，他把這些憑證用在別的案子上：被盜的錢包有些屬於其他調查的當事人，有些屬於敵對國家行為者，甚至有一個是 FBI 為了執行任務自己創設的錢包。公開法院檔案沒有點名是哪幾個國家，檢方統計他前後做了約 100 筆詐欺轉帳，動用 35 樁不同調查取得的憑證，不法所得約 247 萬美元（2,474,380.66 美元）。 轉帳的手法沒有技術含量。他把得手的加密貨幣換成另一種幣，再拆成多筆交易層層洗過，藉此掩蓋資金來源、性質與所有權。依認罪協議，2025 年 11 月 25 日到 2026 年 1 月 13 日之間，他把其中約 9.3 萬美元轉進自己名下帳戶，再於帳戶之間搬動，拿去繳信用卡費、車貸與其他借款。檢方形容他偷錢的物件「不分是誰」：其中一筆只轉了 81 美分，另一筆卻超過 58 萬美元；依法院檔案，這批錢有一部分來自 FBI 正在偵辦的至少 10 名金融犯罪受害者。 前 FBI 探員 Yaroch 案：認罪時承認的不法所得約 247.4 萬美元，明顯高於 2026 年 8 月被捕時對外公布的近 100 萬美元。資料來源：美國司法部 EDVA 認罪公告，動區自繪 問 ChatGPT 該去哪裡生活，答案是一座葡萄牙酒莊 除了還債，這筆錢還有另一個用途：海外新生活。 認罪協議的事實陳述寫道，Yaroch 曾問 ChatGPT 兩件事，一是怎麼讓投資報酬最大化、二是歐盟該住哪個國家，結果聊天機器人建議他到葡萄牙買一座酒莊。今年 6 月 15 日，他授權葡萄牙律師代他向葡萄牙稅務與海關總署辦理登記、取得稅籍編號，並代領他財務入口網站的密碼，接著安排 9 月前往葡萄牙的行程。 案子會曝光，也不是鏈上分析抓到的。 他向司法部國家安全司一名前同事吐露自己做了「很糟的決定」，隨後向 FBI 總部自首；依法院宣誓書內容，他向調查人員說，他對 FBI「不能或不願」對敵對國家的加密錢包採取行動感到挫折，決定自己動手。（但是收進自己口袋） 自首兩天後，調查人員搜尋他的住處，查扣一個 Trezor 硬體錢包、三本護照與一張寫著助記詞的紙條，並把約 92.5 萬美元從他的 Kraken 帳戶與 Sui 鏈借貸協議 Suilend 的資金，移轉到政府控制的錢包。 破口在能合法碰到憑證的人 這起案件最值得省思的地方，是它跟市場主流討論的加密犯罪風險完全走反方向。 今年大家緊盯的是外部攻擊與釣魚，而 Yaroch 沒有駭進任何系統，他偷的是自己單位辦案檔案裡的助記詞，鏈上分析一路沒有示警，最後是他自己走進 FBI 總部才曝光。對任何大量持有扣押或代管加密資產的機關來說，這代表風險核心不是防火牆，而是「誰能合法看到種子短語」這條內控線：只要憑證被能接觸檔案的人記下或抄下，它就跟資產本身等值，事後追蹤鏈上金流幾乎沒有阻攔效果。 相關報導 暗網藥市 Empire Market 創辦人重判 40 年！沒收 1,230 枚 BTC 價值 1 億美元 FBI 定調幣安63億鎂竊案是北韓幹的，籲業界團結封鎖600個洗錢地址 臺中警方偵辦加密詐騙「意外爆自家人收賄！」員警洩民眾個資牟利〈FBI 探員良心發現自首：偷走 247 萬鎂加密貨幣、曾問 ChatGPT 買酒莊出逃〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 加密卡 Gnosis Pay 資料外洩：卡號、住址與綁定錢包地址曝光
articles.excerpt:
穩定幣簽帳卡 Gnosis Pay 公告 11 月 3 日偵測到自有品牌卡片系統遭入侵，用戶姓名、住址、卡號與綁定錢包地址外洩，資金未受影響；這是它今年第二起資安事件，6 月曾被盜 150 萬美元。

這篇文章 加密卡 Gnosis Pay 資料外洩：卡號、住址與綁定錢包地址曝光 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

穩定幣簽帳卡服務 Gnosis Pay 發生資料外洩。Gnosis Pay 在官方部落格 公告 ，11 月 3 日監控系統偵測到有人未經授權存取 Gnosis Pay 自有品牌卡片的系統，部分客戶資料外洩。

Gnosis Pay 表示用戶資金沒有受到影響，但沒有公布受影響的客戶人數。

住址跟綁定的錢包地址一起外流

加密資產追蹤工具 Rotki 創辦人 Lefteris Karapetsas 11 月 6 日在 X 上 貼出他收到的通知信，列出外洩的資料包括他的姓名、完整住家地址、卡號，以及帳戶綁定的所有錢包地址。

他寫道：「你們本來就已經失去我這個用戶了，但至少可以保護好我的資料。」

Gnosis Pay 說，已寄信給每一位受影響的客戶，逐一說明各自被取走哪些資料，也已通報合作夥伴、資料保護主管機關與發卡機構。

兩小時內開始圍堵，12 月 20 日關閉舊系統

依官方說明，資安團隊在偵測到入侵後兩小時內開始圍堵，之後更換了受影響的安全憑證並修補漏洞。這次外洩只涉及 Gnosis Pay 自有品牌卡片的系統，這套系統原本就預定 12 月 20 日退役；替其他企業發行白牌卡的企業平台沒有受到影響。

舊系統退役前，Gnosis Pay 加強監控卡片交易與錢包活動，所有線上刷卡一律加做 3D 驗證（3D Secure），也安排專業監控，留意外洩資料有沒有被拿去濫用。

Gnosis Pay 提醒用戶，接到任何關於 Gnosis Pay、合作 App 或卡片的電子郵件、簡訊、電話或信件都要提高警覺，就算內容寫出你的真實資料或真實消費紀錄也一樣，不要點擊裡面的連結。官方不會要求用戶提供助記詞、私鑰、PIN 碼或完整卡號，也不會用郵件或電話要求轉移資金。官方也提醒，透露自己的住址或持幣狀況時要小心。

今年 6 月才被盜 150 萬美元

這是 Gnosis Pay 今年第二起資安事件。依 Gnosis 的 事後檢討報告 ，6 月 1 日攻擊者利用卡片錢包所用軟體模組的漏洞，盜走共 150 萬美元，另有約 30 萬美元無法動用。Gnosis 自行吸收損失，用戶資金全數補回。

Gnosis Pay 讓用戶用連結自己加密錢包的 Visa 簽帳卡刷穩定幣消費。加密卡每月的消費規模，見鏈新聞 先前報導 。

這篇文章 加密卡 Gnosis Pay 資料外洩：卡號、住址與綁定錢包地址曝光 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: Circle Q3 Revenue Rises 17% to $865M on ARC Token Sale as Reserve Income Falls
articles.excerpt:
Buyers in Circle's $222 million ARC presale hold repayment rights if Arc has not moved to proof-of-stake by May 2028, a May filing shows.

Circle’s (CRCL) third-quarter revenue and reserve income rose 17% to $865 million, as per the company’s latest Q3 earnings report. The total included $182 million from the presale of ARC, the native token of Circle’s Arc blockchain. The presale lifted other revenue to $207 million from $29 million a year earlier.

Reserve income, the interest Circle earns on the assets backing USDC, fell 8% to $658 million. Circle said the decline came mainly from a 61 basis point drop in its reserve return rate, to 3.5%. Average USDC in circulation grew 8% to $73.3 billion, which partly offset the lower rate.

Presale Comes With Repayment Rights

Net income from continuing operations rose 5% to $226 million. Adjusted EBITDA climbed 85% to $317 million, which Circle said reflected the presale revenue and lower distribution costs.

As CryptoPotato reported, the company agreed in May to sell 740 million ARC tokens at $0.30 each, a sale that raised about $222 million from investors led by a16z crypto.

The token agreements give buyers repayment rights in specified cases. Those rights apply, among other cases, if Arc has not switched to a proof-of-stake system by May 8, 2028. Circle launched Arc’s public mainnet on September 16, and the release says the network is working toward that switch in 2027.

Likewise, the stablecoin giant kept its 2026 forecast for other revenue at $310 million to $330 million, which counts presale revenue.

Circle Cuts 5% of Staff

A footnote in the release discloses a workforce reduction of about 5%, and that reduction cost $9.1 million in third-quarter restructuring charges, mostly severance and notice-period payments. The reduction was designed to “better align its structure” with its operating model and strategic priorities.

Adjusted operating expenses, which exclude restructuring and stock-based pay, rose 13% to $139 million. Circle kept its full-year range for that measure at $570 million to $585 million.

The post Circle Q3 Revenue Rises 17% to $865M on ARC Token Sale as Reserve Income Falls appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: Ethereum Price Analysis: ETH Must Reclaim These Levels to Reverse Bearish Momentum
articles.excerpt:
Ethereum is struggling to regain momentum after a failed breakout attempt earlier this week sent the price back toward $2.2K. Ethereum is struggling to regain momentum after a failed breakout attempt earlier this week sent the price back toward $2.2K. With ETH now trading around $2.25K, buyers are defending a short-term support level that could decide whether the market stabilizes or extends its correction. Meanwhile, network activity between user wallets has dropped sharply from its mid-2026 highs, offering little sign of renewed demand.

Ethereum Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

Ethereum’s daily chart shows the asset breaking below the ascending channel that carried the price higher from the June lows near $1.5K. After topping out close to $2.8K in late September, ETH declined through the channel’s midpoint and eventually lost its lower boundary in late October. This indicates a clear deterioration in the medium-term structure.

The subsequent rebound retested the $2.5K supply zone, which now overlaps with the broken lower trendline, but sellers rejected the move. This reaction shows that this former support has turned into resistance. ETH is now holding the $2.2K support level, which marked the late-October low, and buyers would first need to reclaim $2.5K to restore the bullish case and bring the $2.8K-$3K supply zone back into view.

Conversely, a decisive daily close below $2.2K would confirm the channel breakdown and expose the $1.85K demand zone, the consolidation area that preceded the sharp August rally. Below that, the $1.5K region remains the major floor, as it formed the base of the entire recovery that began in June.

 

ETH/USDT 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart shows ETH trading within a descending channel since early October, with a series of lower highs and lower lows. Earlier this week, the asset briefly pushed above the channel’s upper boundary and rallied toward $2.5K, but the move was quickly reversed by a sharp sell-off back inside the structure. This fake breakout trapped late buyers and reinforced the bearish short-term outlook.

ETH is now consolidating just above the $2.2K demand zone, which has already absorbed two sell-offs in the past weeks. If buyers continue to defend it, a relief bounce toward the upper channel boundary around $2.3K could follow. Reclaiming that trendline and then $2.5K would be required to invalidate the failed breakout and target the $2.7K order block.

On the other hand, a breakdown below $2.2K would likely push the price toward the channel’s lower boundary near $2K. Repeated tests of this support increase the risk of failure, and the short-term structure continues to favor sellers unless the upper trendline is decisively broken to the upside.

 

On-Chain Analysis

The Transactions Between EOA metric on CryptoQuant tracks the number of transfers between externally owned accounts, which are wallets controlled by private keys rather than smart contracts and exchanges. Its 30-day exponential moving average serves as a proxy for direct peer-to-peer usage of the network, with rising readings generally reflecting stronger user activity.

The indicator rose steadily from roughly 400K in 2024 to around 600K by late 2025, before surging toward 1.3M in the first half of 2026. Notably, this expansion occurred while ETH fell toward $1.5K, showing that activity and price do not always move in the same direction. It also showed a mass change of hands for ETH when the price lows were forming. Since August, the metric has collapsed to approximately 560K, close to its lowest levels of the past year, and is only now stabilizing.

This reading should be interpreted with caution, as transaction counts can be inflated or deflated by low-value automated transfers and fee conditions, and do not directly measure buying demand. Still, the sharp contraction in wallet activity, combined with the loss of the daily channel, suggests that the market lacks a strong catalyst. This leaves the $2.2K support level as the key line for buyers to defend.

 

 

The post Ethereum Price Analysis: ETH Must Reclaim These Levels to Reverse Bearish Momentum appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: XRP Community Tensions Boil Over as Ripple CEO Defends Token’s Role
articles.excerpt:
Brad Garlinghouse has pushed back against narratives claiming that XRP is not Ripple's main focus anymore.

Tensions within the vast XRP community have intensified following a highly emotional post directed at Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse and CTO Emeritus David Schwartz, which was later reposted by several other accounts.

The criticism centers on a familiar concern among some holders: that Ripple’s rapid expansion into stablecoins, treasury products, and institutional finance has not translated into stronger demand or price performance for XRP.

XRP Community vs. Ripple Execs

The original post came from an XRP commentator known on X as Fiduciary Ledger 17, who accused Ripple’s leadership of benefiting from years of community support while allegedly diminishing XRP’s economic importance in favor of RLUSD and other enterprise products.

The X user argued that XRP holders stood behind Ripple through years of regulatory uncertainty and the lengthy SEC battle, only to see the company increasingly emphasize products that do not always require the token. The commentator went considerably further, claiming that the community deserves to see XRP reach a “fair value” of $15-$20 or more and calling on the company’s executives to take steps to support that outcome.

It’s worth noting that these claims represent the commentator’s own views, which were reposted by others, but do not carry any evidence that Ripple has deliberately suppressed XRP’s price.

Nevertheless, the frustration reflects a genuine disconnect visible throughout the entire year. Ripple has announced partnerships with giants like Coinbase, Robinhood, BNY, Standard Chartered, and other major institutions, while RLUSD has expanded rapidly across different markets. XRP, on the other hand, has struggled in the market despite that corporate momentum, currently trading 66% below its all-time high in July last year.

Garlinghouse Pushes Back

Garlinghouse continues to frequently reject the idea that Ripple has abandoned XRP. At Swell 2026, he doubled down on the idea that XRP is the company’s “North Star,” adding that Ripple wants to pursue only initiatives that benefit the asset. However, he also acknowledged that the cross-border token will not necessarily be the best tool for every transaction, with fiat or RLUSD sometimes making more sense depending on the use case.

His argument is essentially that Ripple would rather win a portion of a much larger financial market using XRP alongside stablecoins and traditional currencies that insist every product exclusively uses the token. That message is consistent with comments he made earlier this year, when he said that “all roads lead back” to XRP. In a separate tweet, Garlinghouse argued that RLUSD does not compete with XRP as it has a different purpose.

The company’s own latest business update continues to mention XRP directly. It recently said that its goal is to modernize financial infrastructure using digital assets such as XRP while connecting payments, custody, stablecoins, treasury, and capital markets.

The post XRP Community Tensions Boil Over as Ripple CEO Defends Token’s Role appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: We Are Still Early: One Brutal Wall Street Session Erased More Than the Entire Crypto Market
articles.excerpt:
The S&P 500 alone wiped out roughly $3 trillion in market value within a single trading session.

Just a day after the post-election relief rally, Wall Street suffered one of its most violent sessions in years, with S&P 500 companies wiping out roughly $3 trillion in market value as the Nasdaq posted its steepest daily drop since the pandemic era.

The scale of the destruction also produced a rather intriguing comparison: more value disappeared from US stocks in one session than the entire cryptocurrency market is currently worth.

Wall Street Calamity

According to the Kobeissi Letter, the S&P 500 alone lost about $3 trillion in market capitalization during Thursday’s session, roughly $750 billion per hour from the opening bell. Dow Jones Market Data independently put the loss at around $2.9 trillion, the largest single-day wipeout on record for the index’s constituents. Nasdaq companies lost another $2.5 trillion, while the Magnificent Seven shed just over $1 trillion.

The scale of the selling was particularly relentless, as analysts from the KL pointed out that the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq staged at least five intraday rebound attempts, including a single rally of 1.7%, but every one was sold. The leading index failed to print a single positive one-hour candle during the entire session.

The Nasdaq 100 ultimately dumped by around 6.4%, while after-hours futures pushed the 12-hour decline to 7.1%. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 was subsequently about $5 trillion below its October peak.

 

What’s interesting about today’s price action is how consistent the selling was.

As shown in our below analysis, there were at least 5 intraday rallies in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100.

One of these intraday rallies was as big as +1.7%!

All of these rallies were sold without a SINGLE green 1-hour candlestick in the S&P 500.

Today’s trading session will be referenced for years to come.

— The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter) November 6, 2026 

 

Kobeissi argued that the collapse appeared more technical than fundamental. Concerns about AI profitability, capital expenditure, and potentially tighter regulation had already spooked investors, while record leverage amplified the move once sentiment turned. US leveraged ETFs attracted roughly $15 billion in October, which was the largest rolling-month inflow in at least two years.

Still Early

Here’s the interesting perspective for the crypto market, which also tumbled hard for its size. CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap put the entire crypto market cap at somewhere between $2.55 trillion and $2.65 trillion. As expected, Bitcoin holds the lion’s share, around 60% of either amount.

In other words, the $2.9-$3 trillion erased from the S&P 500 companies in a single session exceeded the market value of every BTC, ETH, XRP, BNB, stablecoin, altcoin, meme coin, Trump coin, and all other coins combined.

Obviously, this doesn’t mean every crypto asset is undervalued, but it shows the digital asset market is still a fraction of its bigger brothers, despite major adoption news over the past few years.

The post We Are Still Early: One Brutal Wall Street Session Erased More Than the Entire Crypto Market appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: COLIBRIX ONE Taps Vivox AI for Automated KYB Merchant Onboarding
articles.excerpt:
The FCA- and MFSA-authorised payments platform will use Vivox AI's explainable agents to verify corporate documents and run sanctions screening on new merchants.

The post COLIBRIX ONE Taps Vivox AI for Automated KYB Merchant Onboarding appeared first on The Fintech Times .

COLIBRIX ONE , the payments infrastructure platform operated within the Mellifera group, has selected Vivox AI under a multi-year agreement to automate know-your-business checks across its UK and EU merchant base. The deal is designed to reduce the time compliance analysts spend processing document-heavy due diligence on new business customers without removing human sign-off from the process. 

Under the arrangement, Vivox AI’s explainable AI agents will handle corporate document verification, ultimate beneficial owner mapping, and sanctions and adverse media screening. Every AI-generated finding is traceable to its underlying source, and COLIBRIX ONE’s compliance team will review and approve each case before it is closed. The rollout covers merchant onboarding in the UK and EU, with plans to extend to ongoing monitoring and additional entity types in 2027.

 What the technology does 

Vivox AI’s agents draw on corporate registry data across more than 155 countries to identify ownership structures, shareholders and directors, then generate a full customer due diligence or enhanced due diligence report for analyst review. In an earlier deployment at international payments firm TransferMate, the company said due diligence time fell from roughly 60 minutes to under 15 minutes per case, with screening alerts declining by 86 per cent. Those figures come from Vivox AI’s own account of the TransferMate project and have not been independently verified.

 Tim Khamzin , founder and chief executive of Vivox AI, said: “AI agents take on the document-heavy due diligence work where every conclusion comes with a clear audit trail, so analysts stay in control and regulators can see exactly how a decision was reached. That is what makes AI usable in a regulated business.”

COLIBRIX ONE is authorised by the UK Financial Conduct Authority as an electronic money institution (FRN 927920) and holds a parallel authorisation through Mellifera Kartiera Limited from the Malta Financial Services Authority . Its product stack includes card acquiring for one-time and recurring transactions, multi-currency current accounts with dedicated named IBANs, and global payouts, with principal memberships at Visa and Mastercard.

 Regulatory and market context 

The timing reflects a specific pressure on payment platforms regulated under UK and EU financial crime frameworks. The FCA has tightened its expectations on anti-money laundering controls and merchant due diligence for e-money institutions in recent years, and the EU’s AML package, including the forthcoming AML Authority, will raise baseline obligations further across the bloc. For platforms that compete partly on onboarding speed, manual KYB on merchants with complex, multi-jurisdiction ownership structures is a genuine operational bottleneck.

The market for AI-assisted compliance tooling is expanding quickly. Established regtech vendors and a new generation of AI-native compliance firms are competing to automate the same document-heavy workflows, often positioning explainability and audit-trail quality as the differentiator that makes their products acceptable to risk functions and supervisors alike. COLIBRIX ONE’s choice of a dedicated AI compliance vendor rather than a bundled solution from its existing technology stack reflects a broader pattern among licensed payment firms: separating the compliance workflow layer from the core processing infrastructure in order to swap components as the tooling matures.

The key variable to watch in deployments like this one is whether the efficiency gains cited from the TransferMate reference hold across a larger and more varied merchant portfolio, particularly for merchants with layered holding structures in higher-risk jurisdictions, where beneficial ownership mapping is hardest and regulatory tolerance for errors is lowest.

The post COLIBRIX ONE Taps Vivox AI for Automated KYB Merchant Onboarding appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: Big Tech’s AI race will save small business owners time. It won’t find them customers
articles.excerpt:
The next customer is one introduction away.

Meta , Google, OpenAI and Anthropic are racing to become the small business owner’s AI assistant. Meta brought its Muse agent to small businesses in September. Anthropic and OpenAI now package tools aimed squarely at owners, and Google is building the same features into tools millions of them already use.

That competition is good for Main Street. But it’s a race to save owners time, and time isn’t what keeps them up at night. What keeps them up is where the next customer will come from.

A word on where I sit. I run Alignable, a network of 10 million small business owners, so I have a stake in this argument. Alignable also co-hosts small business AI training with Anthropic, one of the companies named here. Read what follows with that in mind. But I also have something the assistants don’t: 13 years of data on how small businesses actually find work.

Fifty beats 500

Start with where customers come from. In our surveys, members say about 85% of their customers come through referrals. Not ads, not search, not cold email. People who already trust them.

Across 35,000 local communities, our members have formed 226 million business connections. Most of them never become a relationship that sends work either way. The owners who grow through their networks aren’t the ones with the most connections. I’ve told owners for years that 50 warm relationships beat 500 cold contacts. That’s a rule of thumb from experience, not a number we’ve measured. But the owners who win do keep a small set of relationships active and leave the rest alone.

And most owners are sitting on more opportunity than they know. When members tell us what their ideal customer looks like, we can count how many of those businesses sit one introduction away: connected to someone the owner already knows. Among members whose ideal customers show up in their extended network, the typical one has about 190 of them a single introduction away. For one in four, it’s more than 600.

The next customer is rarely a stranger. They’re one relationship away, through someone the owner hasn’t talked to in months.

Those relationships aren’t random, either. In my experience, three kinds do most of the work: customers who talk you up, businesses that serve the same customer without competing with you, and a handful of people who open doors. The best referral partner usually isn’t a peer in your own industry. It’s the business your customer calls right before or right after they call you: the realtor and the home inspector, the accountant and the financial planner.

What a general assistant can’t see

Ask any of the big assistants how to get more referrals and you’ll get a solid list of best practices. Ask an assistant that sits on a map of business relationships and it can tell you something specific: three nearby businesses serve your ideal customer, one of them already knows two of your clients, and you haven’t spoken to your best referral partner in four months.

That’s the difference between advice and action. A general assistant can’t answer that question, because the answer lives in data it doesn’t have.

The early numbers bear this out. In Bluehost’s 2026 study of 350 U.S. owners, 78% said AI saves them time every week. But 43% have seen no change in revenue. Time saved only matters if it goes somewhere that pays.

Too often it goes into volume. Forbes recently told the story of Paul Birrell, a New Jersey owner whose automation loop sent roughly 400,000 emails in three days. His reaction: “I don’t have 400,000 customers.” Everything we see says growth comes from the opposite: judgment about the few people who matter.

Three kinds of AI, not one

AI will reach small business owners in three forms. The first is the personal assistant the giants are fighting over. It delivers time, and the assistants are converging fast.

The second is AI built into the systems that already hold the business’s own data. Intuit knows the books. Shopify knows the store. That AI delivers control: it can flag a cash crunch six weeks out or spot the product quietly losing money.

The third is AI built on the relationships between businesses: who knows whom, who serves the same customers, who sends work to whom. That’s the one that delivers growth, and it’s the one almost nobody is talking about. At Alignable, ours is called Allie.

The giants have real advantages, and they’ll connect to the other two kinds. Meta’s Muse already plugs into QuickBooks, Shopify and Stripe , and the others are adding similar connections. The open question is who the intelligence works for. Meta makes nearly all of its money selling ads, and an assistant built by an ad company will tend to find that the answer involves more advertising. The data that actually works for the owner describes how their business runs and who in their community can help it grow.

What owners should do now

Use a personal assistant every day. The time savings are real.

Then decide, in advance, where the reclaimed hours go. Put them on the calendar against the work that generates revenue, and the most neglected item on that list is relationships. Write down the 50 people most likely to send you business. Most owners can name 10 without trying. Those 10 are where AI should be pointing you.

There are about 36 million small businesses in the U.S. , and more than 80% of them have no employees. For those owners, AI isn’t a department upgrade. It’s a capability they never had. Owners should take the better tools the giants’ race produces. But the biggest gains won’t come from saving an hour. They’ll come from knowing which 50 relationships to spend it on.

 The opinions expressed in Fortune.com commentary pieces are solely the views of their authors and do not necessarily reflect the opinions and beliefs of Fortune . 

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: PayPal Urges Retailers to Show BNPL Earlier as Black Friday Nears
articles.excerpt:
PayPal research finds 67% of Christmas BNPL shoppers are more likely to add items to their basket when payment options appear on product pages.

The post PayPal Urges Retailers to Show BNPL Earlier as Black Friday Nears appeared first on The Fintech Times .

PayPal has published research ahead of the Black Friday and Cyber Monday peak, warning UK retailers that late disclosure of buy now, pay later options is costing them basket additions. The payments group says nine in ten UK adults are actively managing festive spending, and that visibility of instalment-payment options earlier in the shopping journey can materially shift conversion. 

The research, conducted by Morning Consult on behalf of PayPal between 4 and 10 September 2026 among 2,076 UK adults, found that more than half of Christmas BNPL shoppers (55%) would favour a retailer that shows the option on product pages over one that waits until the checkout step, where only 21% said they preferred to see it. Two-thirds (67%) said earlier visibility would make them more likely to add an item to their basket. PayPal also cited its own internal data showing an 11% uplift in PayPal payment volumes among merchants that introduced Pay Later messaging or a second checkout button, though it noted results may vary and the underlying merchant sample dated from March 2020 to September 2025.

 The BNPL placement argument 

The distinction between product-page and checkout-page disclosure is commercially significant. At checkout, a shopper has already decided in principle to buy; instalment framing at that point reduces friction but does not drive discovery. On the product page, showing a weekly or monthly cost alongside a headline price addresses affordability earlier, when the shopper is still deciding whether to proceed. For higher-consideration purchases, that reframing can be the deciding factor.

UK home fitness retailer JTX Fitness offered a case study in the release. Jamie Forshaw , head of marketing at JTX Fitness, said: “Showing customers their payment options while they’re still browsing can help them feel more confident about how they’ll manage the cost. When customers can see Pay Later from the product page onwards, more of them go from browsing to buying.”

 Sean Douglas , senior director of UK Large Enterprise at PayPal, noted that peak season pressure tends to put retailers in survival mode, but argued the data pointed to a more active opportunity: the 11% volume uplift, he said, could be the difference between meeting revenue targets and exceeding them.

 Market context and regulatory backdrop 

PayPal’s Pay Later sits within a BNPL market that is under active regulatory review in the UK. The Financial Conduct Authority has been developing a framework to bring point-of-sale credit products within the Consumer Credit Act perimeter, a process that has run for several years and is expected to introduce affordability check requirements, clearer pre-contract disclosure rules and new marketing standards. Once the regime is live, the question of where and how BNPL options are surfaced to consumers will move from a commercial optimisation decision to a compliance one.

The broader market for embedded BNPL includes Klarna , Clearpay (Afterpay) and Zilch , each of which also promotes early product-page integration to merchant partners. PayPal’s advantage in this space is distribution: its existing merchant acceptance network and buyer-side login reduce integration friction compared with a standalone BNPL provider. The research release is also a vehicle for directing merchants to PayPal’s Pay Later onboarding page, so the findings should be read in that commercial context.

The AI finding is a secondary data point worth watching. More than a third of respondents (35%) said they had used or planned to use AI for Christmas shopping, and 52% said they would use it specifically to find deals or compare prices. If AI-assisted browsing compresses the product discovery phase, the window in which payment messaging can influence a shopper may shift again, adding further complexity to where in the journey BNPL should appear.

The post PayPal Urges Retailers to Show BNPL Earlier as Black Friday Nears appeared first on The Fintech Times .

的既有合作，讓美國 Galaxy 使用者能用 Samsung Pay 替 Coinbase 帳戶入金，這次等於把 USDC 直接搬進手機錢包的第一層入口。 雙方的說法也指向同一件事。三星行動體驗（MX）事業部數位錢包團隊負責人 Woncheol Chai 表示，穩定幣有潛力讓全球資金移動更快、更簡單，三星希望 Galaxy 使用者不必面對傳統加密工具的複雜度就能用到；Solana 基金會主席 Lily Liu 形容，過去十年穩定幣已經證明技術可行，缺的是一條接觸主流使用者的路。官方新聞稿則把這項合作定位為原生把穩定幣帶進 8,200 萬台美國 Galaxy 裝置。 8,200 萬台手機，就是穩定幣最缺的那條通路 這場競賽的重心正在轉移。USDC 在 Solana 上結算快、成本低，技術面早已不是瓶頸，真正稀缺的是「不用再多下載一個 App」的接觸點。三星把 8,200 萬台手機直接變成穩定幣入口，等於替 USDC 開了一條電信商等級的分銷管道，這比多上架一家交易所更接近一般消費者。相較之下，Stripe 走的是支付業者路線，把穩定幣塞進商戶的收款流程，兩者搶的是同一個問題的不同端點；三星也表明下一步要探索線上與實體門市的穩定幣支付，並視各國法規把市場往外擴。 另一邊，發行端也在重新分配資源。USDC 發行商 Circle 第三季營收 8.65 億美元、年增 17%，成長動能已從單純的流通量轉向支付與新產品線；當手機廠把通路開啟，對發行量的意義會比多一個交易對更直接。 為什麼美國先上、紐約卻被排除 三星母國韓國沒有排在第一波，反而由美國先開跑，選址邏輯不難理解：監管確定性。紐約州被排除在外，反映的是州級執照與消費者保護門檻，這一州向來有自己的加密貨幣監理體系，不是聯邦法規鬆綁就能自動通行。對亞洲讀者來說，觀察點在於這套「手機內建穩定幣帳戶」的模式能不能複製：台灣、日本、韓國近兩年都在補穩定幣與支付的規範，卡點通常不在技術，而在誰可以保管資金、跨境匯款怎麼認定，以及消費者爭議怎麼處理。 後續觀察：支付場景、鏈上流量與擴張順序 接下來可以盯三件事。第一是支付場景能否落地，三星說要往線上與門市支付走，這一步會牽動商戶端與清算機構的態度；第二是 Solana 上 USDC 的流通結構，若手機端真的成為主要入口，鏈上轉帳量與活躍地址的成長曲線會是最直接的證據；第三是擴張市場的順序，尤其三星是否把這套模式帶回韓國與亞洲，那會決定手機廠自建穩定幣通路究竟是美國特例，還是產業新常態。 相關報導 articles.title: Something Big Is Coming for Pi Network This Month: Here’s What Pioneers Should Know
articles.excerpt:
The month will culminate with an event that comes with a $200,000 prize pool.

The team behind the popular project revealed the agenda for its upcoming Ecosystem Summit, scheduled for November 17-19.

The event will feature new platform announcements, technical demonstrations, developer discussions, ecosystem showcases, and direct appearances from co-founders Chengdiao Fan and Nicolas Kokkalis.

What Comes in November for Pioneers

The announcement shared by Pi Network on Friday indicated that the first two days of the summit will be streamed at scheduled YouTube Premiers at 8:00 AM PST / 4:00 PM UTC, while the third day will be dedicated to the launch of a new hackathon.

Day 1 will focus on the Developer Platform, ecosystem initiatives, and app showcases. The team said the broadcast will combine feature announcements with technical demos, developer integration walkthroughs, and discussions about what the network is already building.

Day 2 shifts the focus to AI and the broader Pi ecosystem, an area the team has increasingly emphasized in recent months. As reported recently, Pi added support that allows devs to use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursos, and Codex to prepare SoloHost applications for Pi Desktop.

The final day is likely to attract the most attention, as Pi will officially launch Pi Next on November 19. This is the project’s latest hackathon that comes with a 200,000 USDT prize pool for participating developers and startups. The team has positioned the event as another attempt to encourage builders to create applications that expand the network’s real-world utility.

Why It Matters

The Ecosystem Summit arrives at a particularly active period of technical developments for Pi Network. Recent updates have included a redesigned Developer Portal, token-price tracking inside Pi BlockExplorer, expanded PiVerify identity tools, and new AI-assisted app packaging for SoloHost. Pi Desktop 0.6.4 also made remote SoloHost access easier while introducing additional app-security protections.

Meanwhile, the project’s native token was hit hard by the overall market crash over the past ten days. PI traded above $0.o8 before the Binance hack last Friday, and its subsequent recovery was halted quickly following the Thursday calamity. The asset currently trades at $0.075, which is 97.5% below its all-time high, and only 6.2% higher than the all-time low marked four months ago.

Its market cap has declined to $850 million, making it the 65th-largest cryptocurrency by that metric on CMC.

The post Something Big Is Coming for Pi Network This Month: Here’s What Pioneers Should Know appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: 幣安法國年底關閉客戶帳戶，沒提幣者 11 月 29 日起收月費
articles.excerpt:
幣安法國寄信通知客戶，帳戶將在 2026 年 12 月 31 日關閉、已停止入金；11 月 29 日起帳上仍有資產的用戶每月收 0.025% 或 10 USDC 管理費。幣安至今沒有取得歐盟 MiCA 執照。

這篇文章 幣安法國年底關閉客戶帳戶，沒提幣者 11 月 29 日起收月費 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

幣安法國（Binance France）的客戶帳戶將在 2026 年 12 月 31 日關閉。法國加密媒體 Cryptoast 11 月 6 日取得幣安寄給客戶的信件，信中說明法國業務正在「有序停止營運」，目前已經不能入金。

還沒把資產提走的用戶，從 11 月 29 日起每個月要付一筆管理費。

年底前沒提走，帳戶視為閒置

依 Cryptoast 引述的信件內容，幣安寫道：「由於有序停止營運，您的 Binance France 帳戶將自 2026 年 12 月 31 日起關閉。」

信中也提醒，到 12 月 31 日還沒提走加密資產的帳戶，幣安會依使用條款把它視為閒置帳戶處理，可能包括把資產轉換、轉移或做其他處置。

11 月 29 日起月費 0.025%，最低 10 USDC

管理費是帳戶餘額的 0.025% 或 10 USDC，取較高者，所以餘額不多的帳戶每月至少要付 10 USDC。第一次扣款在 11 月 29 日後 3 天內，第二次在 12 月 24 日之後。

費用先從帳上的 USDC 扣，不夠再扣其他加密資產。如果餘額比應付費用還少，幣安會把剩下的餘額全部扣光。

幣安說明，在 11 月 29 日這個「計算日」之前把加密資產全部提走的帳戶，不會被收任何費用；用戶也可以隨時自行關閉帳戶。

幣安 7 月才把 MiCA 申請改押法國

這波關閉的起點是歐盟加密資產市場法規（MiCA）。MiCA 過渡期在 6 月底結束，沒有取得執照的業者不能再服務歐盟用戶，幣安至今沒有拿到 MiCA 執照。

幣安原本向希臘申請，6 月 24 日撤回後改向法國申請，見鏈新聞 先前報導 。當時幣安歐洲主管 Gillian Lynch 表示，公司對歐盟的長期承諾不變。

10 月《金融時報》報導，歐洲證券及市場管理局（ESMA）與法國等國監理機關，正在調查幣安援用「反向招攬」豁免、在沒有 MiCA 執照下繼續服務歐盟用戶的做法；幣安當時表示仍在積極爭取 MiCA 授權，見鏈新聞 先前報導 。

這篇文章 幣安法國年底關閉客戶帳戶，沒提幣者 11 月 29 日起收月費 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: 日本菸草（JT）俄國廠被普丁接管，股價暴跌
articles.excerpt:
普丁 11 月 5 日簽署總統令，把日本菸草（JT）4 家俄國製造公司交給俄國企業「臨時管理」。JT 股價 1 […]

〈 日本菸草（JT）俄國廠被普丁接管，股價暴跌 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

普丁 11 月 5 日簽署總統令，把日本菸草（JT）4 家俄國製造公司交給俄國企業「臨時管理」。JT 股價 11 月 6 日跌停、單日跌 19.3%，同日日經 225 指數跌 5.96%。俄國事業占 JT 調整後營業利益約 25%。前總統梅德韋傑夫在 X 上嘲諷「反正抽菸也會死」。 （前情提要：亞股血洗！韓股熔斷 海力士重挫 11%、日經打入熊市，AI 拋售潮延燒） （背景補充：美國派出核潛艇威脅俄羅斯！川普：梅德韋傑夫言論太挑釁，我只想阻止俄烏戰爭） 重點摘要 普丁簽令，JT 俄國 4 家工廠交俄企臨時管理 JT 股價 11/6 跌停 19.3%，日經同日跌 5.96% 俄國事業占 JT 調整後營業利益約 25% 日本菸草（JT）11 月 6 日在東京股市跌停，收在 6,269 日圓，約新台幣 1,297 元（依 11 月 7 日匯率換算）。單日跌 1,500 日圓，跌幅 19.3%。起因是俄羅斯總統普丁 11 月 5 日簽署總統令，JT 旗下 4 家俄國製造公司因此交給一家俄國企業「臨時管理」。 JT 前一天才收在 7,769 日圓、漲 5.23%，創下今年新高。據產經新聞報導，6 日開盤後賣單湧入，股價整天沒有成交。直到收盤，才依規定在跌停價撮合部分買賣。同一天日經 225 指數也重挫 3,643.13 點，跌幅 5.96%。大盤下跌拖累了 JT，但 JT 的跌幅是大盤的 3 倍多。產經新聞指出，賣單主要來自投資人擔心俄國事業對經營的衝擊。 俄羅斯聯邦安全會議副主席、前總統梅德韋傑夫（Dmitry Medvedev）也在 X 上嘲諷此事。他在台灣時間 6 日晚間 9 點 53 分用英文帳號發文，寫道「日本菸草的股價在俄羅斯資產依總統令交由一家俄國公司臨時管理後，創紀錄重挫 19.3%。這可真是件大事。反正抽菸也會死」 Japan Tobacco’s stock plunged by a record 19.3% after its Russian assets were placed under temporary administration managed by a Russian firm following the Russian president’s decree. That’s something! And smoking kills anyway — Dmitry Medvedev (@MedvedevRussiaE) November 6, 2026 接手的公司 9 月才註冊 據莫斯科時報報導，總統令指定「Industrial Assets」公司擔任臨時管理人，接管 JT 國際（JTI）在俄國的 4 家公司。報導引述獨立媒體指出，這家公司 9 月 16 日才註冊。老闆 Sergei Dremov 曾是庫爾斯克州聯邦安全局（FSB）官員。俄國有好幾家公司都叫 Industrial Assets，其中幾家參與過先前的外企接管案。 JT 在 6 日發布的官方聲明中確認，4 家製造公司已被置於臨時管理之下。JT 表示，集團在俄國一直遵守所有適用的法規與制裁。目前正在蒐集資訊，評估可行選項與對集團的影響。據產經新聞報導，這 4 家公司以生產紙菸為主，當地工廠沒有日籍員工。JT 也表示，這和俄國政府國有化或沒收不同，但後續發展仍無法預估。 普丁先前表示，這類接管是對西方制裁與凍結俄國國家資產的對等回應。他也說，條件合適時可以歸還控制權。據莫斯科時報整理，今年秋天被接管的外企還有德國 Metro、法國 Auchan、瑞士雀巢與物流商 FM Logistic。 日本政府要求撤回 日本財務大臣片山皐月 6 日上午在記者會上表示，「已透過外交管道等向俄羅斯政府抗議，並緊急要求撤回措施」。她說政府會與相關部會和 JT 密切合作，採取必要的對應。官房長官木原稔同日也表示，已要求俄方盡快撤回。 莫斯科時報指出，日俄關係近期明顯惡化。部分分析人士認為，莫斯科是想懲罰東京支持烏克蘭、並加入 G7 對俄制裁。10 月，俄國 FSB 以間諜罪名逮捕一名北海道新聞的日籍記者。北海道新聞與日本政府都否認相關指控。JT 表示，如果出現需要揭露的事項，會立即公告。 常見問題 日本菸草 JT 股價為什麼跌停 普丁 11 月 5 日簽令，把 JT 4 家俄國製造公司交俄企臨時管理。JT 隔天跌停 19.3%，收 6,269 日圓，同日日經跌 5.96%。 俄羅斯市場對日本菸草有多重要 據產經新聞，俄國事業占 JT 2025 年營收 10%、調整後營業利益 25%，2026 年第三季俄國市占約 35.5% 排名第一。 相關報導 韓國政府讓你凹單！豁免融資擔保率3個月「緩衝斷頭」，熔斷後反彈 普丁原則同意 11 月重啟俄烏美三方和談！地點擬在阿布達比，還喊話調解美伊 俄羅斯放行散戶買 BTC、ETH、USDT！11/17 生效，莫斯科交易所瞄準 12 月開盤〈日本菸草（JT）俄國廠被普丁接管，股價暴跌〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
