articles.title: 《原神》× 7-ELEVEN 限定聯動即將開跑！與可莉、布倫妮一同展開「提瓦特食光大冒險」！
articles.excerpt:
由 HoYoverse 開發、NIJIGEN 代理發行的開放世界冒險 RPG《原神》宣佈，與 7-ELEVEN 攜手打造的「提瓦特食光大冒險」限定聯動，將於 2026 年 11 月 11 日起登場。全台 7-ELEVEN 門市將化身為旅行者的冒險補給站，帶來專屬限定聯動美食、限定實體周邊以及限定遊戲虛寶，邀請全台旅行者與來自小魔女會的「可莉」、「布倫妮」一起，讓旅途冒險的滋味走進生活，在熟悉的街角留下新的「食光」記憶！

 

 

10 款限定主題包裝商品閃亮登場！虛寶「風之翼」驚喜亮相

　　活動期間，全台 7-ELEVEN 門市將全新推出 10 款《原神》限定聯動包裝鮮食商品，CITY TEA 現萃茶也將同步推出聯動主題杯；此外，凡購買限定聯動包裝鮮食商品、大燒包、大亨堡及 CITY TEA 現萃茶全品項，亦可參加本次滿額贈活動。只要在門市購買指定聯動商品達到指定金額，即可獲得遊戲虛寶獎勵，單筆消費金額滿 499 元，更可獲得聯動限定「風之翼：暇生—聚之翼」遊戲禮包兌換碼！

 

 

 

 

 

 

限定周邊獨家限時預購！滿額再贈限定名片與家具

　　除了豐富的美食體驗，本次活動更推出 6 款《原神》全新聯動周邊商品，並將於 2026 年 11 月 11 日上午 11:00 起，在全台 7-ELEVEN 門市獨家開放預購。預購條碼將於後續官方貼文圖片公布；預購開放後，出示圖片商品條碼給店員掃描，完成付款即可預購，並於指定時間至原預購門市取貨。單筆購買指定聯動周邊滿 499 元，即可領取限定名片、限定主題家具「午後一咖」等多重豐富好禮，讓這段「食光」也成為值得收藏的紀念！

 

 

旅行者集合！北中南「原神主題門市」全台限時展開

　　為了把提瓦特的冒險氣氛帶進熟悉的街角，本次特別於北、中、南三地精選特色門市，打造《原神》限定主題門市。主題門市將於 2026 年 11 月 11 日至 12 月 10 日開放，現場設有聯動專屬佈景，歡迎全台旅行者前往拍照打卡，將這場相遇留在冒險相簿中。

 

 台北 開寧門市 ：臺北市萬華區西寧南路 16 號 18 號 1 樓及 2 樓

 台中 秋紅谷門市 ：臺中市西屯區潮洋里朝富路 30 號 1 樓

 高雄 鑫漢王門市 ：高雄市鹽埕區港都里五福四路 265 號 1 樓

 

 

 

 

 

 

　　提瓦特食光大冒險」將於 11 月 11 日展開，歡迎各位旅行者親臨全台 7-ELEVEN 門市，與可莉、布倫妮一起，把提瓦特的溫暖帶進日常，讓旅途中的冒險時光，化為生活裡值得回味的「食光」記憶！

articles.title: Nexon全新MMORPG《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》預定11/25正式上市
articles.excerpt:
Nexon 於今（6）日宣布，由 GRAYGAMES 開發的全新 MMORPG《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》，將於 11 月 25 日晚上 11 點在韓國、台灣、香港及澳門同步正式上市。本作是以全球人氣網路小說與網路漫畫 IP《裝備仔》為基礎打造的 PC／手機 MMORPG，重現原作以裝備為核心的成長樂趣，並以玩家間的合作與競爭為主軸，規劃多元的遊戲內容。

Nexon 於今（6）日宣布，由 GRAYGAMES 開發的全新 MMORPG《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》，將於 11 月 25 日晚上 11 點在韓國、台灣、香港及澳門同步正式上市。本作是以全球人氣網路小說與網路漫畫 IP《裝備仔》為基礎打造的 PC／手機 MMORPG，重現原作以裝備為核心的成長樂趣，並以玩家間的合作與競爭為主軸，規劃多元的遊戲內容。

 

Nexon 已於 11 月 5 日舉辦線上發表會「OVER WORLD」，公開正式上市時間與主要遊戲內容。GRAYGAMES 製作人崔炳天與總監尹淳準親自登場，透過實際遊戲畫面，介紹裝備成長系統、戰鬥內容，以及跨伺服器交流與競爭系統，並公布上市後 6 個月的更新規劃。

 

 

 

發表會中也介紹了重現原作核心元素的成長與戰鬥系統。玩家可透過核心成長系統「OVERGEARED」，強化各裝備部位的欄位，提升角色能力值。戰鬥方面，玩家可運用效果會隨裝備成長程度改變的「超頻」，以及原作中的「神之手」，體驗多樣化的戰鬥方式。

 

此外，遊戲也提供可變更武器外觀與性能的「武器改造」，以及刻有製作者姓名的「簽名裝備」等系統，增添打造專屬裝備的樂趣。

 

 

 

大型合作內容與跨伺服器交流系統也同步亮相。除了由全伺服器玩家齊心抵禦魔物攻勢的「人魔大戰」，遊戲還將推出讓不同伺服器玩家相遇、組隊或進行 PvP 的「次元」系統。遊戲也計畫分階段導入「次元聯賽」，以所屬玩家的貢獻度加總，決定各伺服器的排名。

 

GRAYGAMES 製作人崔炳天表示：「在《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》中，玩家不只能透過裝備變強，還能與其他玩家合作、競爭，寫下專屬於自己的故事。」他也提到：「期待 11 月 25 日，玩家們能在《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》的世界中，展開全新的篇章。」

 

 

 

目前《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》已在官方網站、Google Play 及 App Store 開放事前預約。完成事前預約的玩家，正式上市後可獲得「花瓣兔（同行寵物）」、「煉金催化劑保證箱」10 個等多項獎勵。

 

更多《裝備仔：OVERGEARED》與線上發表會「OVER WORLD」的詳細資訊，請至官方網站及官方 YouTube 頻道查詢。

articles.title: 台灣角川2027台北動漫節首賣《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。(10)》《魔法偵探時崎狂三死亡證明》特裝版情報解禁！
articles.excerpt:
致命遊輪上的生存挑戰，與能夠倒轉時間的魔法懷錶，兩場步步驚心的對決同步上演！榮獲「這本輕小說真厲害！2024」新作部門第 1 名的生存遊戲話題作《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。 (10)》，以及《約會大作戰》作者橘公司×插畫家つなこ聯手打造的外傳推理小說續集《魔法偵探時崎狂三死亡證明》，將於明年 2027 台北國際動漫節首賣，並同步推出特裝版，自即日起開放限期事前預購至 11/27(五)23:59。兩部作品皆另備官網限定贈品與全通路加購商品，邀請讀者搶先收藏！於官網完成本作特裝版預購者還可額外獲贈 100 元官網滿額優惠券。

 

 

第九十三場死亡遊戲開幕！
《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。(10)》挑戰遊輪生存戰

　　由鵜飼有志創作、ねこめたる繪製插畫，《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。》以少女們賭上性命參加遊戲的故事，帶來緊張刺激的生存體驗。作品曾獲第 18 屆 MF 文庫 J 新人賞「優秀賞」，並榮獲「這本輕小說真厲害！2024」（寶島社）新作部門第 1 名、文庫部門第 2 名，最新第 10 集將帶領讀者登上一艘聚集眾多玩家的遊輪。

　　第九十三場遊戲「JAMBOREE SHIP」以遊輪為舞台，參加人數超越「CANDLE WOODS」，創下最高紀錄，幾乎所有現存玩家都受到邀請。尚未適應現在身體的幽鬼，面前不僅有宿敵「密會」成員阻擋，更出現她最不願想像的藍里、真熊搭檔！在孤立無援、遭超過三百名「敵人」包圍的處境中，她的內心卻冷靜到了極點。海風吹拂水手服，幽鬼將如何走過這場危機四伏的生存考驗？

 

 

 

 

 

 

　　《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。 (10)》特裝版收錄以水手服造型幽鬼為主題的「水手服幽鬼▪壓克力桌繪」，展現幽鬼眼眸細節的「幻色異瞳▪眼睛壓克力吊飾」，以及一次收藏四款角色圖像的「狂徒盛宴▪角色書籤4入組」，搭配「本集小說 with 特別設計書衣」收納於特製珍藏書盒。於台灣角川官網購買，再加贈限定「靜電貼紙」；全通路另推出加購特典「壓克力飾牌 A」，可以 280 元加價購入手，將更多幽鬼周邊帶進日常收藏。

 

七支懷錶爭奪時間之力！
《魔法偵探時崎狂三死亡證明》揭開時鐘儀式

　　《約會大作戰》作者橘公司與插畫家つなこ再度攜手，讓人氣角色時崎狂三以大學生兼偵探的身分登場，在《魔法偵探時崎狂三》系列中調查與魔法工藝品有關的事件。本次《魔法偵探時崎狂三死亡證明》以能夠賦予持有者不同能力的懷錶為線索，展開交織魔法與推理的危險對決。

　　「恭喜您獲選成為『時鐘儀式』的參加者。」時崎偵探社收到一支懷錶，以及寫有規則的信：懷錶共有七支，各自擁有不同能力，集齊所有懷錶者便能獲得「操縱時間的能力」。為了事先防範魔法工藝品犯罪，狂三著手回收其餘懷錶，卻遭其他持有者持刀刺入胸口，受到致命傷。然而，她竟說出「這可不是我第一次復活」，並發動自己懷錶的「時間倒轉」能力！同樣擁有魔法工藝品之人的死鬥，就此揭幕。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

　　《魔法偵探時崎狂三死亡證明》特裝版收錄以地雷系裝扮呈現雙人造型的「地雷系少女◆雙人壓克力立牌」、附牛皮小信封的「時崎狂三◆名片風小卡3入組」，以及以角色列隊場景設計的「列隊指認◆萬用墊」，搭配「本集小說 with 特別設計書衣」收納於特製珍藏書盒。於台灣角川官網購買，再加贈限定「貼紙2入組」。喜愛狂三的讀者，亦可透過全通路分別以 480 元、260 元加購價入手加購特典「炫亮雷射場景立牌組 A」及「名牌風壓克力鑰匙圈 A」。

 

 

《靠死亡遊戲混飯吃。 (10)》特裝版／定價：880 元

【收錄內容】
●水手服幽鬼▪壓克力桌繪（尺寸：L16cm×W12cm）

articles.title: Trump-Backed World Liberty Financial Announces Token Buyback Program
articles.excerpt:
Michaël van de Poppe sees a strong bullish divergence on the WLFI chart and cites HYPE, PUMP, and UNI buybacks as the template for a rebound.

World Liberty Financial (WLFI), the Trump-family-backed crypto project, has announced a new token buyback program, with its initial funding coming from fees generated by its USD1 stablecoin reserves, among other sources.

One of the aims of the initiative is to increase participation in WLFI governance as well as to concentrate voting power among long-term holders.

WLFI Plans Ongoing Buybacks Using USD1-Related Revenue

In a November 6 post on X, World Liberty linked the decision to the growth of its USD1 stablecoin as well as the wider WLFI ecosystem. Furthermore, the project explained that after the first allocation, it would assess the performance of the program before determining its future scale.

 
“The goal is to encourage active participation in WLFI governance and consolidate voting power among our most committed long-term holders,” the team wrote.

They also explained that buybacks would become an “ongoing part” of the project’s long-term strategy, with the speed and scale depending on the growth of the ecosystem and the impact the program will have on governance participation.

Zack Witkoff, who co-founded World Liberty with the Trumps, reacted to the announcement with a brief post of his own, saying, “Burn baby burn.” He also indicated that there could be more announcements coming out soon, telling followers to “stay tuned.”

Crypto analyst Michaël van de Poppe was also in the quote tweets, offering a bullish interpretation of the new development. According to him, some of the best-performing crypto assets, including HYPE, PUMP, and UNI, were tied to token buyback programs that have fueled demand for them, pushing them up by between 25% and 300%.

He believes World Liberty’s native WLFI token could enjoy the same outcome.

 
“This is a great accumulation level, as additional demand will help push the price even higher; technically, a strong bullish divergence is already supporting a potential bottoming phase here,” explained the market watcher. “This has helped $BTC make a strong run, and several #Altcoins have, and I’m sure $WLFI will too.”

WLFI Still Facing Market and Political Pressure

Despite Van de Poppe’s optimism, the picture on the ground for WLFI is still stark. At the time of writing, CoinGecko data showed the asset trading at around $0.047, having barely moved in 24 hours even with the buyback news. That price level represents a nearly 8% dip in the last seven days, a 12% drop over two weeks, and a plunge of over 14% in the past 30 days.

Furthermore, the token is more than 60% lower than where it was 12 months ago and has failed to get any closer to its September 2025 all-time high, lagging 85% below that peak. Still, according to CG, it enjoyed increased trading levels yesterday, with about $115.3 million changing hands, to mark a 96% jump from the day before.

The depressed performance was also seen across several other Trump-related cryptocurrencies following the November 3 midterms, which saw the president’s Republican Party perform dismally . One of them, Official Trump (TRUMP), lost 10% in one day, with its sister token MELANIA adding another 10% dip to its own prolonged downtrend.

The post Trump-Backed World Liberty Financial Announces Token Buyback Program appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: 《天翼之鍊》手機MMORPG《TalesWeaver Mobile》首度曝光 預定12月展開測試
articles.excerpt:
韓國 NEXON 公開旗下經典線上遊戲《天翼之鍊》（TalesWeaver）改編的全新手機 MMORPG《TalesWeaver Mobile》，同步釋出首支包含部份遊戲畫面的宣傳影片，並宣布將於 12 月 12 日在韓國展開首次焦點團體測試。

韓國 NEXON 公開旗下經典線上遊戲《天翼之鍊》（TalesWeaver）改編的全新手機 MMORPG《TalesWeaver Mobile》，同步釋出首支包含部份遊戲畫面的宣傳影片，並宣布將於 12 月 12 日在韓國展開首次焦點團體測試。

 

 

 

 

 

《天翼之鍊》最早於 2003 年推出，遊戲故事改編自韓國作家全民熙的奇幻小說《符文之子》，以角色各自擁有獨立故事線的劇情設計、獨特的美術風格，以及令人印象深刻的遊戲配樂聞名，也是當年具有代表性的韓國線上角色扮演遊戲之一。

 

 

 

《TalesWeaver Mobile》是以 2003 年推出的經典線上遊戲《天翼之鍊》為基礎開發，將延續原作的世界觀、故事劇情、登場角色以及可愛的美術風格，同時針對手機平台重新調整操作方式與戰鬥節奏，期望在保留原作特色的同時，提供不同於 PC 版本的冒險與成長體驗。

 

 

 

透過宣傳影片 NEXON 首度展示遊戲實際畫面。宣傳影片以原作經典登入音樂「Tales are about to be weaved」揭開序幕，並由路西安演奏、波里斯在一旁聆聽，接著帶領玩家重新回到熟悉的港口城市那維克，以及克萊登平原等經典場景。影片也展示了角色施展技能的戰鬥畫面、過場演出，以及原作初登場的經典怪物「果凍雞」喚起玩家回憶。

 

 

 

NEXON 表示《TalesWeaver Mobile》預計於 12 月 12 日在韓國舉辦線下焦點團體測試，並自即日起至 11 月 15 日透過 NEXON 官方網站及 NEXON PLAY 招募測試玩家。此次測試將著重確認遊戲的視覺表現、劇情、戰鬥系統與操作手感調整遊戲內容。

articles.title: Google攜手亨利卡維爾開發保衛鬍子遊戲，玩一次捐11美元造福男性
articles.excerpt:
Google 於 11 月 4 日宣布邀請好萊塢演員、製片人兼知名遊戲玩家亨利卡維爾（Henry Cavill）運用 Googlebook 與 AI 工具，從零打造 16 位元復古風像素遊戲《Mustache Protocol》（暫譯，鬍子保衛戰）。

Google 於 11 月 4 日宣布邀請好萊塢演員、製片人兼知名遊戲玩家亨利卡維爾（Henry Cavill）運用 Googlebook 與 AI 工具，從零打造 16 位元復古風像素遊戲《Mustache Protocol》（暫譯，鬍子保衛戰）。

 

卡維爾親自構思遊戲劇情，還參與設計主角造型與武器，此外，Google 與男性健康公益組織 Movember 合作，待遊戲上市後開放免費遊玩（還未公布推出時間）。

 

2026 年 11 月期間每有一次遊戲遊玩紀錄就會捐出 11 美元，累積捐款上限 50 萬美元（新台幣 1,650 萬元），募款金額將用來支持男性心理健康，以及預防攝護腺癌、睪丸癌等議題的宣導。

 

 

Henry Cavill knows a thing or two about mustache injustice, and with a little help from Google, is making a video game on Googlebook this Movember. Watch the full episode at https://t.co/1q4TViRq19 https://t.co/531JFhXobY

— Android (@Android) November 4, 2026 

 

卡維爾在企劃影片說他一直很喜歡鬍子，希望趁著 Movember 活動期間找個方式讓這份對鬍子的熱愛永久留存，他引用創作就要從熟悉事物著手的說法，笑稱自己最了解的就是「鬍子正義」（Mustache Justice）。

 

《鬍子保衛戰》故事描述一名英雄挺身而出阻止失控的 CGI 特效藝術家抹除全世界的鬍子，卡維爾形容是為解決嚴肅問題打造的趣味遊戲。

 

 

 

《鬍子保衛戰》其實在暗示卡維爾 2017 年拍《正義聯盟》（Justice League）時發生的「鬍子門」事件，當時他同時拍攝《不可能的任務：全面瓦解》飾演反派 CIA 特務要留八字鬍，無法配合《正義聯盟》補拍時剃鬍，華納兄弟只能透過 CGI 後製移除他的鬍子。

 

好笑又無奈的是，CGI 數位修補效果兩光，令卡維爾在部分畫面的上唇與嘴部表情不自然，成為電影播出後乃是影史上廣受討論的視覺瑕疵，如今他將這段經歷轉化為遊戲題材，讓玩家反過來阻止 CGI 藝術家消滅全世界的鬍子。

 

 

 

卡維爾與 Google 合作將推出一系列影片記錄遊戲製作過程，第一部展示遊戲主角的誕生，首先考慮以 Chevron（人字鬍）或 Handlebar（翹鬍）作為角色標誌。他利用 AI 工具生成復古遊戲風格的英雄造型，並把放大版鬍子梳設計成 15 世紀晚期巨劍外觀的武器。

 

 

 

至於人字鬍與翹鬍究竟該選哪一種，他笑稱這就像要自己在兩隻愛犬 Cal 和 Baggins 之間做選擇一樣困難，還提議讓愛犬也加入遊戲。

 

 

 

 

《鬍子保衛戰》開發過程使用 Googlebook 搭配多項 AI 工具，其中 Antigravity 將自然語言提示轉換成實際可運作的 16 位元遊戲機制與視覺內容，協助卡維爾將構想逐步轉化為遊戲。

 

此外，卡維爾使用語音轉文字工具 Rambler 將腦中的想法整理成具體筆記，再透過 Magic Pointer 選取及組合畫面中的視覺元素，調整角色外觀與配件。Googlebook 的 Continue On 功能則讓他能在 Android 手機與 Googlebook 切換工作，延續原本的創作進度。

 

《鬍子保衛戰》將登陸手機與平板，預計近期推出， 玩家可前往活動特設網站 觀看後續製作影片，並登記接收遊戲上市通知。

articles.title: Dubai Future Finance Week day four: a tokenisation rulebook, a court on chain and the liquidity question
articles.excerpt:
The DFSA published its view of how tokenised markets can scale and DIFC Courts proposed a way to enforce rulings on chain. On stage at the Future Tokenisation Forum, regulators and market builders agreed that issuing tokens is now the easy part. Making them tradeable is not.

The post Dubai Future Finance Week day four: a tokenisation rulebook, a court on chain and the liquidity question appeared first on The Fintech Times .

The DFSA published its view of how tokenised markets can scale and DIFC Courts proposed a way to enforce rulings on chain. On stage at the Future Tokenisation Forum, regulators and market builders agreed that issuing tokens is now the easy part. Making them tradeable is not. 

On Thursday, Dubai Future Finance Week turned to two longer-term questions: how family wealth passes between generations, and how tokenised assets can move from pilots into real markets. The Future Tokenisation Forum at Jumeirah Mina Al Salam took the second question, and it was the busiest regulatory day of the week.

A paper that maps the debate

 Mark Steward , chief executive of the DFSA, opened the forum with the regulator’s new report, Scaling Tokenisation: The Road Ahead. It draws on input from BlackRock , Ripple , Robinhood , Soter Insure and Standard Chartered , and looks at what tokenisation needs as it moves from experiments into live financial products, payments and market infrastructure. The paper deliberately stops short of picking a winner. It sets out where the industry agrees and where it does not, and does not prescribe a particular technology, rulebook or business model. The DFSA wants it to start a wider conversation with firms, investors, policymakers and international standard setters.

DIFC Courts brought a more concrete proposal. Working with DECA4 Advisory and industry partners, the courts published a white paper on a Dispute Resolution Oracle, an opt-in link between a smart contract and a court or other forum the parties choose before they transact. The gap it targets is simple to state: a court can decide who owns a digital asset, but it cannot make that decision take effect on chain. Under the proposal, a disputed asset would be preserved once a claim is raised and the final decision enforced directly on chain. Judges, arbitrators and mediators would still decide cases off chain, with limited asset freezes, early review, reasoned decisions and rights of appeal as safeguards. The courts are pitching it as an open standard for any jurisdiction, not a Dubai-only tool. Amna Al Owais , deputy director of DIFC Courts, was among the day’s speakers.

Regulators: the wrapper changes, the rules should not

The regulators’ panel was the clearest guide to where supervisors stand. Michail Fekkas , first vice chairman of Greece’s Hellenic Capital Market Commission , argued that tokenisation changes how an instrument is issued, transferred and traded, not what it is. Europe already has the tools in MiFID, CSDR, the DLT Pilot Regime and MiCA, he said, and should not build a separate regime for tokenised assets. The principle should stay simple: same activity, same risk, same regulatory outcome. For him, the real obstacles are now legal uncertainty, fragmentation and whether market infrastructure can pay its way. “Europe must move from regulatory experimentation to regulatory scalability, and smaller European markets must be part of that,” he said.

 William Mason , director general of the Guernsey Financial Services Commission , described a lighter-touch route. Guernsey audited its existing laws, found them largely fit for purpose and issued guidance on how it would read them, rather than rewriting them. He added that the GFSC aims to finalise its stablecoin rules next month. His bigger worry was liquidity. Supervisors do not want private assets moved on chain and sold to retail investors who then cannot get out, he said, and he doubted that automated market makers alone would solve it. Real market makers taking positions would be needed for the market to scale. “Buying is easy; anybody can buy,” he said. The hard part is being able to sell.

 Paul Kayrouz , Chief Fintech Officer at the Central Bank of the UAE , gave the UAE’s position. The central bank regulates entities, he said, so a bank that starts tokenising securities needs a separate licence from the Capital Market Authority , but the central bank still oversees its whole balance sheet, operational resilience and conduct. On tokenised money, he said the UAE expects central bank digital currency, tokenised deposits and stablecoins to coexist rather than compete. The central bank’s job is to build the rails and let the market choose. The digital dirham is close to launch, the UAE has licensed four banks and one non-bank to issue stablecoins, and several banks are close to launching tokenised deposit programmes. To move beyond closed loops, he said, tokenised assets will need a unified ledger for clearing and settlement, and on-chain records with the same legal force as the assets they represent.

Kayrouz also pointed to a cross-border problem. A handful of stablecoin issuers dominate the market, and their tokens are used in the UAE although they are issued and licensed elsewhere. Protecting consumers then depends on regulators sharing information and working together, he said, because “we will never be in any stage where we will have the same regulation”. An Israeli regulator on the panel made a related point: owning a token used to be a technical question about who holds the key, but scaling it into finance needs a legal answer about enforceable rights, including across borders.

The market view: cheap to imagine, costly to issue

A second panel looked at why tokenisation has barely left the pilot stage. The founder of a UAE-based tokenisation platform said technology is no longer the bottleneck. Cost is: legal advice, issuing vehicles, licences and prospectuses mean the economics rarely work unless an issue runs into hundreds of millions of dollars. Today the money goes to lawyers, administrators and technology vendors, he said, and will shift towards distribution and trading as tokens trade across many venues. He expects funds and traditional capital markets to grow fastest, and warned that tokenising an asset with no clear use will fail. He also called the UAE lucky to have regulators that are approachable and willing to find ways to meet their objectives without blocking new products.

A speaker from the UAE’s Capital Market Authority, which replaced the SCA as a legal continuation on 1 January, said the authority’s tokenisation framework is still narrow, covering only securities and commodities. The CMA is considering a discussion paper to review it in light of market demand. Questions include which assets should qualify, how disclosure should work, who can custody tokens, and whether making illiquid assets easier to buy should change who they can be sold to. There is no single change that would unlock the market, she said.

Distribution: trust before scale

The forum’s closing panel, moderated by BCG , set the scale of the challenge: roughly USD 3trn in crypto assets and about USD 300bn in stablecoins, against only USD 30bn to 40bn in tokenised real-world assets. A partner at SC Ventures , Standard Chartered’s venture arm, said demand today comes mainly from crypto money looking for exposure to traditional assets. Institutions are next, once settlement and collateral benefits make the economics work, and everyone else will follow. Liquidity is the gap. “Just tokenising something doesn’t automatically make it liquid,” he said, adding that more market makers, leverage and links between traditional and digital rails would be needed.

 Paul Boots , senior director and head of sector development at VARA , said the authority learns through regulatory pilots, including its expanding real estate tokenisation pilot with Dubai Land Department. Issuance rules are clear and licensed broker dealers can already distribute tokens. The next step is for tokens to trade on more than one platform with market makers behind them, so retail buyers of property tokens can sell when they need to. He was firm when an audience member asked VARA to make licensing easier: liquidity matters, but not at the expense of KYC and anti-money laundering checks. Investors, he said, will end up buying on “the platforms of trust”.

 Mohamed Damak , managing director and global head of Islamic finance at S&P Global Ratings , said S&P has rated some tokenised money market funds and digital bonds at the same level as their conventional equivalents after finding that the technology added no extra risk. He named three barriers to scale: the legal structure of what a token holder owns, interoperability between bank platforms and public blockchains, and the money leg, where settlement still waits for banks to open. He pointed to the DIFC Courts proposal as the kind of recourse investors will want before they commit. The president of Robinhood MENA, which arrived in the UAE recently, said investor education remains the biggest hurdle for retail demand.

Family wealth and the next generation

The Dubai Family Wealth Summit, held the same day, focused on governance, succession, structuring and philanthropy, with the UAE’s Year of Family as the backdrop. Dr Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi , Minister of Foreign Trade, gave the keynote on international connectivity. Speakers included Hussain Sajwani of DAMAC , Halima Dangote of Dangote Industries , Maurice Gravier of Emirates NBD , Shehab Gargash of Gargash Prime and Osama Ibrahim Seddiqi of Seddiqi Holding . DIFC announced a 2027 NextGen Internship Programme that will place future family business leaders in DIFC firms across financial services, audit, consultancy, law and AI, Fintech and innovation, ahead of an estimated USD 18.3trn global wealth transfer by 2030. The Investment Leaders Exchange brought sovereign wealth funds, institutional allocators and family offices together on asset allocation and the place of digital assets in long-term portfolios.

 Dr Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, Minister of Foreign Trade 

A China to Gulf payments link

Outside the forums, Lianlian DigiTech , the Hong Kong-listed payments group, opened its Middle East regional office in DIFC. The company already holds a DFSA Category 3D payment services licence and will offer cross-border collections, foreign exchange and vendor payouts for businesses trading between China, the Gulf and global markets. It already supports sellers on Noon , Amazon UAE and Amazon Saudi Arabia .

Dubai Future Finance Week closes on Friday with GEFI’s ethical finance conference at DIFC.

The post Dubai Future Finance Week day four: a tokenisation rulebook, a court on chain and the liquidity question appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 美國白宮再用AI翻玩《薩爾達》 共和黨選輸擋不住川普戴帽：我還是你們的總統
articles.excerpt:
美國共和黨在 11 月 3 日中期選舉中失去國會兩院控制權，民主黨成功拿下眾議院與參議院，選舉結果出爐後，白宮官方 X 帳號卻在美國時間 11 月 5 日再次借用任天堂經典遊戲《薩爾達傳說》的元素，發布一段將美國總統川普塑造成遊戲角色的宣傳影片。

美國共和黨在 11 月 3 日中期選舉中失去國會兩院控制權，民主黨成功拿下眾議院與參議院，選舉結果出爐後，白宮官方 X 帳號卻在美國時間 11 月 5 日再次借用任天堂經典遊戲《薩爾達傳說》的元素，發布一段將美國總統川普塑造成遊戲角色的宣傳影片。

 

低多邊形的川普角色戴著印有「Still Your President」（我還是你們的總統）帽子，彷彿強調就算國會選輸了，川普仍然在位，時間適逢《薩爾達傳說》40 周年新作《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》推出之際，加上白宮早在兩個月前已推出畫面幾乎一樣的內容，被網友批評在蹭熱度。

 

 

It's dangerous to go alone! Take this 🇺🇸 https://t.co/masCWWQe7m

— The White House (@WhiteHouse) November 5, 2026 

影片開頭以仿製《薩爾達傳說》標題畫面「川普傳說：MAGA」，接著身穿西裝、打著紅色領帶，頭戴「Still Your President」帽子的川普遊戲角色現身白宮前，並跟隨類似原作妖精夥伴的角色在草地移動。

 

白宮將一系列政策宣傳文字設計成遊戲的冒險提示，宣稱處方藥價格創下 60 多年來最大降幅、謀殺率降至 125 年來新低，以及連續 17 個月沒有非法移民被釋放進入美國等內容。

 

影片背景則搭配《薩爾達傳說》原作遊戲音樂，最後畫面切換至川普坐在白宮橢圓形辦公室的堅毅桌前簽署文件，並以「川普總統正不懈工作……讓美國再次偉大」作為宣傳收尾。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

白宮的影片還配《薩爾達傳說》系列經典台詞「獨自上路很危險！拿著這個」接美國國旗圖示，至於影片是否有任天堂授權，或是生成式 AI 打造，白宮都沒有說明。

 

9 月才玩過一次 白宮同一招玩不膩

 

早在今年 9 月 9 日，白宮官方 X 帳號就曾仿照《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》重新設計標題畫面，讓低多邊形風格的川普角色跑進白宮辦公，搭配原作的遊戲介面與背景音樂。

 

當時的發布時間也相當敏感，任天堂才剛在 9 月 8 日舉辦「薩爾達傳說 40 週年 Direct」，公開《薩爾達傳說 時之笛》Switch 2 完全重製版的資訊，白宮隔天便發布仿作影片，借用作品當時的話題熱度進行政治宣傳。

 

 

Hey! Listen! https://t.co/brGDWq89fV

— The White House (@WhiteHouse) September 9, 2026 

白宮擅自挪用 ACG 或影視 IP 的情況已經不勝枚舉，就任天堂來說，今年 3 月白宮曾將《Wii Sports》的遊戲畫面與伊朗遭到空襲的實拍影像剪輯在一起，藉此宣傳美軍軍事行動，《超級瑪利歐》、《寶可夢》、《動物森友會》都曾被用來製作川普的政治內容。

 

除了任天堂作品，白宮過去還曾借用《冰與火之歌：權力遊戲》、《蜘蛛人》、《航海王》、《007》、《火影忍者》、《七龍珠》、《遊戲王》、《女神異聞錄》等知名作品的元素。

針對川普政府屢次將日本 ACG 智財用於政策與政治宣傳的情況，日本政府早在 2026 年 4 月 17 日表達關切，但白宮似乎充耳不聞，類似作為一直持續到現在。

 

 日本外務大臣茂木敏充當時 在眾議院外務委員會被問及白宮疑未經授權使用任天堂遊戲畫面的問題時表示：「一般而言，即使是公家機關，未經著作權人同意擅自複製著作物也是不恰當的。」外務省也透露，已向美國駐日大使館傳達日本方面的相關立場。

 

 

The Mark of a Good Crew 🇺🇸 https://t.co/d5yLOOe9x1

— The White House (@WhiteHouse) November 3, 2026 

 

日本經濟安保大臣小野田紀美於 6 月 12 日 在內閣府記者會回應川普扮成《火影忍者》主角漩渦鳴人的影片 ，她指出，使用 IP 原則上得取得著作權人許可，公家機關也不例外，若以違背權利人意願的方式使用作品，也可能損害作品形象。

 

 小野田紀美證實 日本已透過外交管道多次向美方傳達這項立場，「我強烈希望類似事件不要再度發生，也希望這次的貼文不要再被二次擴散。」她強調日本政府會持續與美方溝通，確保日本著作權受到適當對待。

 

 

 

 

CAN'T STOP WINNING. 🎮 Build the wall. Deport. Fill a Trump Account. LIVE - PLAY NOW 📲 https://t.co/qIR69AxSnm https://t.co/2nr2jG1ZRg

— The White House (@WhiteHouse) September 3, 2026

articles.title: 《尼爾：自動人形》Steam發售10年後更新繁體中文版 但下載安裝容量誤增為366GB
articles.excerpt:
白金工作室開發、Square Enix 發行的動作遊戲《尼爾：自動人形》NieR:Automata）在 2017 年登陸 Steam 平台將近 10 年後，在今（6）日推出官方中文化更新，正式支援繁體中文、簡體中文與韓文。不過部分玩家可能會發現遊戲安裝所需容量竟然暴增至 366.56 GB。

白金工作室開發、Square Enix 發行的動作遊戲《尼爾：自動人形》NieR:Automata）在 2017 年登陸 Steam 平台將近 10 年後，在今（6）日推出官方中文化更新，正式支援繁體中文、簡體中文與韓文。不過部分玩家可能會發現遊戲安裝所需容量竟然暴增至 366.56 GB。

 

 

 

《尼爾：自動人形》由橫尾太郎擔任總監，白金工作室負責開發，故事描述人類遭到外星人派出的機械生命體侵略，被迫撤退至月球，隨後組織人造人部隊展開地球奪還作戰。玩家將透過 2B、9S 與這兩位下降到地球進行作戰的寄葉部隊人造人成員，揭露這場大戰最後的真相。

 

 

 

本作自 2017 年推出以來，憑藉獨特的敘事手法、音樂與動作戰鬥系統獲得玩家好評，全球累積銷量也已突破 1,000 萬套。不過 Steam 版本長年未提供官方中文，過去想以中文遊玩的 PC 玩家只能尋求非官方手段，如今終於官方正式更新中文版。根據 Square Enix 公布的 Steam 更新公告，本次更新主要新增繁體中文、簡體中文與韓文三種語言。

 

 

 

不過導致《尼爾：自動人形》在 Steam 安裝時系統竟然要求預留高達 366.56GB 的儲存空間，相較商店頁面標示的 50GB 增加 7 倍。檢查發現問題出在 Steam 對 DLC 安裝容量的計算方式。遊戲包含的 8 項 DLC 在安裝介面中，各自被計算為約 40.73GB，導致系統將本體與 DLC 的需求容量重複累加，才會出現 366.56GB 的誇張數字，官方建議先安裝本體再追加 DLC 內容，實際大小不變。

 

 
Steam版『NieR:Automata』の最新アップデート適用後、インストール時に想定を超えるストレージ容量が必要と表示される事象を確認しております。
現在、原因を調査し、対応を進めております。
ご不便をおかけしており、申し訳ございません。

一時的な回避方法として、Steamの「プロパティ」→「DLC」よりDLCのチェックを外すことで、本編をダウンロードいただけます。
— NieR公式PRアカウント (@NieR_JPN) November 6, 2026

肆、中國信託綜合證券股份有限公司違反證券管理法令處分案

一、處分時間：115年11月6日。

二、受處分之對象：中國信託綜合證券股份有限公司（下稱中國信託證券）。

三、處分之法令依據：證券交易法第178條之1第1項第4款、證券商管理規則第2條第2項及第37條第13款規定。

四、違反事實理由：本會檢查局於115年5月26日至115年6月11日對中國信託證券進行一般業務檢查，發現該公司辦理受託買賣有價證券業務有受理非本人且未具客戶委任書之代理人買賣有價證券、辦理受託買進信用評等未達BBB等級海外債券時未向客戶揭露投資風險、有受理非專業投資人買入債券發行人之長期債務信用評等未達A-等級之債券、具損失吸收能力債券、反向超過1倍之ETF及外國虛擬資產ETF、未辦理委外事項之風險程度評估與管控等情事。

五、處分結果：依證券交易法第178條之1第1項第4款規定，處中國信託證券新臺幣60萬元之罰鍰。

【科技早餐】今天精選 6 則國內外重要科技新聞。

＊Google 為 Anthropic 資料中心租約提供信用支持，20 年合約估 190 億美元

美國資料中心開發商 TeraWulf 11 月 4 日公告，Google 同意為 Anthropic 位於肯塔基州 Hawesville 的資料中心租約提供信用支持，協助降低融資風險。Anthropic 今年 7 月與 TeraWulf 簽署 20 年租約，承租約 401 MW 的關鍵 IT 負載容量，20 年租期預計帶來約 190 億美元收入。這筆金額是長期租金預期，並非 Google 向 Anthropic 或 TeraWulf 投資 190 億美元。

TeraWulf 的申報文件顯示，Google 的信用支持將在相關機房達到約定啟用條件後生效；若 Anthropic 違約，Google 可依約承接租約或支付終止費。公司也擴大與工程承包商 Fluor 的合作，預計 2027 年底開始分階段交付機房，至 2028 年第 2 季完成規劃容量。大型 AI 模型商所需資本持續增加，具信用評等的科技巨頭為長租約提供支持，正成為資料中心開發商籌資的重要工具；機房交付與融資仍待落實。

＊SpaceX 攜高通打造全美 5G 地面網路，2027 年啟動基地台部署

高通（Qualcomm）11 月 4 日宣布，SpaceX 旗下 Starlink Mobile 選定其 Dragonwing 通訊基礎設施平台，建置美國地面 5G 基地台。方案涵蓋無線電、基頻處理與商用軟體，並與既有衛星網路結合。SpaceX 預計 2027 年開始推出部署計畫，在多年合作期間建立數萬處站點，目標是擴大網路覆蓋與容量，目前尚未完成部署。

這筆合作同時反映高通的業務轉型壓力。公司最新一季手機晶片營收年減 26%，面臨手機需求疲弱、記憶體漲價及蘋果（Apple）自研通訊晶片等挑戰。高通先前預估，2027 會計年度非手機業務將占晶片部門營收過半，成長動能包括資料中心、車用與通訊設備。對網通供應鏈而言，值得追蹤的是基地台實際開工、採購規模與衛星及地面網路如何分工，而非將規劃站點直接計為新增出貨。

＊OpenAI 企業營收占比過半，總裁稱 2027 年可準備 IPO

OpenAI 總裁葛瑞格・布羅克曼（Greg Brockman）11 月 4 日在《The Wall Street Journal》科技活動表示，企業客戶目前已貢獻公司超過一半營收，企業市場正成為重要成長來源。OpenAI 擴大企業銷售，推廣程式開發工具 Codex，並與 Anthropic 競爭。上述企業營收占比為公司高層說法，OpenAI 尚未提供可獨立查核的完整分部財報。

談及 2027 年能否準備好首次公開發行股票（IPO）時，布羅克曼表示認為可行，但這不等於正式提出上市申請，也未承諾掛牌日期。OpenAI 持續擴張模型研發與算力投資，市場關注其企業合約能否轉化為穩定收入，是否足以支撐資本需求。對企業採購方而言，除了比較模型表現，也需評估服務供應商的商業持續性、合約條件及未來價格變動風險。

＊鴻海參與 Agility 上市融資！人形機器人去年營收 178 萬美元、虧損 1.38 億美元

人形機器人公司 Agility Robotics 的合併上市案，11 月 2 日獲收購公司 Churchill Capital Corp XI 股東批准。官方當時預定 11 月 4 日交割、11 月 5 日以 AGLT 代號於 Nasdaq 交易。合併及融資預計籌得約 4.65 億美元，包含信託帳戶約 1.64 億美元、鴻海（Foxconn）領投的約 2.01 億美元私募，以及已取得的 1 億美元。鴻海並非單獨投入整筆私募金額。

Agility 的 Digit 機器人已在亞馬遜（Amazon）、GXO 等物流場域部署，並推動豐田（Toyota）製造場域應用。《Business Insider》引述申報文件指出，公司 2025 年營收約 178 萬美元，淨虧損約 1.38 億美元。Agility 雖揭露 Digit 5 超過 3 億美元的多年期訂單承諾，仍須滿足交付時程、產品功能與性能等條件，並非已確認入帳營收。Digit 5 預計 2027 年上半年向早期客戶交付，訂單能否轉為收入與獲利，仍待驗證。

＊Apple Intelligence 中國開放開發者測試，部分功能導入阿里巴巴千問

蘋果（Apple）宣布，中國版 Apple Intelligence 首批功能自 11 月 4 日起透過最新 iOS 開發者 Beta 版提供測試，預計 12 月隨 iOS 27.3 正式推出。功能包括翻譯、寫作摘要、照片消除、視覺智慧與通知摘要。蘋果也確認與阿里巴巴合作，讓千問（Qwen）支援部分 Siri、寫作工具和視覺智慧體驗，涉及文字與影像理解。

這項安排反映跨國平台在不同監管市場，需要重新配置模型與服務夥伴。蘋果仍採用自家模型，千問並未全面取代 Siri；此次更新也不包含新一代 Siri AI 及先前公布的其他下一代功能。現階段屬開發者測試，不代表所有中國使用者已能正式使用，其他裝置平台也仍待必要審批。區域模型整合、功能範圍與審批進度，將影響開發者後續布局。

＊Arm 季營收增 27% 至 14.4 億美元，AI 資料中心帶動 CPU 布局

晶片架構公司安謀（Arm）11 月 4 日公布 2027 會計年度第 2 季財報，營收達 14.4 億美元，年增 27%，高於市場預估。授權收入約 7.73 億美元，權利金收入約 6.7 億美元，後者年增 8%。隨 AI 資料中心擴張，Arm 架構滲透大型雲端平台，公司預估下一季營收約 15.4 億美元，但仍屬財測。

Arm 今年 3 月推出自有 Arm AGI CPU，從原本以處理器架構授權為主，進一步銷售完整晶片。執行長雷恩・哈斯（Rene Haas）向《Reuters》表示，公司估計 2027 與 2028 兩個會計年度可銷售約 20 億美元 AGI CPU，並與台積電（TSMC）等廠商協調生產資源；這是未來銷售展望，不是本季已實現營收。AI 伺服器除了 GPU，也需 CPU 協調資料流，Arm 對傳統 x86 架構的競爭正延伸到晶片供應模式。

＊本文開放合作夥伴轉載，資料來源： TeraWulf（SEC 8-K 申報文件） 、 《Reuters》 、 Qualcomm（官方公告） 、 《Reuters》 、 《MarketWatch》 、 《Reuters》 、 Agility Robotics 、 美國證券交易委員會（SEC） 、 《Business Insider》 、 Apple 、 《The Verge》 、 Arm 、 《Reuters》 、 《The Wall Street Journal》 ，首圖來源： Unsplash 。

articles.title: 【資安週報】1102～1106，電商服務供應鏈資安風波多家同時延燒、永豐銀行異常轉帳確認為資安事件
articles.excerpt:
連續數週以來，日本企業資料外洩事件接連曝光，臺灣電商服務供應鏈也持續傳出資安警訊。繼91APP遭駭波及上千家品牌後，1shop、Cyberbiz、meepShop及電商ERP業者莫筆克科技也接連傳出資安事件或疑慮，連帶使得眾多採用相關服務的品牌商陸續發布資安公告，部分顧客訂單及個資可能受到影響。
金融資安事故同樣備受關注。臺灣永豐銀行客戶異常轉帳事件，銀行後續說明是駭客利用新網銀交易系統供應商的安全設定漏洞所導致，但相關細節並未揭露，仍待進一步釐清；國際間，法國銀行也傳出鉅額資金遭駭轉走，加密貨幣交易平臺Binance則揭露，駭客透過假面試及遭變造的軟體安裝程式入侵工程師電腦，進而滲透錢包簽章服務。

articles.title: Polygon Eyes Hard Fork to Recover 70.49 Million POL Stolen in Polymarket and Binance Hacks
articles.excerpt:
The proposal targets native POL only, leaving Binance's already-frozen USDT untouched.

Polygon is considering a hard fork proposal that would move around 70.49 million POL stolen in separate security incidents involving Polymarket and Binance back to recovery wallets designated by the two platforms.

The proposal calls for Polygon PoS validators to approve a coordinated network upgrade that would set the balances of five attacker-controlled addresses to zero and credit the same amounts to verified recovery addresses. The funds are currently blocked from moving, but Polygon said the existing block list does not provide a way to return them to their rightful owners.

New Hard Fork Proposal

The incidents took place on October 29 and 30, with roughly 23.86 million POL linked to the Polymarket incident and another 46.63 million POL connected to Binance. Following requests from the affected platforms, all validator-elected block producers added the identified addresses to their Bor transaction block lists. While this stopped the funds from moving, Polygon describes the arrangement as a stopgap rather than a permanent solution.

The block lists are read only when a block producer starts up, which essentially means that every update requires a deployment and a Bor restart or span rotation. The filtering mechanism also leaves room for potential bypass attempts, as it does not cover every possible transaction path.

Polygon also pointed to an attempted transaction involving a fee of around 219,450 POL and an alleged approach to validators offering cash in exchange for help unblocking a transaction. Under the proposal, the balances of four Polymarket-linked addresses and one Binance-linked address would be transferred at a fixed block height.

Both platforms will have to prove control of their respective recovery addresses and confirm in writing that they are authorized to receive the funds.

Other Tokens Excluded

The proposal only covers native POL held at the five listed addresses, while other tokens remain outside its scope. Binance’s stolen USDT has already been frozen by Tether, so the proposed fork will not touch it. Polygon also makes clear that this is an extreme measure and should not become common practice or establish a general mechanism for freezing and recovering user funds.

Before the change reaches mainnet, it must pass the Polygon governance process, undergo development and testing on Amoy, and receive the required validator support.

The post Polygon Eyes Hard Fork to Recover 70.49 Million POL Stolen in Polymarket and Binance Hacks appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: RemitBee and TerraPay Link Canadian SMEs to Digital Wallets
articles.excerpt:
RemitBee has partnered with TerraPay to give Canadian small businesses access to cross-border payouts across 156 countries and 3.7 billion digital wallets.

The post RemitBee and TerraPay Link Canadian SMEs to Digital Wallets appeared first on The Fintech Times .

RemitBee , the Mississauga-based cross-border payments platform, has entered a partnership with London-headquartered TerraPay to extend international payout capabilities for Canadian small businesses and individual senders. The integration gives RemitBee’s customers access to TerraPay’s network, which spans 7.5 billion bank accounts and 3.7 billion digital wallets across more than 156 countries, with outbound corridors covering the United States, Asia, the Middle East and Africa. 

The deal is framed around a specific gap in the Canadian market: small businesses have historically lacked the transaction volumes required to negotiate competitive exchange rates or access the kind of payment infrastructure available to larger corporates. RemitBee, which has been regulated by FINTRAC as a money services business since its founding in 2015, is positioning the partnership as a way to democratise enterprise-grade payment rails for SME use cases including supplier payments, freelancer payouts, remote payroll and remittances.

 Manos Yoganathan , chief operating officer of RemitBee, said: “Canadian small and medium-sized businesses often lack the transaction volumes to negotiate favorable exchange rates and face delays in cross-border payments. By partnering with TerraPay, we’re advancing our vision of making enterprise-grade payment infrastructure accessible to these businesses.”

 Market context 

Canada’s outbound cross-border payments market is commercially significant. More than 90 per cent of employer businesses in the country are classified as small businesses, according to Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada . That concentration of SMEs, combined with a diaspora population driving personal remittances, makes Canada an attractive corridor anchor for payments infrastructure providers. Global personal remittance flows to low- and middle-income countries reached approximately $704 billion in 2025, according to World Bank data cited in the release, a figure that illustrates the scale of the underlying demand.

TerraPay’s role in the partnership is to supply last-mile connectivity, particularly into digital wallets, a segment where traditional correspondent banking has the least reach. The company’s Xend network, which it describes as a wallet interoperability platform, is the mechanism through which those wallet payouts are routed. Several competing infrastructure providers, including Thunes and Nium , operate in broadly similar territory, offering single-connection access to multi-corridor payout networks for fintechs and payment operators. The competitive differentiation in this space tends to rest on the depth of wallet coverage in specific corridors, pricing transparency and the regulatory footprint of the infrastructure provider in receiving markets.

 Regulatory path 

Regulatory compliance is a stated priority for both parties. RemitBee’s FINTRAC registration covers its Canadian operations, and TerraPay emphasises its regulated status across multiple markets. Cross-border money movement into digital wallets is an area of active regulatory interest: the Financial Action Task Force has updated guidance on virtual asset service providers and wallet providers in recent years, and corridors into the Middle East and Africa carry additional compliance considerations given the concentration of mobile-money platforms operating under varied licensing regimes. For SME-facing operators, the ability to demonstrate clean compliance trails across corridors is becoming as commercially relevant as price.

The partnership does not include disclosed commercial terms or a go-live transaction volume target. The near-term markers to watch are the specific wallet networks activated within the TerraPay integration, uptake among RemitBee’s existing SME customer base, and whether the partnership extends into inbound Canadian corridors over time.

The post RemitBee and TerraPay Link Canadian SMEs to Digital Wallets appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: Apple and Home Depot join list of objectors to tokenized stock plan pushed by NYSE owner
articles.excerpt:
Boeing also joined the list of dozens of companies refusing to participate in the venture cochaired by former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo.

An ambitious joint venture to bring U.S. stocks onto the blockchain appears to be on life support. The venture, cochaired by former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo, and led by crypto firm OKX and the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, announced plans last month to offer round-the-clock trading of tokenized shares of 62 public companies. But as of Thursday, 54 of those companies had objected to having their shares traded on the platform.

Aerospace manufacturer Boeing and business software maker ServiceNow joined the objection list on Wednesday, a day after Apple , Home Depot and GE Vernova filed objections. Earlier objectors include some of corporate America’s biggest names, from Microsoft , Alphabet , and Nvidia to JPMorgan Chase and Walmart .

Home Depot declined to comment. Boeing, ServiceNow, Apple, and GE Vernova did not immediately respond to Fortune ’s request for comment. 

Companies outside OKXICE’s original proposed lineup have also filed objections, including Wells Fargo , Nebius Group, Arm Holdings, Cerebras Systems, and Cigna Group.

The expanded objection list comes a month after Cuomo announced the tokenized stock trading venue in a social media post. The venture was born out of a temporary exemption granted by the Securities and Exchange Commission in September that allows qualifying platforms to offer trading in tokenized stocks without registering as national securities exchanges, provided they meet certain conditions. 

The eight companies in OKXICE’s original proposed lineup without a disclosed objection so far predominantly have ties to crypto or blockchain. They include USDC issuer Circle Internet Group, crypto exchange Coinbase, trading platform Robinhood, digital asset custodian BitGo, bitcoin treasury company Strategy and tokenization company Securitize. Software company Palantir and server maker Super Micro Computer round out the list.

OKXICE declined to say whether the growing number of objections would affect its planned launch.

The SEC approved the exemption two days after the Clarity Act, a bill to establish a regulatory framework for digital assets, stalled in the Senate. Under the exemption, platforms like OKXICE do not need a company’s permission to offer trading in tokenized versions of its shares. Instead, they must notify the company and give it 30 days from receipt to object and block the listing, as Fortune reported earlier .

Applied Optoelectronics, a networking equipment maker among the companies to file objections, previously told Fortune that the new framework’s potential impact on its stock’s pricing, liquidity and volatility remained unclear. The company also expressed concern that investors might mistakenly believe it sponsored or endorsed the offering.

“At this stage, we don’t see a clear benefit to AOI or our shareholders that justifies these uncertainties,” a spokesperson said.

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

articles.title: Claude 推個人理財功能：連銀行帳戶問錢花去哪，但只能看不能動
articles.excerpt:
Anthropic 在 Claude 推出個人理財功能，美國 Pro、Max、Ultra 用戶可透過 Plaid 連結銀行與信用卡帳戶，用白話問支出與帳單；權限唯讀，不能轉帳或投資，也不提供投資建議。

這篇文章 Claude 推個人理財功能：連銀行帳戶問錢花去哪，但只能看不能動 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

Anthropic 11 月 5 日在 Claude 推出「個人理財」（Personal Finance）功能，用戶可以連結自己的銀行與信用卡帳戶，用白話問 Claude「這個月錢花去哪了」，由它從帳戶餘額與交易紀錄裡找答案。依 Claude 官方說明 ，功能本週起以 beta 版在美國逐步開放給 Pro、Max 與 Ultra 方案用戶。

Anthropic 強調，Claude 對帳戶只有唯讀權限，不能轉帳、管理或投資用戶的錢，這項功能也不是設計來提供投資建議。官方 Claude 帳號 也寫明，和 Claude 其他功能一樣，個人理財沒有廣告或業配推薦。

問「發薪前還剩多少」，Claude 算出 1,393.22 美元

官方舉的例子是月底、離發薪日還有 10 天。用戶問「這個月錢花去哪了」，Claude 把各帳戶的支出加總並分類，例子裡共 4,309.37 美元，超過一半是房租與水電，餐飲 1,024.51 美元。

用戶可以接著問「這比平常多嗎」「還有什麼漏掉的」「發薪前還剩多少」。Claude 會比對前幾個月，指出一筆會員續費，再列出發薪前還會從活存扣掉的四筆款項，算出剩下 1,393.22 美元。

Claude 也能找出容易漏看的地方，例如重複扣款、意外的手續費，或一整年默默漲價的帳單；問「APR 是什麼、今年我付了多少」，它會先解釋名詞，再加總實際付出的利息。用戶還可以要求做每週支出圖、繳費行事曆或自訂儀表板。

透過 Plaid 連結，Claude 看不到銀行密碼

帳戶要用戶自己透過 Plaid 登入銀行才會連上，Plaid 是串接應用程式與銀行的服務，用戶在那裡同意條款並核准唯讀權限，所以 Claude 不會要求、也看不到銀行密碼。

對於用戶選擇連結的帳戶，Claude 能看到銀行名稱、帳戶名稱與類型、帳號末四碼、餘額與信用額度，以及最多兩年的交易紀錄。在個人理財專區的對話不會拿來訓練模型；專區以外分享的內容，則照用戶原本的隱私設定。帳戶可以隨時解除連結。

官方也提醒，Claude 的回答可能出錯，建議追問某個數字背後是哪幾筆交易，重要數字要跟銀行核對。

下一步想找銀行與財富管理業者合作

Anthropic 說，個人理財只是第一步。面對人生更重大的財務決定，它認為由 Claude 與用戶信任的持牌專業人士、受監管機構一起協助最好，目前正在研究怎麼在 Claude 裡做到，也希望銀行、財富管理與金融服務業者一起參與。

銀行業對 AI 碰帳戶的態度還很保守。摩根大通 10 月禁止外部 AI 代理操作客戶帳戶，執行長戴蒙說對客戶和銀行的風險太高，見 摩根大通禁外部 AI 代理操作帳戶 。Claude 這次只開唯讀、不碰資金移動，也不推銷信用卡、貸款或存款帳戶。

這篇文章 Claude 推個人理財功能：連銀行帳戶問錢花去哪，但只能看不能動 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: Iceland Considers Its Own A2A Payments System
articles.excerpt:
The Central Bank of Iceland is exploring a new payments infrastructure that would enable account-to-account (A2A) payments for goods and services, as the country looks to modernize its payment systems and strengthen connections with the rest of Europe. Although Iceland is not a member of the EU, it has been seeking ways to better align […]

The post Iceland Considers Its Own A2A Payments System appeared first on PaymentsJournal .

The Central Bank of Iceland is exploring a new payments infrastructure that would enable account-to-account (A2A) payments for goods and services, as the country looks to modernize its payment systems and strengthen connections with the rest of Europe. Although Iceland is not a member of the EU, it has been seeking ways to better align its domestic payment processes with those of the continent.

Iceland’s payments landscape is already highly digital, but it remains heavily reliant on Visa and Mastercard. Tómas Brynjólfsson, Deputy Governor for Financial Stability at the Central Bank of Iceland, warned that depending on a small number of foreign providers could create vulnerabilities if those networks experience technological disruptions.

“Critically, domestic rails for debit card transactions that played an important role during the banking failures of the Global Financial Crisis have given way to foreign rails,” Brynjólfsson said at the Money Live Nordic Banking conference in Copenhagen. “Cash use is very low, and broadly adopted account-to-account solutions have not emerged as they have in many other countries in the region.”

Making Connections

The proposed scheme would establish shared technical standards and interfaces, allowing consumers to make payments directly from their bank accounts. Rather than replacing existing card networks, the A2A infrastructure would operate alongside the international payment systems.

The initiative also aligns with Iceland’s planned participation in the TARGET Instant Payment Settlement (TIPS) service, expected in the second half of 2028. TIPS is operated by the Eurosystem, which comprises the European Central Bank and the national central banks of euro-area countries. Iceland’s participation would mark another step toward closer integration with Europe’s payment infrastructure, despite remaining outside the EU.

Following Regional Models

TIPS operates around the clock, settling instant payments in euros, Swedish krona, and Danish krone. For Iceland to participate in its domestic currency, the Icelandic króna would also need to be added.

The country’s relationship with the EU remains a separate but related consideration. In August, Icelanders once again voted against pursuing EU membership, continuing a debate that has spanned more than a decade.

“Iceland is in a unique situation, existing outside the EU and geographically located in a complex area for connecting globally,” said Ben Danner , Senior Analyst of Debit at Javelin Strategy & Research. “Officials are seeing the successes of A2A domestic schemes from other countries and want to modernize their payment system towards digitalization. I also think it’s about modernizing their cross-border payment system as they plan to connect to the Eurosystem’s TIPS service.”

The post Iceland Considers Its Own A2A Payments System appeared first on PaymentsJournal .

articles.title: Ripple Price Analysis: XRP Rejected at Key Resistance Again – Is $1.00 Next?
articles.excerpt:
XRP had recovered toward $1.34 after briefly dipping near $1.20 last week before it dumped to $1.26 minutes ago, with the latest push lifting the token above the upper boundary of its short-term descending channel on the 4-hour chart. The rebound has kept the $1.25 support intact, but the asset still faces several supply zones […]

XRP had recovered toward $1.34 after briefly dipping near $1.20 last week before it dumped to $1.26 minutes ago, with the latest push lifting the token above the upper boundary of its short-term descending channel on the 4-hour chart. The rebound has kept the $1.25 support intact, but the asset still faces several supply zones above before the broad bullish trend is restored.

Ripple Price Analysis: The USDT Pair

The daily chart shows XRP still trading within the broader range formed after the sharp August rally from the $1.00 region. The rejection from the $1.70 resistance level in late September started a sequence of lower highs. The decline eventually dragged the price into the $1.25 demand zone, which marks the base of the mid-September rebound.

Sellers briefly pushed XRP below this area at the end of October, with a long lower wick reaching around $1.20. Buyers quickly absorbed the move, however, and the price has since closed back above the zone. If the rebound holds, which doesn’t appear to be the case as of now, the first resistance lies at the $1.40 October lower high, followed by the $1.50 region, where a strong bearish order block is located.

On the contrary, a decisive drop below $1.25 would invalidate the recent reclaim and expose the $1.10 zone. Below that, the $1.00 region remains the major floor, having held throughout July and August before the rally began. At the top of the range, the $1.70 supply zone remains the main long-term obstacle for buyers.

 

The 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart highlights a notable shift in short-term structure. Since peaking just below $1.70 in late September, XRP has been trending lower within the orange descending channel, with each rally rejected at the upper boundary, including the October 21 attempt that created the $1.40 supply zone. After a week of tight base-building around $1.25, the price has now broken above the channel’s upper trendline.

The breakout lifted XRP to about $1.34 before a major pullback pushed it to $1.26, suggesting the price may need more time to return to the $1.40 area. Still, if buyers maintain control, the asset could attempt a relief rally toward the $1.40 zone soon, which is the most recent lower high and the first real test of the breakout. Reclaiming that level would strengthen the reversal case and bring the key $1.50 area back into focus.

However, a return below the broken trendline and the $1.25 demand zone would suggest that the move was a false breakout. In that scenario, the lower channel boundary near $1.15 and the daily $1-$1.10 demand zone would become the next downside levels. For now, the short-term structure leans constructive, but confirmation would require buyers to hold $1.25 and clear $1.40.

 

 

The post Ripple Price Analysis: XRP Rejected at Key Resistance Again – Is $1.00 Next? appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: Ethereum (ETH) Price Analysis: Why Reclaiming $2.5K Is Do-or-Die for the Bulls
articles.excerpt:
Ethereum is pulling back below $2.4K after the recent rebound from the $2.2K mark ran into resistance at the level where its multi-month ascending channel broke down. The rejection leaves ETH caught between improving short-term momentum and an unresolved breakdown on the daily timeframe. Meanwhile, the Coinbase Premium Index is recovering from deeply negative readings […]

Ethereum is pulling back below $2.4K after the recent rebound from the $2.2K mark ran into resistance at the level where its multi-month ascending channel broke down. The rejection leaves ETH caught between improving short-term momentum and an unresolved breakdown on the daily timeframe.

Meanwhile, the Coinbase Premium Index is recovering from deeply negative readings but remains below zero, suggesting that US spot demand has yet to return in force.

Ethereum Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

On the daily chart, Ethereum spent June through mid-October inside an ascending channel that carried the price from approximately $1.5K toward $2.8K. The October decline hover pushed ETH through the channel’s lower boundary, and the former support area has since turned into resistance. The latest rebound stalled inside the yellow zone around $2.5K, exactly where the channel was lost.

Reclaiming the $2.5K region on a daily closing basis would be the first sign that the breakdown was a deviation rather than a structural shift, potentially reopening the path toward the $2.8K swing high and the supply zone above it. Until that happens, rallies into this area could continue to meet selling pressure from market participants looking to exit near breakeven.

On the downside, the 0.5 Fibonacci retracement of the June–September rally near $2.16K has so far contained the late-October dip. Yet, a daily candle close below it would expose the 0.618 level at $2K, followed by the $1.9K demand zone. This area marks the July–August consolidation that preceded the sharp August rally and overlaps with the 0.702 retracement, forming a notable support confluence.

 

ETH/USDT 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart offers a more constructive picture. Since the early-October high near $2.8K, ETH had been trading inside a descending channel defined by lower highs and lower lows. Buyers defended the $2.2K demand zone repeatedly in recent sessions before driving a strong impulse that broke above the channel’s upper trendline earlier this week.

The breakout, however, ran directly into the strong $2.5K supply zone, and the price is now retreating below $2.4K. A successful retest of the broken trendline near $2.3K would support the breakout scenario and set up another attempt at $2.5K. Clearing that barrier would bring the $2.7K supply zone into focus.

Conversely, a return inside the descending channel would invalidate the breakout and suggest that the move was only a relief rally within the broader downtrend. In that scenario, the $2.2K demand zone would likely be tested again, and a breakdown there would align the short-term structure with the bearish path on the daily chart.

 

Sentiment Analysis

The Coinbase Premium Index on CryptoQuant measures the percentage difference between ETH’s price on Coinbase’s USD pair and Binance’s USDT pair. Positive readings typically reflect stronger buying from US investors, who mainly trade on Coinbase, while negative readings point to relatively weaker US demand or heavier selling from that cohort.

Throughout most of the 2025 rally toward approximately $4.8K, the index remained largely positive. Since late 2025, readings have been predominantly negative, interrupted only by brief positive spells, consistent with ETH’s broader decline. The metric recently plunged to approximately -0.21, among its deepest readings on the chart, before recovering toward -0.09 alongside the latest price rebound.

The improvement suggests that US selling pressure is easing, but a reading still below zero does not by itself indicate a return of meaningful demand. A sustained move back into positive territory would add weight to any reclaim of $2.5K, while renewed deterioration would raise the risk of the daily channel breakdown extending toward $2K, which is the most important psychological support level at the moment.

 

 

The post Ethereum (ETH) Price Analysis: Why Reclaiming $2.5K Is Do-or-Die for the Bulls appeared first on CryptoPotato .

Kraken 母公司 Payward 與旗下資管客戶，透過關聯基金在二級市場買入未披露數量的 AAVE 代幣，並可能繼續增持；雙方同步探索後續合作。 （前情提要：Kraken 推出比特幣收益產品「Bitcoin Vault」：整合 Aave、Morpho 讓 BTC 持有者賺 DeFi 獎勵） （背景補充：納斯達克砸 1 億鎂投資 Kraken 母公司 Payward！聯手打造「股票代幣」打通傳統與加密市場） 加密貨幣交易所 Kraken 母公司 Payward，連同其資產管理客戶，已透過關聯基金 Digital Asset Special Investments I, LP 在二級市場購入未公開數量的 AAVE 代幣。CoinDesk 週四報導，Wyoming 註冊的 Payward 表示可能繼續加碼，並與 Aave 探索未來合作機會，細節尚未對外說明。 知情人士向該媒指出，這次是在市場上買進、而非直接向 Aave 購買，等於雙方利益對齊的訊號，也為後續協作鋪路。六月間曾傳出洽談方案含 25 萬枚 AAVE 與 Aave Group 15% 普通股（估值 3.85 億美元）；此次公告聚焦代幣購入，未再提及股權。 Payward 以資管客戶資金推進鏈上信用曝險 這筆配置落在 Payward 擴張資產管理業務的脈絡：公司把業務拆成交易、銀行、資管與 Payward Services 四大支柱，希望從交易手續費延伸到投資產品、支付與客戶資產相關服務。Payward 資管暨機構業務副總裁 Gurpreet Oberoi 表示，這反映對鏈上信用市場與去中心化金融（DeFi）的長期信心，以及客戶對相關基礎設施曝險的需求。 Aave 讓用戶透過區塊鏈智慧合約存入數位資產賺取利息、或以資產抵押借款。依雙方聲明，協議淨存款約 330 億美元、活躍貸款約 110 億美元；持有 AAVE 者可參與影響協議與國庫的治理投票。 Aave Labs 創辦人暨執行長 Stani Kulechov 認為，與 Payward 合作是把 Aave 帶給下一波零售與機構用戶的戰略一步。對交易所母公司而言，持有治理代幣也意味著在鏈上信用基礎設施上擁有更直接的利害關係。 併購擴張後，DeFi 合作成下一條線 Payward 近年以高額併購補強牌照與支付能力，包括最高約 5.5 億美元收購美國衍生品平台 Bitnomial、以及最高約 6 億美元完成穩定幣支付公司 Reap 交易。如今在二級市場配置 AAVE、並公開與 Aave 談合作，等於把擴張觸角從受監管衍生品與支付，延伸到鏈上借貸與信用市場。 對 Aave 來說，Kraken 母公司與其機構客戶進場，有機會把更多零售與機構流量接到協議；對 Payward 則是用自有與客戶資金，在 DeFi 基礎設施上留下可延續的曝險與合作空間。數量未披露，但方向已很清楚：交易所母公司正把資管手臂伸進鏈上信用。 相關報導 Kraken 母公司 Payward 砸 5.5 億美元收購 Bitnomial！一次全包美國三大衍生品牌照，要重啟 IPO？ 數位銀行 SoFi 與 Kraken 達成合作！加密交易所進銀行體系，打通穩定幣與美元結算 Chainlink 新推 24/7 報價：週末也能定價代幣化美股，Aave 率先採用 詳解 AAVE V4 升級：用模組化重塑借貸，老幣能否迎來新春？〈Kraken 母公司 Payward 二級市場購入 AAVE！加碼 DeFi 佈局〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: Bitcoin Price Analysis: $80K Battle Rages On as BTC’s Next Targets Come Into Focus
articles.excerpt:
Bitcoin is trading around $79.7K after a sharp rebound from the $75K region stalled near $80K. The rejection keeps BTC within a short-term corrective structure, with the price now caught between a key demand zone below and overhead resistance that buyers have repeatedly failed to clear. Meanwhile, the Adjusted SOPR is sliding back toward its […]

Bitcoin is trading around $79.7K after a sharp rebound from the $75K region stalled near $80K. The rejection keeps BTC within a short-term corrective structure, with the price now caught between a key demand zone below and overhead resistance that buyers have repeatedly failed to clear. Meanwhile, the Adjusted SOPR is sliding back toward its key 1 threshold, suggesting that profit realization across the network is fading.

Bitcoin Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

Bitcoin continues to trade within the ascending channel that has defined its recovery from the June lows near $58K. However, after two rejections from the channel’s upper boundary around $87K in September and early October, BTC began forming lower highs and slipped below the channel’s midpoint late last month.

The decline brought the price into the $75K-$78K demand zone, the order block that preceded the September rally toward $87K. Buyers responded with a long lower wick and a strong rebound, but the move stalled at the channel midline, which is now acting as resistance around $80K. Reclaiming it could pave the way for another advance toward the $87K supply zone, where the massive breakdown originated early this year.

Conversely, a decisive daily close below $75K would invalidate the order block and leave the channel’s lower boundary near $73K as the next support. A breakdown beneath this trendline would mark a clear failure of the broader recovery structure and raise the risk of a deeper move toward the low $60K region, where the price consolidated during the summer.

 

BTC/USDT 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart shows that BTC has been trading within a descending channel since the late-September highs near $87K, printing consistent lower highs and lower lows. The upper boundary has capped every notable rebound, including the October spike into the $85K supply zone, which sellers quickly absorbed.

Yesterday, Bitcoin rallied aggressively from the $76K demand zone, which overlaps with the channel’s lower boundary. The move, however, was rejected at the confluence of the upper trendline and the $80K supply zone, which represents the bearish order block where the late-October breakdown began, and the price is now slipping back below it.

A sustained break above this confluence would mark the first breakout from the channel and could open the way toward $85K, followed by the $87K highs. Until then, rebounds remain vulnerable to overhead supply. A renewed drop below $76K would leave the descending lower boundary near $75K as the final short-term support before the daily channel floor around $73K.

 

On-Chain Analysis

The Adjusted Spent Output Profit Ratio (aSOPR) on CryptoQuant measures whether coins moved on-chain are, on average, being spent at a profit or a loss, excluding outputs younger than one hour to filter out short-term noise. Readings above 1 indicate profit realization, while values below 1 suggest holders are selling at a loss. The chart displays the metric’s 30-day exponential moving average.

The indicator remained above 1 throughout the 2024–2025 uptrend before dropping below it in early 2026, bottoming near 0.98 as BTC fell toward $60K. It reclaimed the threshold in August alongside the rally, peaking around 1.013 in October, but has since declined sharply toward approximately 1.003.

In healthy uptrends, the 1 level tends to act as support, as holders are reluctant to sell at a loss. A rebound from here would suggest demand is absorbing supply around the $78K zone, while a sustained drop below it would point to loss-driven selling. The metric alone does not confirm direction, but a move beneath 1 alongside a daily close below $75K would considerably strengthen the bearish case and potentially lead to another round of capitulation.

articles.title: Zilch Commits £77m to Victoria HQ as European Expansion Accelerates
articles.excerpt:
Zilch will take 33,160 sq ft at 40 Grosvenor Place on a 10-year lease, more than doubling capacity ahead of its planned Fjord

The post Zilch Commits £77m to Victoria HQ as European Expansion Accelerates appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Zilch has signed a 10-year lease on a new London headquarters at 40 Grosvenor Place in Victoria, committing £77 million over the lease term and more than doubling its current office footprint. The buy-now-pay-later and payments platform will occupy floors four and five of the building, a 33,160 sq ft space the company says can accommodate more than 400 employees. Zilch expects to relocate from its current base at 111 Buckingham Palace Road in Spring 2027. 

The investment manager for the building is PATRIZIA , represented by CBRE and Knight Frank , with XIX acting for Zilch.

 A platform for European ambitions 

 Philip Belamant, CEO and co-founder at Zilch 

The headquarters move sits alongside a cluster of strategic commitments that have changed the shape of the business this year. Zilch has announced the proposed acquisition of Fjord Bank , a deal that is expected to complete in the first half of 2027 and which the company says will form the foundation of its European expansion. It has also entered a multi-year strategic partnership with Visa and taken on a sponsorship arrangement as Arsenal FC’s official payments partner.

Cumulative customer spend on the Zilch platform has passed £8 billion across all UK regions, according to the company, and it counts six million customers on its books. Philip Belamant , co-founder and chief executive, said the new headquarters reflects “the scale of our ambition and the momentum behind our growth” and described the site as a base for attracting talent both domestically and internationally.

City Minister Lucy Rigby KC MP welcomed the announcement, describing the UK as “a fintech powerhouse” and voicing support for the sector’s continued growth.

 Market and regulatory context 

The Fjord Bank acquisition, once completed, would give Zilch a European banking licence and materially alter its regulatory footprint. For a BNPL provider that has operated largely under consumer-credit exemptions, holding a licensed deposit-taking entity in Europe carries both an opportunity and a compliance cost: greater product range and cross-border reach, but also capital requirements, prudential reporting obligations and exposure to the evolving Consumer Credit Directive framework across EU member states.

The broader BNPL sector has been navigating tightening oversight on both sides of the Channel. In the UK, the Treasury’s long-running consultation on bringing BNPL within the FCA regulatory perimeter has yet to conclude in final rules, though industry participants have been preparing for credit-authorisation requirements for several years. A banking licence acquired through Fjord Bank could allow Zilch to pre-empt some of that regulatory uncertainty by operating within an already-licenced structure.

Competitively, the move mirrors a pattern seen among better-capitalised BNPL players globally: consolidation upward into banking infrastructure rather than remaining as a merchant-facing credit layer. Klarna ‘s pursuit of a public listing and Affirm’s continued push into debit and banking products reflect the same structural logic. Zilch’s Visa partnership adds an acceptance-network dimension that standalone BNPL products lack, potentially supporting the “intelligent payments platform” positioning the company has adopted as a framing that goes beyond instalment credit.

The Victoria headquarters lease is a long-duration fixed commitment, which signals confidence in the London talent market and the company’s trajectory. The proof of that conviction will come when the Fjord Bank deal closes and Zilch moves to convert the European banking licence into live product revenue.

articles.title: Just How Large Is the Potential Market for Stablecoins?
articles.excerpt:
Measuring the size of the stablecoin market is no simple task. Several organizations have produced sizable market forecasts based on estimates of stablecoin supply, tokenized asset values, and transaction volumes. But these figures don’t necessarily reflect the full revenue opportunities available to financial institutions. In the Building the Case for Stablecoins: Javelin Models the Total […]

The post Just How Large Is the Potential Market for Stablecoins? appeared first on PaymentsJournal .

Measuring the size of the stablecoin market is no simple task. Several organizations have produced sizable market forecasts based on estimates of stablecoin supply, tokenized asset values, and transaction volumes. But these figures don’t necessarily reflect the full revenue opportunities available to financial institutions.

In the Building the Case for Stablecoins: Javelin Models the Total Addressable Market report, Javelin Strategy & Research examines 32 U.S. outbound remittance corridors representing nearly $250 billion in annual flows to assess the potential market for stablecoin-enabled payments. By incorporating defined use cases, measurable payment activity, and an existing fee pool, Javelin develops bear, base, and bull scenarios to estimate the opportunity.

Searching for Data

A total addressable market (TAM) represents the overall revenue opportunity for a product or service within a given market. Industry analysts have approached the stablecoin market from several different angles, but each has limitations.

Total outstanding stablecoin supply offers a snapshot of the value currently in circulation, but doesn’t capture the market’s potential. Annual stablecoin transaction volume provides another useful measure, although it can be inflated by repeated turnover of the same balances. Others simply aggregate the stablecoins held in individual wallets.

“I’ve been involved in discussions where companies are getting data from consumers, and they’re leaning on decision making and strategy based off the consumer data,” said Joel Hugentobler , Cryptocurrency Analyst at Javelin and author of the report. “If you wait for consumer demand, you’re going to miss this opportunity.”

Measuring Revenue

The most prevalent approach involves multiplying an asset value by an assumed adoption rate and presenting the result as a total addressable market. However, this doesn’t necessarily answer the more important question: How much revenue can participants actually generate?

Hugentobler’s approach builds on that model by incorporating additional inputs, including fees and one-way payment flows, and applying bear, base, and bull scenarios that account for regulatory conditions, adoption rates, and transaction volumes. The goal is to estimate the market opportunity in terms of what participants could realistically capture by pursuing stablecoin solutions.

The model starts with U.S. outbound remittance flows, applies an assumed stablecoin adoption rate, and then factors in remittance fees. The first two inputs estimate how much existing payment activity could migrate to stablecoin rails, while the fee component translates that activity into a potential revenue pool. Together, these inputs provide a more grounded estimate of the addressable market.

Money velocity is another important consideration when assessing TAM. Citi, for example, generally applies a velocity multiple of 50 in its own measurements, meaning $1 trillion in stablecoins could potentially support $50 trillion in transactions. This has implications for market estimates because the underlying stablecoin balances can facilitate activity across multiple services, including foreign exchange and last-mile payments.

The Last Mile

The last-mile component is receiving increasing attention across the industry, and for good reason. It remains one of the key pieces that must be addressed for stablecoin payments to reach their full potential.

“If a payment settles on a blockchain in seconds, but that last mile portion takes minutes or days, it’s a poor payment experience and it defeats the whole purpose,” said Hugentobler. “So there are quite a few companies that are really focusing on that last mile portion.”

Stablecoin providers are building their businesses around solving last-mile challenges, recognizing that ensuring a transaction can be completed efficiently is just as important as optimizing the middle mile. Before scaling a corridor, financial institutions need dependable payout partners, access to FX liquidity, identity verification capabilities, and processes for handling exceptions.

Treasury Use Cases

A large portion of stablecoin activity today is tied to treasury-related use cases. B2B payments, payroll, and capital markets settlement could ultimately represent even larger opportunities, but customer behavior and available data are less consistent, making these markets more difficult to quantify. Even so, interest in their potential continues to grow.

“They might find a problem that they want to solve with stablecoins,” Hugentobler said. “Then they realize, oh, wait a second, if we use stablecoins and we have an international business or offices all over the world and we’re paying suppliers, we can maintain all these balance sheets on one ledger instead of having to manage all these different systems and different cutoff times. And it can be transferred in seconds. That’s going to be a big topic of discussion in the coming year.”

The prevailing view is that payment processors should keep stablecoins invisible to consumers unless there is tangible benefit to holding them or knowing they are holding them. Consumers don’t necessarily need to understand which underlying mechanism makes a transaction more convenient or efficient for the financial institution.

A Conservative Case

The overall TAM for U.S. stablecoin remittances turned out to be somewhat smaller than Hugentobler initially anticipated. However, he emphasized that the figures should be viewed as particularly conservative estimates.

One consideration was the failure of the Clarity Act to advance in September, leaving the industry in a state of regulatory uncertainty as participants await the guidelines that could help fuel the next phase of growth. But that uncertainty may also obscure just how much the stablecoin market has already evolved.

“It’s definitely come a long way,” said Hugentobler. “Some things still need to be worked out from the bigger players in the market that handle a lot more volume, but it’s coming for sure.”

Despite this progress, stablecoins remain overlooked in many corners of the financial industry. As more organizations become familiar with the possibilities, an increasing number appear poised to enter the market.

Hugentobler recently asked a digital remittance company how much of its payment volume it was already processing in stablecoins.

“He said, ‘We haven’t seen a ton of demand,’” Hugentobler said. “And I said, ‘What do you mean by that?’ He said, ‘Well, consumers would rather just pay with what they know.’ I said, right, I agree 100%, but if the fees are way less and they don’t even know they’re using a stablecoin, why would they not use a cheaper alternative? And I could just see the wheels turning.”

The post Just How Large Is the Potential Market for Stablecoins? appeared first on PaymentsJournal .

articles.title: AI agents went shopping for TVs and laptops—and messed up nearly 50% of the time, study shows
articles.excerpt:
In a first of its kind experiment, Gemini and Muse agents scored the highest when it come to carrying out tasks like buying a TV.

As personal AI agents like Muse or Claude become part of daily life, more people are asking them to carry out shopping tasks. But there’s a problem: the agents aren’t very good at shopping. In a first-of-its-kind study, Visa instructed 22 different agents to purchase three everyday items—a TV, a laptop and a hair appliance—and, while some agents did significantly better than others, the overall success rate was only around 57%.

The results of the study are available on a new website by Visa that shows the outcome of 15 separate shopping expeditions by each of the 22 agents. Unsurprisingly, the agents powered by more cutting edge AI models fared best, with the Aragon 4 version of Google’s Gemini and the Wonder version of Meta’s Making notching the highest scores. Both agents made a successful purchase 82% of the time. A Claude agent came in third with a 76% success rate, while an OpenAI agent finished 6th with a 64% success rate.

The diagram below from Visa shows the performance of all 22 models. The vertical axis scores the agents’ success rate, while the horizontal one reflects the cost to run each shopping inquiry. (Visa notes that the five most expensive models succeeded on average 67% of the time, while the cheapest five scored 50%).

 

The agents’ struggle to make a successful purchase is rooted in part in a simple reality: The motivations behind any given purchase are often complicated and, in many cases, consumers lack information and are not certain what they want.

Visa’s experiment sought to capture this reality by, in the case of TV shoppers, assigning a list of attributes they needed in a television—for instance, compatibility with a child’s gaming console, a 30-day return window, and a model with Dolby Vision. As is the case with real world consumers, the purchaser (who in this case was also an agent) would volunteer some information, but not all of it. 

The upshot is that, for an AI agent to succeed in Visa’s experiment, it had to interact with the shopper in a way that would elicit the missing information in a reasonable time. Success amounted to buying a TV that matched the shopper’s needs but, in many cases, the agents bought the wrong product, or simply failed to suggest something suitable at all.

“We’re not there yet from a trust or technology perspective. But we’ll soon get into a world where consumers can trust and delegate,” Visa’s Global Head of Growth, Rubail Birwadker, told Fortune .

Birwadker noted that agent-driven shopping is still in its early days, but that it is advancing rapidly. He added that the focus of Visa’s experiment—product discovery—is just one element of this new type of commerce that retailers and AI companies are trying to figure out.

For AI agents to enter the shopping mainstream, companies will also have to sort out smooth and secure payments—a challenge that Visa and its rival Mastercard are already seeking to address by educating merchants and building tools to facilitate so-called agentic commerce.

There are also new and unresolved legal issues when it comes to AI agents going shopping. Most notably, it’s still unclear who should bear the liability when agents make rogue purchases or commit fraud.

According to Birwadker, these questions will get resolved over time in the same way that an earlier generation of consumers and merchants learned to use ecommerce—he added, though, that agent-based shopping is going to be a very different experience than how we shop online today.

In announcing the results of its agent shopping experiment, Visa also rolled out a website that allows consumers to interact with the agents used in its survey.

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com
